Custom Objects.description: In the user interface, you can extend your org’s data by defining custom objects. Custom objects are custom database tables that allow you to store information unique to your organization. For custom objects, the custom flag—a Boolean field in the describe results—is true.

CustomApplication.description: Represents a custom or standard application.

CustomBrand.description: Represents a custom branding and color scheme.
CustomBrand.accessRules: This object is available only when your org has digital experiences enabled.

CustomBrandAsset.description: Represents a branding element in a custom branding scheme. For example, a color, logo image, header image, or footer text.
CustomBrandAsset.accessRules: This object is available only when your org has digital experiences enabled.

CustomField.description: Represents a custom field on a custom object that stores data unique to your organization.

CustomFieldDisplay.description: Represents the view type assigned to product attribute custom fields.
CustomFieldDisplay.accessRules: CustomFieldDisplay is available only if the B2B or D2C Commerce license is enabled.

CustomFieldDisplayValue.description: Stores variation details for the product attribute item view.
CustomFieldDisplayValue.accessRules: CustomFieldDisplayValue is available only if the B2B or D2C Commerce license is enabled.

CustomFieldMember.description: Represents the working copy of a field for editing or saving in a MetadataContainer.
CustomFieldMember.accessRules: View All Data and Customize Application

CustomFulfillmentScopeCnfg.description: Represents a user-defined scope to define and customize scope-specific validation and orchestration for flexible fulfillment.

CustomHelpMenuItem.description: Represents the items within a section of the Lightning Experience help menu that the admin added to display custom, org-specific help resources.

CustomHelpMenuSection.description: Represents a section of the Lightning Experience help menu that the admin added to display custom, org-specific help resources.

CustomHttpHeader.description: Represents a custom HTTP header used with OData 2.0 or OData 4.0 external data sources. Custom HTTP headers provide context information from Salesforce such as region, org details, or the role of the person viewing the external object.
CustomHttpHeader.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.

CustomMsgChannel.description: Represents a custom conversation channel and stores event-driven Messaging settings. Custom conversation channels are implemented for Bring Your Own Channel for Messaging and Bring Your Own Channel for CCaaS Messaging channels.
CustomMsgChannel.accessRules: Salesforce admin privileges or the Customize Application permission

CustomNotifActionDef.description: Represents the metadata associated with a mobile action group notification definition.

CustomNotifActionDef (Beta).description: Represents the metadata associated with a mobile action group notification definition.

CustomNotificationActionGroup.description: Stores information about custom notification action groups.

CustomNotificationActionGroup (Beta).description: Stores information about custom notification action groups.

CustomNotificationType.description: Stores information about custom notification types.

CustomObject.description: Represents a custom object that stores data unique to your organization. Includes access to the associated CustomObject object and related fields in Salesforce Metadata API.

CustomObjectParticipant.description: Represents information about a participant in the context of a custom object record.

CustomObjectUserLicenseMetrics.label: Custom Object Usage By User License Metric

CustomPermission.description: Represents a permission created to control access to a custom process or app, such as sending email.

CustomPermissionDependency.description: Represents the dependency between two custom permissions when one custom permission requires that you enable another custom permission.
CustomPermissionDependency.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only users with View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

CustomTab.description: Represents CustomTab metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

Customer.description: Represents the customer role of an individual with respect to a particular company or organization.

CustomerProperty.description: Represents the insurable and insured properties of a customer.

DandBCompany.description: Represents a Dun & Bradstreet® company record, which is associated with an account added from Data.com.
DandBCompany.accessRules: Only organizations with Data.com Premium Prospector or Data.com Premium Clean can access this object.

Dashboard.description: Represents a dashboard, which shows data from custom reports as visual components. Access is read-only.

Dashboard Event Type.description: Dashboard events contain details about report requests from dashboards. These requests are triggered by dashboard refreshes, subscriptions, and filter changes.

DashboardComponent.description: Represents a dashboard component, which can be a chart, metric, table, or gauge on a dashboard. Access is read-only.

DataAssessmentMetric.description: Represents a summary of statistics for fields matched and unmatched in your account records with Data.com account records.

DataAssessmentValueMetric.description: Summarizes the number of fields matched for your account records with Data.com account records.

DataDetectJobSession.description: Represents a run of a DataDetect scan policy that's triggered manually.

DataDetectPolicy.description: Represents a set of parameters that specifies the types of sensitive data for search with in a data scan. DataDetect scan policies can also apply filters to a data scan, along with specific objects and fields for scanning.

DataDetectPolicyObjField.description: Represents an object field of the DataDetect scan policy object to be scanned. This object is available in API version 64.0 and later.

DataDetectPolicyObject.description: Represents an object of the DataDetect scan policy to be scanned. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

DataDetectScanResult.description: Represents the results of a DataDetect data policy scan.

DataEncryptionKey.description: The DataEncryptionKey object is part of the Bring Your Own Key (BYOK) feature, which allows users to upload a data encryption key (DEK) using a public key generated by the Salesforce Shield Key Management Service (KMS). Customers create their own DEKs and upload them to Salesforce. Users access this entity via the API to list DEK keys for auditing purposes. They can also programmatically use this object to create the certificate and to upload key material.

DataIntegrationRecordPurchasePermission.description: Represents Lightning Data purchase credits that a Salesforce admin has granted to users.

DataKitDeploymentLog.description: Represents the log details of a data kit component deployment. This object is available in API version 61.0 or later.

DataMaskCustomValueLibrary.description: Represents a set of user-inputted values in a custom library in Data Mask.

DataMltOrgMdatChgLineage.label: Data Multi Org Metadata Change Lineage

DataObjectSearchIndexConf.label: Data Object Search Index Configuration

DataOrgFeatureAllowList.label: Data Org Feature Allow List

DataSourceBundleDefinition.accessRules: Data 360 permission to access this object

DataSrcDataModelFieldMap.description: Data Source Data Model Field Mapping (Tooling API)
DataSrcDataModelFieldMap.label: Data Source Data Model Field Mapping

DataUsePurpose.description: Represents the reason for contacting a prospect or customer, such as for billing, marketing, or surveys
DataUsePurpose.accessRules: This object is available if Data Protection and Privacy is enabled.

DataWeaveResource.description: Represents the DataWeaveScriptResource class that is generated for all DataWeave scripts.

DatabaseSaveEventLog.description: Database Save events track when records are created,updated, or deleted

DatacloudCompany.description: Represents the fields for Data.com company records.

DatacloudContact.description: The fields and properties for Data.com contact records.

DatacloudDandBCompany.description: Represents a set of read-only fields that are used to return D&B company data from Data.com API calls.

DatacloudOwnedEntity.description: Represents fields in the DatacloudOwnedEntity object. The DatacloudOwnedEntity object tracks user-purchased records.

DatacloudPurchaseUsage.description: Represents an object used to identify and track Data.com record purchases. This object is available in API version 30.0 or later.

DatasetExport.description: Represents a dataset exported from CRM Analytics. When a dataset is exported, the data is converted into a .csv file and the schema is stored in a separate JSON file. These files are stored in two objects: DatasetExport and DatasetExportPart. DatasetExport acts as the header and includes the JSON schema.

DatasetExportPart.description: Represents a dataset exported from CRM Analytics. When a dataset is exported, the data is converted into a .csv file and the schema is stored in a separate JSON file. These files are stored in two objects: DatasetExport and DatasetExportPart. DatasetExportPart contains parts of the .csv file.

DatedConversionRate.description: Represents the dated exchange rates used by an organization for which the multicurrency and the effective dated currency features are enabled.
DatedConversionRate.accessRules: Customer Portal users can't access this object.

DealIndirectPartner.description: Represents an indirect partner’s involvement in a deal.

DealerProdtSearchableField.description: Represents information about dealers selling and, or, servicing products for location-based searches. Helps customers find nearby dealer locations for product purchases and services.

DealerVehDefSearchableField.description: Represents information about dealerships selling and, or, servicing vehicles for location-based searches. Helps customers find nearby dealer locations for vehicle-related purchases and services.

DebitMemo.description: Represents the document used to charge an additional amount to a buyer by a seller. An invoice is generated for the debit memo in the next invoice run.
DebitMemo.accessRules: Revenue Cloud Billing license and one of these permission sets to access this object

DebitMemoAddress.description: Represents the buyer's address information, which is used to determine the tax amount for a buyer when a debit memo is issued.
DebitMemoAddress.accessRules: Revenue Cloud Billing license and one of these permission sets to access this object

DebitMemoLine.description: Represents the additional charge amount that the buyer must pay for the product, service, or debit memo line tax that’s related to the debit memo.
DebitMemoLine.accessRules: Revenue Cloud Billing license and one of these permission sets to access this object

DebitMemoLineTax.description: Represents the tax information for a debit memo line.
DebitMemoLineTax.accessRules: Revenue Cloud Billing license and the Tax Admin permission set to access this object

DebugLevel.description: Represents a set of log category levels to assign to a TraceFlag object. Multiple trace flags can use a debug level.

DecisionMatrixDefinition.description: Represents information about a decision matrix definition.

DecisionMatrixDefinitionVersion.description: Represents information about a decision matrix definition version.

DecisionTable.description: Represents the information about a decision table.

DecisionTableDatasetLink.description: Represents a dataset link associated with a decision table. Use dataset links in a decision table to select an object whose records the decision table must evaluate and provide outcomes for.

DecisionTableParameter.description: Represents an input or output field in a decision table. An input field is a field in the business rule object or custom metadata type that contains values used by the decision table to evaluate records and values. An output field is a field in the business rule object or custom metadata type that contains the values provided as outcomes for a rule.

DecisionTableSourceCriteria.description: Represents the fields and values from a data source that are used to define the condition logic of the data that's used in a decision table.

DecisionTblDatasetParameter.description: Represents the mapping between a decision table parameter and a field of the object selected in the dataset link. This mapping allows the decision table to know which object fields from the dataset link must be evaluated by the input fields of the decision table.

DeclinedEventRelation.description: Represents event participants (invitees or attendees) with the status Declined for a given event.

DelegateGroup.description: Represents a Delegate Group for queries.

DelegateGroupGrant.description: Represents a Delegate Group Grant, indicating permissions granted to a delegate group.

DelegateGroupMember.description: Represents users assigned to the delegate group

DelegatedAccount.accessRules: You must have a Partner or Customer Community Plus license. You can't edit the visibility of DelegatedAccount metadata on user profiles.

DeleteEvent.description: Represents a record that has been soft deleted.

DeliveryEstimationSetup.description: Shows the configuration options for the commerce delivery service offered through a web store or sales channel. Includes settings such as delivery location group, channel, fulfillment types, and default fulfillment time.
DeliveryEstimationSetup.accessRules: The DeliveryEstimationSetup object is available only if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled.

DeliveryTask.description: Represents information about shipments and orders to be delivered to a store in a visit.

DeployDetails.description: A complex type that contains detailed XML for any compile errors reported in the asynchronous request defined by a ContainerAsyncRequest object.

DeployRequest.description: Uses file representations of metadata components to create, update, or delete those components in a Salesforce org. This object is available in API version 49.0 and later.
DeployRequest.accessRules: Your client application must be logged in with the Modify Metadata Through Metadata API Functions OR Modify All Data permission.

Deviation.description: Represents the information about the deviation from set rules.

DevopsActivityLog.description: Represents the history of activities performed within DevOps Center. The object provides visibility into the users, actions, and outcomes.

DevopsEnvDeploymentMbr.description: Represents a metadata component or configuration data record included in a deployment to a DevOps Center pipeline environment. Use it to verify what was promoted or deployed.

DevopsEnvironment.description: Represents a connection from DevOps Center to an environment, which currently can be only a Salesforce org. Developers use development environments to do their work. Each pipeline stage has an associated environment.

DevopsPipeline.description: Represents a release pipeline in DevOps Center, which is the ordered path work items follow from development to production. Related DevopsPipelineStage records store the pipeline stages.

DevopsPipelineEnvironment.description: Represents the association between a DevopsPipeline and DevopsEnvironment objects. This object defines which orgs are part of the release pipeline.

DevopsPipelineStage.description: Represents a connection between a pipeline, an environment, and the source control branch used for that stage. The collection of all pipeline stages in a project make up the DevOps Center pipeline.

DevopsPipelineStageTrigger.description: Defines trigger points within a DevOps pipeline stage where automated validations, test suite executions, and quality gate evaluations can be initiated. It tracks execution history, trigger type, associated records, and the number of linked test suites and quality gates, enabling organizations to enforce testing and quality controls at specific stages of the deployment lifecycle.

DevopsPipelineTestProvider.description: Establishes the association between a DevOps pipeline and an external test provider. It stores provider-specific configuration and project information required for integrating testing services into a pipeline. This object enables pipelines to connect with external testing platforms, manage provider settings, and facilitate the execution and synchronization of tests as part of the DevOps workflow.

DevopsPipelnStgProm.description: Represents a stage promotion in DevOps Center. Stage promotion moves one or more work items to the next stage in the pipeline.

DevopsPipelnStgPromWkItem.description: Represents the association between a work item and a pipeline stage promotion. The object tracks the merge status of the work item into the target stage branch in source control.

DevopsProject.description: Represents a DevOps Center project. A project is the primary workspace where teams collaborate to manage changes for an app or customization. This object is the parent for all other DevOps Center objects, including pipelines, environments, and work items.

DevopsProjectPipeline.description: Represents an association between a DevOps Center project and a release pipeline. In DevOps Center, each project is associated with a pipeline to define the sequence of stages work items move through, from initial development to final release. This association is typically established during the pipeline setup.

DevopsQualityGate.description: Defines a set of quality requirements that must be satisfied before a deployment or pipeline stage can proceed. It acts as a container for quality gate rules, enabling organizations to enforce testing and quality standards by evaluating test execution results against predefined criteria. Quality gates help ensure that only changes meeting established quality thresholds advance through the DevOps lifecycle.

DevopsQualityGateResult.description: Stores the outcome of a quality gate evaluation performed during a test suite execution. It records the overall status of the quality gate and associates the result with both the quality gate definition and the corresponding test suite execution. This object enables tracking, reporting, and auditing of quality gate compliance before a deployment progresses through the DevOps pipeline.

DevopsQualityGateRule.description: Defines the criteria that must be evaluated as part of a quality gate assessment within the DevOps process. Each rule specifies a validation condition, such as severity, pass percentage, or essential test requirements, along with an optional threshold value. These rules are used to determine whether a quality gate passes or fails before allowing progression through the deployment pipeline.

DevopsQualityGateRuleResult.description: Stores the outcome of an individual quality gate rule evaluation performed during a quality gate assessment. It records the execution status of a specific quality gate rule and associates the result with the overall quality gate evaluation, enabling detailed tracking, monitoring, and reporting of quality gate compliance within the DevOps process.

DevopsRequestInfo.description: Represents a specific request for a DevOps Center operation, such as a commit, deploy, promotion, rebase, or back sync, and tracks its overall status and outcome.

DevopsTest.description: Stores and manages individual test definitions within the DevOps testing framework. It maintains metadata about tests imported from external test providers, including test type, severity, execution status, configuration details, and associations with pipelines and environments. This object enables the organization, tracking, and execution of tests as part of automated quality assurance and deployment processes.

DevopsTestExecution.description: Tracks the execution of individual tests within a test suite execution. It records execution timing, status, results, severity, error messages, and related reporting information, enabling teams to monitor, analyze, and troubleshoot test outcomes as part of the DevOps testing process.

DevopsTestProvider.description: Stores the configuration and metadata of both internal and external testing providers integrated with the DevOps framework. It serves as a central registry of supported test providers, maintaining provider-specific information such as implementation identifiers, language settings, URLs, and integration details required to connect and manage external testing systems within DevOps processes.

DevopsTestProviderSyncLog.description: Tracks synchronization activities between the DevOps framework and external test providers. It records the lifecycle of synchronization operations, including execution start and end times, status, error details, and the associated DevOps pipeline and test provider. This object enables monitoring, troubleshooting, and auditing of test provider synchronization processes.

DevopsTestSuite.description: Stores and manages collections of related test definitions that can be executed together as part of a DevOps pipeline. It serves as a logical grouping mechanism for tests sourced from external test providers, enabling teams to organize, configure, and execute sets of tests within specific pipelines and environments.

DevopsTestSuiteExecution.description: Records the individual execution lifecycle, results, and metrics of a specific test suite within a DevOps pipeline stage. It tracks granular outcomes like code coverage, pass/fail rates, and links directly back to the overarching test suite group.

DevopsTestSuiteGroupExec.description: Records the execution lifecycle of a test suite group within a DevOps pipeline stage, including execution status, quality gate outcomes, timing information, and deployment request details.

DevopsTestSuiteStage.description: Represents the association between a Test Suite and a Pipeline Stage within the DevOps process. It is used to configure which test suites are executed at specific pipeline stages and optionally link quality gates that must be evaluated before progressing through the deployment pipeline.

DevopsTestSuiteTest.description: Represents the association between a DevOps Test Suite and an individual DevOps Test, enabling tests to be organized, managed, and synchronized within a test suite.

DevopsWkItmTstSteGrpExec.description: Represents the association between a DevOpsWork Item and a DevOpsTestSuiteGroupExecution. This object is used to track which work items are linked to specific test suite group execution records, enabling traceability between development work and test execution activities within the DevOps lifecycle.

DifferentialShift.description: Represents a collection of fields to store the information about shifts different from the normal shifts of a resource. These shifts are marked against the timesheet entries.

DigitalPass.description: Represents a user-facing representation generated from a digital pass template. It contains specific, relevant data, such as a membership number or voucher details, making each pass unique to the user. This pass can be optionally stored in a mobile or digital wallet.

DigitalPassTemplate.description: Represents a template for creating digital passes, such as loyalty membership cards or coupons. It outlines the pass's design, data fields, and functionality, enabling the generation of multiple unique passes from a single, reusable template.

DigitalPassTmplParameter.description: Represents a specific, configurable data field within a digital pass template. It defines the content type such as text, date, or image, and properties such as label and visibility, for a particular section of the pass.

DigitalSignature.description: Represents a signature captured on a service report in field service.

DigitalVerification.description: Stores information about the verification of a related record

DigitalWallet.description: Represents a customer’s digital wallet service. Salesforce Payments can use a digital wallet as a payment source when processing payments through a payment gateway.
DigitalWallet.accessRules: Salesforce Payments, Salesforce Order Management, B2B Commerce, D2C Commerce, Lightning Experience

DirectMessage.description: Represents a direct message conversation between multiple users in Chatter.
DirectMessage.accessRules: Manage Chatter Messages and Direct Messages

Disclosure.description: Represents the disclosure details that a company shares, which can be included by a user in their response document.

DisclosureDefinition.description: Represents information that defines a disclosure type, such as details of the publisher or vendor who created or implemented the report.

DisclosureDefinitionVersion.description: Represents the version information about the disclosure definition.

DisclosureType.description: Represents the types of disclosures that are done by an individual or an organization and the associated metadata.

DisclsReportingPeriod.description: Represents a corporate reporting period that is used for stakeholder disclosure reports.

DiscoveryDplyMdlCstmzField.description: Discovery Deployed Model Customizable Fields - DiscoveryDplyMdlCstmzField
DiscoveryDplyMdlCstmzField.label: Discovery Deployed Model Customizable Field

DiscvDplyMdlCstmzFieldTxt.description: Discovery Deployed Model Customizable Field Text - DiscvDplyMdlCstmzFieldTxt
DiscvDplyMdlCstmzFieldTxt.label: Discovery Deployed Model Customizable Field Text

Dispute.description: Represents the details of a dispute that involves one or multiple disputed transactions.
Dispute.accessRules: These fields are available if the add-on license for Agentforce Financial Services is enabled.

DisputeItem.description: Represents a transaction that’s being disputed.

DisputeItemArbitration.description: Represents the details of the arbitration or compliance case filed for a transaction that's being disputed.

DisputeItemChargeback.description: Represents the claim and chargeback created by the card issuer for a transaction that's being disputed.

DisputeItemMerchantAlert.description: Represents the alert sent by the card issuer to the merchant. The alert occurs through a chargeback prevention vendor like Ethoca Merchant Alerts™ for a transaction that’s being disputed.
DisputeItemMerchantAlert.accessRules: These fields are available if the add-on license for Agentforce Financial Services is enabled.

DisputeItemQueueResponse.description: Represents the response received from the job that’s run to fetch the claim details.

DisputeQueueJobRun.description: Represents a job that’s run to fetch the details of the claims.

DisputeReason.description: Represents the reason for the transaction dispute.

DistributorAuthorization.description: Represents the official authorization from an insurance company granting a distributor the permission to act as its agent.

Division.description: A logical segment of your organization's data. For example, if your company is organized into different business units, you could create a division for each business unit, such as “North America,” “Healthcare,” or “Consulting.” Available only if the organization has the Division permission enabled.
Division.accessRules: Divisions must be enabled for your organization to access this object. To discover whether divisions have been enabled for an organization, inspect the User or Group object for the DefaultDivision field—if it is present, then divisions have been enabled, and this field (the field is named Division in objects other than User and Group) will be available in all relevant objects. Customer Portal users can’t access this object.

DivisionLocalization.description: When the Translation Workbench is enabled for your organization, the DivisionLocalization object provides the translation of the label for a division.
DivisionLocalization.accessRules: Your organization must be using Professional, Enterprise, Developer, Unlimited, or Performance Edition and be enabled for the Translation Workbench. To view this object, you must have the “View Setup and Configuration” permission.

DivrsEquityInclSum.description: Represents information that indicates the quantitative view of the organization based on the employee gender, age group, and other fairness indicators.

DocAtchDownloadEventLog.description: Document Attachment Downloads events contain details of document and attachment downloads.

DocChkItemValidatedTarget.description: Represents the details of the document checklist item and the target object against which the document checklist item was validated.

DocClauseSetAsmtQstn.description: Represents a junction between a document clause set and an assessment question.

Document.description: Represents a file that a user has uploaded. Unlike Attachment records, documents are not attached to a parent object.

Document Attachment Downloads Event Type.description: Document Attachment Downloads events contain details of document and attachment downloads.

DocumentAttachmentMap.description: Maps the relationship between an EmailTemplate and its attachment, which is stored as a Document.
DocumentAttachmentMap.accessRules: Customer Portal users can’t access this object.

DocumentCategory.description: Represents a document category that's used to group the document checklist items.

DocumentCategoryDocumentType.description: Represents a junction between Document Category and Document Type.

DocumentChecklistItem.description: Represents a checklist item for a file documentation upload.

DocumentDecisionRequirement.description: Represents the decision criteria that will be used to determine applicable documents.

DocumentFolder.description: Represents DocumentFolder metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.
DocumentFolder.label: Document Folder

DocumentRecipient.description: Connects a Service Report to a Digital Signature.

DocumentType.description: Represents the type of file being uploaded or attached.

Domain.description: Read-only object that represents a custom Web address assigned to a site in your organization.
Domain.accessRules: Customer Portal users can’t access this object. To view this object, you must have either the View Setup and Configuration or Manage Custom Domains permission. Site.com Publisher users have read-only API access to the Domain and DomainSite objects.

DomainProvision.description: Represents provisioned changes to custom domains.

DomainSite.description: Read-only junction object that joins the Site and Domain objects.
DomainSite.accessRules: Customer Portal users can’t access this object. To view this object, you must have either the View Setup and Configuration or Manage Custom Domains permission. Site.com Publisher users have read-only API access to the Domain and DomainSite objects.

DsarPolicy.description: Represents a Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) policy created in the Privacy Center managed package. DSAR policies anonymize or transfer personal data from your org at your customer’s request. This object is available in API version 50.0 and later.
DsarPolicy.accessRules: This object is for Privacy Center customers with the ReadAllData or PrivacyDataAccess permissions.

DsarPolicyLog.description: Represents the history of Data Subject Access Request (DSAR) policy execution requests. This log records the status and results of executed DSAR policies for a customer. This object is available in API version 50.0 and later.
DsarPolicyLog.accessRules: This object is for Privacy Center customers with the ReadAllData or PrivacyDataAccess permissions.

DuplicateJob.description: Represents an instance of a job that identifies duplicates among existing records in the system.
DuplicateJob.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

DuplicateJobDefinition.description: Setup object defining a job that identifies duplicate record items globally.
DuplicateJobDefinition.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

DuplicateJobMatchingRule.description: Represents a MatchingRule to be used with a DuplicateJob sharing the corresponding DuplicateJobMatchingRuleDefinition.
DuplicateJobMatchingRule.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

DuplicateJobMatchingRuleDefinition.description: Setup object specifying a MatchingRule to use with DuplicateJob instances that share a DuplicateJobDefinition.
DuplicateJobMatchingRuleDefinition.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

DuplicateRecordItem.description: Represents a record that’s been identified as a duplicate. DuplicateRecordItems are included in a DuplicateRecordSet, which are processed in duplicate jobs. Use this object to create custom report types for duplicates.
DuplicateRecordItem.accessRules: To access this object, enable Duplicate Management. A Salesforce admin can grant access to any user with a Sales Cloud or CRM user license.

DuplicateRecordSet.description: Represents a group of records that have been identified as duplicates. Each duplicate record set contains one or more duplicate record items. Use this object to create custom report types and view the results of duplicate jobs.
DuplicateRecordSet.accessRules: To access this object, activate duplicate rules. A Salesforce admin must give users read and write access.

DuplicateRule.description: Represents a duplicate rule for detecting duplicate records.
DuplicateRule.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

DynamicDataCapture.description: DynamicDataCapture is a junction object that adds a Form tab to Work Order Overview, and to the related list of a work order, work order line item, or service appointment in the Field Service mobile app.

EconomicPerformanceSum.description: Represents statistics about the direct economic value generated and distributed by an organization or the related income and expenses.

EducCharReqAssignment.description: Represents the assignment of an educational characteristic requirement to a learning or course offering.

EducCharReqRelationship.description: Represents the logic between multiple educational characteristics that defines an educational characteristic requirement.

EducCharRequirement.description: Represents a definition of the educational characteristics that are needed to meet an educational requirement.

EducCharacteristicAssignment.description: Represents the assignment of an educational characteristic to a student. Assignments are active for an academic interval such as an academic year or semester.

EducCharacteristicType.description: Represents a category of educational characteristics such as major or campus.

EducInstSearchableProfile.description: Represents information about an educational institution aggregated from other objects for Criteria-Based Search and Filter.

EducInstitutionOffering.description: Represents a junction between an institution's account and other objects, such as program, learning program, and academic term.

EducationalCharacteristic.description: Represents a characteristic about a student such as the student's major or student-athlete status. You can use educational characteristics to filter and search for data and customize the student experience.

EducationalInfoRequest.description: Represents details about a request for information (RFI) raised by prospective students, parents, or counselors.

ElectrLifecyclEmssnFctrSet.description: Represents the emissions factors used to calculate greenhouse gas emissions that occur throughout the lifecycle of electricity. It includes emissions from the production of electricity and losses during the transmission and distribution of each kilowatt hour (kWh) of electricity.

ElectricityEmssnFctrSet.description: Represents the factors that are used to convert electricity usage into CO₂e, CO₂, CH₄, and N₂O values. This record holds data on the breakdown of sources of electricity by fuel type (grid mixes).

ElectronicMediaGroup.description: Represents the type of media that you can associate with a product or category.
ElectronicMediaGroup.accessRules: You must have the B2B Commerce license and a CMS workspace to access a web store.

ElectronicMediaUse.accessRules: You must have the B2B Commerce license and a CMS workspace to access a web store.

EmailContent.description: Represents a marketing email asset for use with Account Engagement.
EmailContent.accessRules: Manage Email Content, CRM User, Sales, or Service

EmailDomainFilter.description: Represents a filter that determines whether an email relay is restricted to a specific list of domains.

EmailDomainKey.description: Represents a domain key for an organization’s domain, used to authenticate outbound email that Salesforce sends on the organization’s behalf.
EmailDomainKey.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.

EmailFolder.description: Represents EmailFolder metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.
EmailFolder.label: Email Folder

EmailInsight.description: Represents an insight generated from an email interaction. EmailInsights acts as a central place to store various types of insights related to email messages. The insights stored include status, type, and time of generation. Only certain types of insights can be created based on a pre-configured list of insight types.

EmailInsightAction.description: Represents the actions that have been taken, or could be taken, in relation to email insights. It logs different types of actions and associated metadata, helping to track and manage the activities and decisions made based on email insights.

EmailMessage.accessRules: EmailMessage is only available for orgs that use Email-to-Case or Enhanced Email, which is automatically enabled for most customers.

EmailMessageRelation.description: Represents the relationship between an email and contacts, leads, and users.
EmailMessageRelation.accessRules: EmailMessageRelation is only available for organizations that use Email-to-Case or Enhanced Email, which is automatically enabled for most customers.

EmailRelay.description: Represents the configuration for sending an email relay. An email relay routes email sent from Salesforce through your company’s email servers.
EmailRelay.accessRules: Email Administration, Customize Application, and View Setup

EmailRoutingAddress.description: An email address used for Email-to-Case. Email routing addresses store a unique email services address provided by Salesforce and configuration options for emails received by this address.

EmailServicesAddress.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.

EmailServicesFunction.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.

EmailStatus.description: Represents the status of email sent.
EmailStatus.accessRules: Customer Portal users can’t access this object.

EmailTemplate.description: Represents a template for an email, mass email, list email, or Sales Engagement email. Supported in first-generation managed packages only.
EmailTemplate.accessRules: Customer Portal users can’t access this object.

EmailTemplateMonthlyMetric.description: Represents the monthly engagement metrics for an email template.

EmbeddedServiceBranding.description: Represents EmbeddedServiceBranding metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

EmbeddedServiceConfig.description: Represents a setup node for creating an Embedded Service deployment.

EmbeddedServiceCustomComponent.description: Represents a custom component created for an Embedded Service feature.

EmbeddedServiceCustomLabel.description: Represents a customized label that appears in the embedded component for a particular Embedded Service deployment. Labels can be customized for both Embedded Chat and embedded Appointment Management (beta).

EmbeddedServiceCustomization.description: Represents a mapping between the EmbeddedServiceCustomization record parent and the EmbeddedServiceConfiguration or EmbeddedServiceMenuSettings, for a set of Embedded Service resources. Each resource is set of customizations applied via an uploaded static resource for your Embedded Chat.

EmbeddedServiceDetail.description: Represents a metadata catalog object that exposes fields from the underlying Embedded Service setup objects defined in each EmbeddedServiceConfig deployment for guest users. Guest users don’t have direct access to the Embedded Service setup objects.

EmbeddedServiceFieldService.description: Represents a setup node for creating an embedded Appointment Management (beta) deployment.

EmbeddedServiceFlow.description: Represents a Flow Definition used by an Embedded Service deployment.

EmbeddedServiceFlowConfig.description: Represents whether an Embedded Service Flow feature is enabled or not.

EmbeddedServiceLabel.description: Represents a customized label in Embedded Chat or embedded Appointment Management.

EmbeddedServiceLiveAgent.description: Represents a setup node for creating an Embedded Chat deployment.
EmbeddedServiceLiveAgent.accessRules: To access EmbeddedServiceLiveAgent, your org must have Service Cloud with Chat enabled.

EmbeddedServiceMenuItem.description: Represents the information needed to configure a Channel Menu item.

EmbeddedServiceMenuSettings.description: Represents a setup node for creating a channel menu deployment. Channel menus list the ways in which customers can contact your business.

EmbeddedServiceQuickAction.description: Represents EmbeddedServiceQuickAction metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

EmbeddedServiceResource.description: Represents a mapping from an EmbeddedServiceCustomization record parent to a set of resources. Each resource is a set of customizations applied via an uploaded static resource for your Embedded Chat.

EmissionsActivity.description: Represents a company’s emission generating activities and the greenhouse gas categories that are used to aggregate emissions for these activities.

EmissionsAllocation.description: Represents information about the emissions from a child or partner account that are allocated to an account.

EmissionsForecastFact.description: Represents information about the time periods, measures, and dimensions used to forecast the emissions of a company. The emissions forecast of the company is generated based on its business measures such as revenue or employee count, and the actual emissions data from previous years.

EmpBenefitSummary.description: Represents statistics about benefits provided to employees and the usage of benefits.

EmpUserProvisionProcessErr.description: Represents an employee-user provisioning process error.
EmpUserProvisionProcessErr.accessRules: a Workplace Command Center add-on license, or an Employee Experience add-on license

EmpUserProvisioningProcess.accessRules: a Workplace Command Center add-on license, or an Employee Experience add-on license

Employee.description: Represents an employee within a company or organization.

Employee2.description: Represents an employee within a company or an organization.

EmployeeCrisisAssessment.description: Represents a crisis assessment of an Employee.
EmployeeCrisisAssessment.accessRules: To access this object, you must be assigned a Workplace Command Center permission set license and the Provides access to Workplace Command Center features system permission.

EmployeeDemographicSum.description: Represents statistics about employees based on their demographic information, such as employee count by age group, by gender, and by region.

EmployeeDevelopmentSum.description: Represents statistics about training and development provided to upskill the employees.

Employment.description: Represents the details of an individual's employment with an organization.

EmploymentCompensationSummary.description: Represents information about stakeholder engagement to assess the importance of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) issues for them.

EmploymentOffer.description: Represents an employment offer for a selected candidate.

EmploymentOfferVettingEval.description: Represents a junction between an employment offer and a vetting evaluation of the offer recipient.

EmssnRdctnCommitment.description: Represents information about a company's commitment to reducing its carbon emissions. This commitment is in line with the Paris Agreement’s goal to achieve a low-carbon future. For example, companies sign the Business Ambition for 1.5°C commitment letter and commit to set emission reduction targets to limit temperature rise to 1.5°C above pre-industrial levels.

EmssnReductionTarget.description: Represents information about the science-based or non-science-based target set by a company to fulfill its emissions reduction commitment. This target indicates the company’s emissions reduction goal. A company’s emissions reduction goal could be to reduce carbon emissions or increase renewable energy for reaching a target metric tonnes of CO2e (tCO2e) within a specific timeframe.

EnablementMeasureDefinition.description: Represents an Enablement measure, which specifies the job-related activity that a user performs to complete a milestone or outcome in an Enablement program. A measure identifies a source object and optional related objects, with optional field filters and filter logic, for tracking the activity. This object also represents Enablement measure information in Metadata API.
EnablementMeasureDefinition.accessRules: To access this object, the Design and Deliver Enablement Programs permission is required. This permission is enabled by default as part of the Manage Enablement Essentials permission set, which comes with the Enablement add-on license.

EnablementProgram.description: Represents an Enablement program, which includes exercises and measurable milestones to help users such as sales reps achieve specific outcomes related to your company’s revenue goals.
EnablementProgram.accessRules: a supported Partner Relationship Management (PRM) add-on license

EnablementProgramDefinition.description: Represents Enablement program information in Metadata API.
EnablementProgramDefinition.accessRules: To access this object, the Design and Deliver Enablement Programs permission is required. This permission is enabled by default as part of the Manage Enablement Essentials permission set, which comes with the Enablement add-on license.

EnblMeasureObjectDefinition.description: Represents the criteria for an object that tracks the job-related activity for an Enablement measure in an Enablement program. A separate EnblMeasureObjectDefinition is used for a measure's source object and each optional related object.
EnblMeasureObjectDefinition.accessRules: To access this object, the Design and Deliver Enablement Programs permission is required. This permission is enabled by default as part of the Manage Enablement Essentials permission set, which comes with the Enablement add-on license.

EnblPgmTaskMeasureProgress.description: Represents a user’s progress through the object and field requirements that an Enablement measure defines for an outcome or milestone in an Enablement program.
EnblPgmTaskMeasureProgress.accessRules: a supported Partner Relationship Management (PRM) add-on license

EnblProgramSection.description: Represents an optional section in an Enablement program. A section can include other program items, such as milestones and exercises.
EnblProgramSection.accessRules: a supported Partner Relationship Management (PRM) add-on license

EnblProgramTaskDefinition.description: Represents an outcome, a milestone, or an exercise in an Enablement program. A program task is also known as a program item.
EnblProgramTaskDefinition.accessRules: a supported Partner Relationship Management (PRM) add-on license

EnblProgramTaskMeasure.description: Represents the connection between an Enablement measure and a specific milestone or outcome in an Enablement program.
EnblProgramTaskMeasure.accessRules: To access this object, the Design and Deliver Enablement Programs permission is required. This permission is enabled by default as part of the Manage Enablement Essentials permission set, which comes with the Enablement add-on license.

EnblProgramTaskProgress.description: Represents a user’s progress towards completing an outcome, a milestone, or an exercise in an Enablement program.
EnblProgramTaskProgress.accessRules: a supported Partner Relationship Management (PRM) add-on license

EnblProgramTaskSubCategory.description: Represents a custom exercise type that an Enablement admin adds to an Enablement program in Program Builder. A custom exercise type also requires a corresponding EnblProgramTaskDefinition record for Program Builder and corresponding LearningItem and LearningItemType records for when users take the exercise in the Guidance Center.
EnblProgramTaskSubCategory.accessRules: For Enablement admins to create, update, and delete Enablement programs, the Design and Deliver Enablement Programs permission is required. This permission is enabled by default as part of the Manage Enablement Essentials permission set, which comes with the Enablement add-on license. For users who take Enablement programs, the Take Enablement Programs permission is required. This permission is enabled by default as part of the Use Enablement Programs permission set, which comes with the Enablement add-on license.

EnergyAttrCertCredit.description: Represents information about the energy attribute certificate credits related to energy attribute certificate purchase.

EnergyAttrCertPurchase.description: Represents information about the purchase of energy attribute certificates from the clean energy project supplier. The information includes terms of engagement and the delivery type of energy attribute certificate.

EnergyAttrCreditDstr.description: Represents a junction between energy attribute credits and stationary asset energy use indicating the quantity of credits distributed for a specific energy use.

EnergyServiceAgreement.description: The services or commodities purchased by a customer, for a specified product and optionally linked to a Contract. Contracted Services can be physical goods (eg. appliances), commodity services (eg. electricity, gas or water) or other miscellaneous services (eg. homeowner insurance, boiler maintenance contract).

EnergyServiceAgreementItem.description: Represents the details of the Energy Service Agreement object such as the time, location, and pricing information.

EngagementAttendee.description: Represents information about an attendee of an engagement. For example, when a customer initiates an engagement interaction by calling a service representative to inquire about an insurance claim, this object stores information about the customer and the service representative.

EngagementChannelType.description: Represents a channel through which a customer can be reached for communication. The Engagement Channel Type object supports only the English language.

EngagementChannelWorkType.description: Represents the relationship between an Engagement Channel Type object and a Work Type object for Salesforce Scheduler.

EngagementInsightType.description: Represents the configuration for engagement insight types for voice and video call insights.

EngagementInteraction.description: Represents information about an interaction between a service representative or any other specialist in an organization and the organization’s customer. Engagement interactions can be initiated through communication channels and can cover one or more topics. For example, a customer can initiate an engagement interaction by calling a service representative to inquire about an insurance claim.

EngagementSignal.description: Represents data about an individual’s engagement action, such as a web click, an email response, or a PDF download. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

EngagementSignalCmpndMetric.description: Represents a rate metric that measures the ratio between two engagement signal metrics, such as product orders and product views to calculate a conversion rate, or email clicks and email opens to determine a click-through rate. Use this object to create complex measurements for A/B testing and web experimentation. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

EngagementSignalMetric.description: Represents a measurable quantity that’s derived from an engagement signal, such as the sum of revenue or a count of clicks. Use this object to track user engagement for A/B tests, machine learning model training, and attribution configurations. This object is available in API version 62.0 and later.

EngagementTopic.description: Represents information about the topics discussed by a customer and other attendees during an engagement. For example, when a customer initiates an engagement interaction by calling a service representative to inquire about an insurance claim, the topic of the engagement is Claim.

EnhancedLetterhead.description: Represents an enhanced letterhead that can be associated with a Lightning email template that doesn’t use the Salesforce Merge Language (SML).

EnrichedField.description: Represents a field selected for Change Data Capture Enrichment for a channel and channel member. A non-empty enriched field is added to an update or delete change event even when not changed. Available in API version 51.0 and later.
EnrichedField.accessRules: This object is part of Change Data Capture Enrichment. Use the EnrichedField object to query, retrieve, or delete enriched fields. Add an enriched field as part of PlatformEventChannelMember. For more information about Change Data Capture Enrichment and adding enriched fields, see Enrich Change Events with Extra Fields When Subscribed with CometD and Example: Add Event Enrichment Fields with Tooling API in the Change Data Capture Developer Guide. To retrieve or query this object, you must have the View Setup and Configuration permission. To delete this object, you must have the Customize Application permission.

EnrollmentEligibilityCriteria.description: Represents criteria that define patient enrollment eligibility for one or more care programs.

Entitlement.description: Represents the customer support an account or contact is eligible to receive.

EntitlementContact.description: Represents a Contact eligible to receive customer support via an Entitlement.

EntitlementTemplate.description: Represents predefined terms of customer support for a product (Product2).
EntitlementTemplate.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only Salesforce admins, users with access to the Case, Entitlement, or Work Order objects, and users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

EntityDefinition.description: Provides row-based access to metadata about standard and custom objects.

EntityHistory.description: Represents historical information about an object’s changed field values.

EntityLimit.description: Represents the limits for an object as displayed in the Setup UI.

EntityMilestone.description: Each row represents a required step in a customer support process on a work order. The Salesforce user interface uses the term object milestone.
EntityMilestone.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only Salesforce admins, users with access to the Case, Entitlement, or Work Order objects, and users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object. Entitlement management must be enabled. Work orders or Field Service must be enabled.

EntityParticle.description: Represents each element of a field that can be presented in a user interface. Contrast EntityParticle with FieldDefinition, which represents each element of a field defined in the Metadata API

EntitySubscription.description: Represents a subscription for a user following a record or another user.

EnvironmentHubMember.description: Represents a member organization in the Environment Hub.

EnvironmentalRisk.description: Represents information about the risk that the environmental resources create for an organization.

EstmtEnergyUseCriteria.description: Represents the criteria to generate estimated energy use records.

EstmtEnergyUseJobRun.description: Represents an instance of running the criteria applied to generate the estimated energy use records.

Event.description: Represents an event in the calendar. In the user interface, event and task records are collectively referred to as activities.

EventBusSubscriber.description: Represents a trigger, process, or flow that’s subscribed to a platform event or a change data capture event. Doesn’t include CometD or Pub/Sub API subscribers.
EventBusSubscriber.accessRules: EventBusSubscriber is read only and can only be queried. As of Summer ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.

EventRelation.description: Represents a person (a user, lead, or contact) or a resource (such as a conference room) invited to an event. This object lets you add or remove invitees from an event and use the API to manage invitees’ responses to invitations. If Shared Activities is enabled, EventRelation can also represent other objects that are related to an event. EventRelation does not support triggers, workflow, or data validation rules.

EventRelayConfig.description: Represents the configuration of an event relay, which relays platform events and change data capture events from Salesforce to Amazon EventBridge.
EventRelayConfig.accessRules: To retrieve or query this object, you must have the View Setup and Configuration permission. To create, update, or delete this object, you must have the Customize Application permission. You can update only the state and relayOption fields and not eventChannel or destinationResourceName. Update the state and relayOption fields through the Metadata field.

EventRelayFeedback.description: Represents execution state information about an event relay from Salesforce to Amazon EventBridge for platform events and change data capture events. Query this object to get information such as the event relay status and any error message.

EventStagedInviteeEmail.description: Represents the relationship between an event and an email address invited to the event that doesn’t match to a user, contact, or lead record. Data about the unmatched email address is represented in StagedInviteeEmail. This object represents event-related details, such as the invitee's attendance response to the event.
EventStagedInviteeEmail.accessRules: This object is available with Einstein Activity Capture when Sync Email as Salesforce Activity is turned on.

EventTag.description: Associates a word or short phrase with an Event.

EventWhoRelation.description: Represents the relationship between an event and a lead or contacts. This derived object is a filtered version of the EventRelation object; that is, IsParent is true and IsWhat is false. It doesn’t represent relationships to invitees or to accounts, opportunities, or other objects.

Examination.description: Represents information about the authorized examinations that qualify a license or permit.

Expense.description: Represents an expense linked to a work order. Service resource technicians can log expenses, such as tools or travel costs.

ExpenseReport.description: Represents a report that summarizes expenses.

ExpenseReportEntry.description: Represents an entry in an expense report.

ExplainabilityActionDef.description: Represents the explainability definition of the explainability action log that's generated by the associated application's action.

ExplainabilityActionVersion.description: Represents the explainability action version of the explainability action log that's generated by the associated application's action.

ExplainabilityMsgTemplate.description: Represents the template that contains the decision explanation message for a specified element type.

ExplainabilityMsgTemplateLocalization.description: Represents the translated value of the message in an explainability message template for an expression set step element.
ExplainabilityMsgTemplateLocalization.accessRules: the System Administrator permission set to access this object

ExprcSiteDataspcIntegInfo.description: Experience Site Dataspace Integration Information (Tooling API)
ExprcSiteDataspcIntegInfo.label: Experience Site Dataspace Integration Information

ExpressionFilter.description: Represents a logical expression that’s used to control the execution of macro instructions.

ExpressionFilterCriteria.description: Represents a condition in an expression that’s used to control the execution of macro instructions.

ExpressionSet.description: Represents information about an expression set. An expression set performs a series of calculations using lookups and user-defined variables and constants.

ExpressionSetConstraintObj.description: Represents the association between a Product object and the constraint model tags defined in a given constraint model.
ExpressionSetConstraintObj.accessRules: This object is available in orgs where Revenue Cloud is enabled.

ExpressionSetDefinition.description: Represents information about an expression set definition.

ExpressionSetDefinitionContextDefinition.description: Represents a relationship between an expression set definition and a context definition. This object is available in API version 58.0 and later.

ExpressionSetDefinitionVersion.description: Represents information about an expression set definition version.

ExpressionSetMessageToken.description: Represents a token that's used in an explainability message template. The token can be replaced with an expression set version resource that the template is used in.

ExpressionSetObjectAlias.description: Represents the alias of the source object that's used in an expression set.
ExpressionSetObjectAlias.accessRules: To use this object, users must have the Modify All Data permission, and the orgHasExpressionSet org permission.

ExpressionSetVersion.description: Represents information about a specific version of an expression set. This object is also accessible through the UI API, which enables its use in components like Lightning Web Components (LWC).

ExpressionSetView.description: Represents a virtual object that provides a consolidated view of file-based expression set. File-based expression sets are read-only templates. To be able to modify file-based expression sets, you must clone them first.

ExpsSetObjectAliasFieldVw.description: Represents the virtual object that provides a consolidated view of source object and its alias, and the source object fields and their aliases that are used in an expression set. This object is used to check the permission level required to access the underlying object fields associated with their field aliases.
ExpsSetObjectAliasFieldVw.accessRules: access to the source object, the usage type, and the field level security associated with the object field aliases in the object

ExtConvParticipantIntegDef.description: Represents the integration configuration for external conversation participants, used for communication between Salesforce and external messaging platforms.

ExtDataShare.description: Represents a data share, which is a collection of Data Cloud objects that can be shared with other Data Cloud orgs or third-party partners.

ExtDataTranFieldTemplate.description: External Data Transport Field Template (Tooling API)
ExtDataTranFieldTemplate.label: External Data Transport Field Template

ExtDataTranObjectTemplate.description: External Data Transport Object Template (Tooling API)
ExtDataTranObjectTemplate.label: External Data Transport Object Template

ExtKnowledgeConnector.description: Represents a connector to a third-party knowledge source for Unified Knowledge.
ExtKnowledgeConnector.accessRules: Knowledge must be enabled in your org. Salesforce Knowledge users, unlike customer and partner users, must also be granted the Knowledge User feature license.

External Cross-Org Callout Event Type.description: External Cross-Org Callout events represent external data callouts via the cross-org adapter for Salesforce Connect.

External Custom Apex Callout Event Type.file: objects/E/External Custom Apex Callout Event Type.json
External Custom Apex Callout Event Type.description: External Custom Apex Callout events represent external data callouts via custom adapters for Salesforce Connect.

External Data Source Callout Event Type.file: objects/E/External Data Source Callout Event Type.json
External Data Source Callout Event Type.description: External Data Source Callout events represent external data callouts via the Salesforce Connect adapters for Amazon DynamoDB and Amazon Athena.

External OData Callout Event Type.description: External OData Callout events represent external data callouts via the OData 2.0 and OData 4.0 adapters for Salesforce Connect.

ExternalAccountHierarchy.description: Represents the external account hierarchy, which works like a role-based hierarchy. Use ExternalAccountHierarchy to allow partner and customer users to share data with other external accounts in their hierarchy.
ExternalAccountHierarchy.accessRules: You must have a Partner or Customer Community Plus license.

ExternalAccountHierarchyHistory.description: Represents the history of changes to values in the fields of an external account hierarchy.
ExternalAccountHierarchyHistory.accessRules: You must have a Partner or Customer Community Plus license.

ExternalAuthIdentityProvider.description: Represents an external authentication (auth) identity provider. An external auth identity provider links to an external credential and obtains OAuth tokens for outbound callouts to external systems.
ExternalAuthIdentityProvider.accessRules: Only users with the Customize Application permission or the Manage Named Credentials permission can access this object.

ExternalAuthIdentityProviderParameter.description: External Auth Identity Provider Parameter (Tooling API)
ExternalAuthIdentityProviderParameter.label: External Auth Identity Provider Parameter

ExternalCredential.description: Represents the details of how Salesforce authenticates to the external system.

ExternalDataSource.description: Represents the metadata associated with an external data source. Create external data sources to manage connection details for integration with data and content that are stored outside your Salesforce org.
ExternalDataSource.accessRules: From API version 48.0 onwards, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.

ExternalDataSrcDescriptor.description: Contains the metadata information for the external schema of an external data source. Use the metadata to map attributes from an AWS data source, such as Amazon DynamoDB and Amazon Athena, to Salesforce external object fields. Also, use the metadata to customize the data retrieval queries to an AWS data source.

ExternalDataUserAuth.description: Stores authentication settings for a Salesforce user to access an external system. The external system must be defined in an external data source or a named credential that’s configured to use per-user authentication.

ExternalDocStorageConfig.description: Represents configuration, which admin makes in setup to specify the drive, path, and named credential to be used for storing documents on external drives.

ExternalEncryptionRootKey.description: Represents metadata about root keys stored in third-party key stores that are used to generate and secure keys that encrypt Salesforce data.

ExternalEvent.description: Holds native iOS or Android calendar event details for the Salesforce Today feature in the Salesforce mobile app.
ExternalEvent.accessRules: The Salesforce Today app is available in Salesforce for Android and Salesforce for iOS. It’s not available in the Salesforce desktop site. Access to Today is available only if you grant Calendar permission to the Salesforce mobile app.

ExternalEventMapping.description: Holds native iOS or Android calendar event details for the Salesforce Today feature in the Salesforce mobile app.
ExternalEventMapping.accessRules: The Salesforce Today app is available in Salesforce for Android and Salesforce for iOS. It’s not available in the Salesforce desktop site. Access to Today is available only if you grant Calendar permission to the Salesforce mobile app.

ExternalLearning.description: Represents information that defines a training that is made available by an external provider as a course, program, or on-site experience, for a contact.

ExternalLearningPtcpResult.description: Represents the outcome of a student's participation in an external learning.

ExternalServiceRegistration.description: Represents the external service configuration for an org.

ExternalSocialAccount.description: Represents a managed social media account on a social network such as Facebook or Twitter.

ExternalStringLocalization.description: Represents the translation of custom labels for a UI component represented by the ExternalString object. This object is available in API version 49.0 and later.

ExtlClntAppSamlPlcyCnfg.description: External Client App SAML Policy Configuration (Tooling API)
ExtlClntAppSamlPlcyCnfg.label: External Client App SAML Policy Configuration

ExtlIntrIdMapping.description: Represents a mapping between a Salesforce record and its corresponding record in an external system, such as Workday.

ExtlPtcpRsltLrnrPgmRqmt.description: Represents a junction between the External Learning Participant Result and Learner Program Requirement objects.

ExtlRecShrCnct.description: Represents authentication data to make outbound calls to and inbound calls from an external system to publish events for Partner Connect.
ExtlRecShrCnct.accessRules: To see this object, enable Partner Connect or Partner Connect for Vendors. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Partner and Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help.

ExtlRecShrCnctAccnt.description: Represents an association between an account and an external record share connection for Partner Connect.
ExtlRecShrCnctAccnt.accessRules: To see this object, enable Partner Connect or Partner Connect for Vendors. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Partner and Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help.

ExtlRecShrField.description: Represents an imported, exported, or updated external record share field for Partner Connect.
ExtlRecShrField.accessRules: To see this object, enable Partner Connect or Partner Connect for Vendors. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Partner and Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help.

ExtlRecShrFieldMap.description: Represents the external record share field mapping between the sender and receiver for Partner Connect.
ExtlRecShrFieldMap.accessRules: To see this object, enable Partner Connect or Partner Connect for Vendors. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Partner and Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help.

ExtlRecShrLead.description: Represents the Lead record of a vendor org if you’re a partner. If you’re a vendor for Partner Connect, this object represents a partner org.
ExtlRecShrLead.accessRules: To see this object, enable Partner Connect or Partner Connect for Vendors. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Partner and Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help.

ExtlRecShrObject.description: Represents a shared object for Partner Connect.
ExtlRecShrObject.accessRules: To see this object, enable Partner Connect or Partner Connect for Vendors. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Partner and Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help.

ExtlRecShrOpportunity.description: Represents the opportunity for Partner Connect in the vendor org if you’re a partner and the partner org if you’re the vendor.
ExtlRecShrOpportunity.accessRules: To see this object, enable Partner Connect or Partner Connect for Vendors. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Partner and Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help.

ExtlRecShrPcklstOptn.description: Represents a picklist option of an external record share picklist field shared between a partner and vendor for Partner Connect.
ExtlRecShrPcklstOptn.accessRules: To see this object, enable Partner Connect or Partner Connect for Vendors. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Partner and Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help.

ExtlRecShrPicklistMap.description: Represents the external record share picklist field mapping between the partner and vendor system for Partner Connect.
ExtlRecShrPicklistMap.accessRules: To see this object, enable Partner Connect or Partner Connect for Vendors. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Partner and Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help.

ExtlRecShrRecordMap.description: Represents the lead or opportunity being mapped between a partner and vendor for Partner Connect.
ExtlRecShrRecordMap.accessRules: To see this object, enable Partner Connect or Partner Connect for Vendors. See Set Up Partner Connect as a Partner and Set Up Partner Connect as a Vendor in Salesforce Help.

FSL__Time_Dependency__c.description: Represents a dependency between two service appointments. This object is used to define scheduling relationships between two appointments. It allows you to determine the order and timing in which dependent appointments should be scheduled.
FSL__Time_Dependency__c.accessRules: This object is available in orgs that have the Field Service managed package installed. Records of this object are subject to standard sharing and security settings.

FeeScheduleDefinition.description: Stores fee schedule information for contracts of Standard Care Fee Agreement types.

FeedAttachment.description: Represents an attachment to a feed item, such as a file attachment or a link. Use FeedAttachment to add various attachments to one feed item.
FeedAttachment.accessRules: You can read, create, update, or delete a FeedAttachment only if you have the corresponding access to the associated FeedItem. Inline images aren’t creatable, updatable, or deletable through SOAP API.

FeedComment.description: Represents a comment added to a feed by a user.
FeedComment.accessRules: Note the following when working with feed comments.

FeedItem.description: FeedItem represents an entry in the feed, such as changes in a record feed, including text posts, link posts, and content posts.

FeedLike.description: Indicates that a user has liked a feed item.
FeedLike.accessRules: context user has the Insert System Field Values for Chatter Feeds

FeedPollChoice.description: Shows the choices for a poll posted in the feed.

FeedPollVote.description: Shows how users voted on a poll posted in the feed.

FeedPost.description: FeedPost represents the following types of changes in a record feed, such as AccountFeed: text posts, link posts, and content posts.

FeedRevision.description: Holds the revision history of a specific feed item or comment, including a list of attributes that changed for each revision.

FeedTrackedChange.description: Represents an individual field change or set of field changes. A FeedTrackedChange is a child object of a record feed, such as AccountFeed.

FieldChangeSnapshot.description: Use this virtual object to learn which opportunities' close dates changed during the specified time period.

FieldDefinition.description: Represents a standard or custom field, providing row-based access to field metadata. Contrast FieldDefinition with EntityParticle, which represents each element of a field that can be presented in a user interface. FieldDefinition has parity with metadata type Field.

FieldHistoryArchive.description: Represents field history values for all objects that retain field history. FieldHistoryArchive is a big object, available only to users with the “Retain Field History” permission.

FieldMapping.description: Represents a mapping between fields in an object in the org and fields in a data service. A data service uses two separate field maps: one controls how the data service matches records in an object, and the other controls how the data service adds or updates data for an existing record.

FieldMappingField.description: Represents a field in an object in the org that maps to a field in a data service.

FieldMappingRow.description: Represents a field in a data service record that maps to a field in an object record in the org.

FieldPermissions.description: Represents the enabled field permissions for the parent PermissionSet.
FieldPermissions.accessRules: In API version 49.0 and later, only users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

FieldRestrictionRule.description: Represents a field visibility rule that controls whether a field is visible to a user, based on the field’s inclusion in the PersonalInfo_EPIM field set. If Enhanced Personal Information Management setting was enabled before Spring ’22, field visibility is based on the field’s compliance categorization.

FieldSecurityClassification.description: Represents a field’s data sensitivity value selected from the SecurityClassification picklist.
FieldSecurityClassification.accessRules: the Customize Application or Modify Data Classification permission

FieldServiceMobileSettings.description: Represents a configuration of settings that control the Field Service iOS and Android mobile app experience.

FieldServiceOrgSettings.description: Represents the org settings for Field Service, such as Appointment Assistant settings.

FieldSet.description: Represents FieldSet metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

FileSearchActivity.description: Represents search activity on a file.

FinAssetPortfolioTgtAlloc.description: Stores target asset allocation for a financial account, person account, or household.

FinServ AccountContactRelation Custom Fi.description: Represents the relationship between an individual (specifically the contact part of the individual) and the household (account) that the individual is a member of. AccountContactRelation is a standard object that is available through the Shared Contacts feature. Custom fields extend the AccountContactRelation standard object for use in Agentforce Financial Services.

FinServ AuthorizationForm Custom Fields.description: Represents the specific version and effective dates of a form that is associated with consent, such as a privacy policy or terms and conditions.

FinServ AuthorizationFormConsent Custom.description: Represents the date and way in which a user consented to an authorization form.

FinServ AuthorizationFormText Custom Fie.description: Represents an authorization form’s text and language settings.

FinServ_AccountAccountRelation__c.description: Represents a relationship between two accounts, such as between a household and a business account.

FinServ_Alert__c.description: Represents notifications to alert advisors about their client accounts.

FinServ_AssetsAndLiabilities__c.description: Represents assets or liabilities that are not represented in a client's financial accounts, such as real estate or collectibles.
