FinServ_BillingStatement__c.description: Represents a billing statement for an individual’s financial account.

FinServ_Card__c.description: Represents credit or debit card associated with this financial account.

FinServ_ChargesAndFees__c.description: Represents agreed-to fees and charges for servicing an individual’s financial account.

FinServ_ContactContactRelation__c.description: Represents the relationship between any two individuals.

FinServ_Employment__c.description: Represents information about an individual’s employment history.

FinServ_FinancialAccountRole__c.description: Represents the role occupied by a person or organizational entity that is involved with a financial account, such as a beneficiary or trustee.

FinServ_FinancialAccountTransaction__c.description: Represents information about a single financial account transaction.

FinServ_FinancialAccount__c.description: Represents a financial account such as an investment account, bank account, or insurance policy.

FinServ_FinancialGoal__c.description: This Financial Goal object is installed in your Agentforce Financial Services Salesforce org when you install the Agentforce Financial Services Managed Package. It represents a client’s financial goal, such as college funds or a major purchase.

FinServ_FinancialHolding__c.description: Represents a financial holding in an investment account, such as shares of stock.

FinServ_IdentificationDocument__c.description: Represents information about documents used to verify an individual’s identity.

FinServ_LifeEvent__c.description: Represents a client’s life event, such as a birth or marriage.

FinServ_PolicyPaymentMethod__c.description: Represents the premium payment method for a policy, such as credit card, debit card, or internet banking.

FinServ_ReciprocalRole__c.description: Represents the other entity’s corresponding role in a one-to-one relationship between entities.

FinServ_Revenue__c.description: Represents data from Agentforce Financial Services and external systems to aggregate revenue streams for an advisor’s book of business.

FinServ_Securities__c.description: Represents a security, such as a stock or bond.

FinancialAccount.description: Represents a financing option, such as an automotive loan or lease related to a customer.

FinancialAccountAddress.description: Represents an address related to a financial account.

FinancialAccountBalance.description: Represents the details about a financial account balance.

FinancialAccountFee.description: Represents the charges levied on a financial account

FinancialAccountMilestone.description: Represents the events in the lifecycle of a financial account.

FinancialAccountParty.description: Represents the relationship between an account or a contact and a financial account.

FinancialAccountStatement.description: Represents a periodic statement summary for a financial account.

FinancialAccountTransaction.description: Represents a single transaction related to a loan or a lease.

FinancialDeal.description: Represents the deal that the financial institution is working on.

FinancialDealAsset.description: Represents the assets included in the financial deal.

FinancialDealBid.description: Represents the bids placed by financial deal parties in the financial deal.

FinancialDealInteraction.description: Represents a junction between an interaction and a financial deal.

FinancialDealParticipant.description: Represents the user or the group with whom the deal is shared.

FinancialDealParty.description: Represents the parties, such as partners and competitors, that are involved in the deal.

FinancialDealProduct.description: Represents the products (services) offered by the bank in the deal.

FinancialGoal.description: This Financial Goal object is a standard Salesforce object. It represents a financial goal for a person account.

FinancialGoalFunding.description: The financial goal of an individual or person account that requires funding.

FinancialGoalParty.description: Represents a junction between the financial goal and the person account.

FinancialPlan.description: Represents a financial plan for a person account.

FinclAcctPtyFinclAsset.description: Represents the financial account associated with the financial asset for a specific account or contact.

FinclDealInteractionSummary.description: Represents a junction between an interaction summary and a financial deal.

FiscalYearSettings.description: Settings to define a custom or standard fiscal year for your organization. This object has a parent-child relationship with the Period object.
FiscalYearSettings.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only partner users and standard users can access this object.

FldSvcObjChg.description: Represents a change made to one of a service appointment’s tracked fields.
FldSvcObjChg.accessRules: Field Service managed package must be installed. The Track the lifecycle of service appointments setting in Setup | Field Service Settings must be enabled. The Platform Integration User must have the Manage Service Appointment Lifecycle and the View Service Appointment Lifecycle permissions. To view this object, users must have the View Service Appointment Lifecycle

FldSvcObjChgDtl.description: Represents the details of a change made to one of a service appointment’s tracked fields.
FldSvcObjChgDtl.accessRules: Field Service managed package must be installed. The Track the lifecycle of service appointments setting in Setup | Field Service Settings must be enabled. The Platform Integration User must have the Manage Service Appointment Lifecycle and the View Service Appointment Lifecycle permissions. To view this object, users must have the View Service Appointment Lifecycle

Fleet.description: Represents a group of assets used in commercial, service, or transport operations in the manufacturing industry.

FleetAsset.description: Represents the relationship between an asset and the fleet to which it belongs.

FleetParticipant.description: Represents the relationship between a fleet and a participant, such as an account, a contact, or a user.

FlexHierNodeSummary.description: Represents rollup data for a hierarchy node, including direct, child, and total aggregate values.

FlexHierVldJobRun.description: Represents an execution instance of a hierarchy validation job that includes validation requests for one or more hierarchies.

FlexHierVldJobRunItem.description: Represents the execution status and results for a specific hierarchy processed in a validation job.

FlexQueueItem.description: Represents an asynchronous Apex job in the Apex flex queue. Provides information about the job type and flex queue position of the AsyncApexJob.
FlexQueueItem.accessRules: In API version 49.0 and later, users must have the View Setup and Configuration permission to access this object.

FlexiPage.description: Represents FlexiPage metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

FlexibleHierarchy.description: Represents the structure and hierarchy of relationships among individuals or entities within an organization or between organizations.

FlexibleHierarchyNode.description: Represents a unique entity within the hierarchy, such as a company, a subsidiary, a branch unit, or an individual person.

FlexibleHierarchyNodeRela.description: Represents the type of relationship between any two nodes in an hierarchy. For instance, a parent-subsidiary relationship between companies or an individual's affiliation with a company.

Flow.description: Represents Flow metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

FlowDefinition.description: Represents FlowDefinition metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

FlowDefinitionView.description: Represents the description of a flow definition.

FlowInterview.description: Represents a flow interview. A flow interview is a running instance of a flow. This object is available in API version 32.0 and later.

FlowInterviewLog.description: Represents the logs of a screen flow interview. An interview is an instance of a running or previously run flow.
FlowInterviewLog.accessRules: By default, only users with the View All Data permission can access the logs for flows that are run by other users. To let users access other users’ flow logs, set up sharing settings with the FlowInterviewLogOwnerSharingRule object.

FlowInterviewLogEntry.description: Represents the log of a specific element that’s executed by a screen flow interview. An interview is an instance of a running or previously run flow.
FlowInterviewLogEntry.accessRules: By default, only users with the View All Data permission can access the log entries for flows that are run by other users.

FlowInterviewShare.description: Represents a sharing entry on a FlowInterview.

FlowNavMetricEventLog.description: Flow Navigation Metric event logs contain metric data for flow interviews such as total execution time, number of interviews, and number of errors.

FlowOrchestration.description: Represents the details of an orchestration definition.

FlowOrchestrationInstRelaObj.description: Represents a junction between a flow orchestration instance and a related object.

FlowOrchestrationInstance.description: Represents a run-time instance of an orchestration.
FlowOrchestrationInstance.accessRules: If sharing rules are defined for FlowOrchestrationInstance, they determine access to specific orchestration run records. Or the user must have the View All Data permission.

FlowOrchestrationLog.description: Represents logging data for a FlowOrchestrationInstance.
FlowOrchestrationLog.accessRules: If sharing rules are defined for FlowOrchestrationInstance and the Inherit orchestration run sharing rules to control orchestration run log record access setting is enabled, then orchestration run log record access is inherited from related orchestration run records. If the Inherit orchestration run sharing rules to control orchestration run log record access setting isn’t enabled, a user must have the Manage Flow permission. Or the user must have the View All Data permission.

FlowOrchestrationStageInstance.description: Represents a run-time instance of a stage in a run-time instance of an orchestration.
FlowOrchestrationStageInstance.accessRules: If sharing rules are defined for FlowOrchestrationStageInstance, they determine access to specific orchestration stage run records. Or the user must have the View All Data permission.

FlowOrchestrationStepInstance.description: Represents a run-time instance of a step in a run-time instance of a stage of a run-time instance of an orchestration.

FlowOrchestrationVersion.description: Represents the version of an orchestration.

FlowOrchestrationWorkItem.description: Represents a work item associated with a run-time instance of an interactive step in a run-time instance of an orchestration.
FlowOrchestrationWorkItem.accessRules: An assignee can see all work item records assigned to them. If sharing rules are defined for FlowOrchestrationWorkItem, they determine access to specific orchestration work item records for users other than the assignee. Or the user must have the View All Data permission.

FlowRecord.description: Represents the details of a flow. This object is available in API version 58.0 and later.

FlowRecordElement.description: Represents a single element within a flow version. This object is available in API version 58.0 and later.

FlowRecordElementOccurrence.description: Represents the execution metrics for a single element within a flow version.

FlowRecordRelation.description: Represents a relationship between a record and a flow interview. When a flow interview is paused, Salesforce uses the $Flow.CurrentRecord global variable in the flow to associate the interview with a record.

FlowRecordVersion.description: Represents the version of a flow. This object is available in API version 58.0 and later.

FlowRecordVersionOccurrence.description: Represents an instance of a recurring flow that runs on a schedule.

FlowStageRelation.description: Represents a relationship between a paused flow interview and its stages. When a flow interview is paused, Salesforce creates a FlowStageRelation record for each stage that’s set to the $Flow.CurrentStage or $Flow.ActiveStages global variable.

FlowTest.description: Represents the description of a flow test associated with a flow definition.

FlowTestResult.description: This object is reserved for internal use.

FlowTestView.description: Represents the description of a flow test associated with a flow definition.

FlowVariableView.description: Represents a variable within the flow version.

FlowVersionView.description: Represents the version of a flow definition.

Folder.description: Represents a repository for a Dashboard, Document, EmailTemplate, Macro, QuickText, or Report. Only one type of item can be contained in a folder.
Folder.accessRules: these permissions to create and manage report folders and dashboard folders: “Create Dashboard Folders” “Create Report Folders” “Create Dashboard Folders” “Create Report Folders” To use folders for macros and quick text, enable folders for these objects in Setup on the Macro Settings and Quick Text Settings pages

FolderedContentDocument.description: Represents the relationship between a parent and child ContentFolderItem in a ContentWorkspace.

ForecastingAdjustment.description: This object represents an individual forecast manager’s adjustment for a subordinate’s or child territory’s forecast via a ForecastingItem.
ForecastingAdjustment.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only standard users with the View All Forecasts or Allow Forecasting permission or delegated forecast manager status can access this object.

ForecastingColumnDefinitionLocalization.description: Represents the translated value of a custom calculated column or custom reference data column label when the Translation Workbench is enabled for your organization.

ForecastingCustomCategory.description: Represents a custom forecasting category used for forecast rollups.

ForecastingCustomData.description: Represents forecast data from external sources to display in the forecasts page. For example, risk or last year’s revenue.

ForecastingDisplayedFamily.description: Represents the table in Forecasts Settings where an admin selects the product families that users can forecast on in Lightning Experience.
ForecastingDisplayedFamily.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only standard users with the View All Forecasts or Allow Forecasting permission or delegated forecast manager status can access this object.

ForecastingFact.description: This object is read-only and links a ForecastingItem with its opportunities, such as opportunities that share the same owner or forecast category and have a closing date within the period of the forecasting item.
ForecastingFact.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only standard users with the View All Forecasts or Allow Forecasting permission or delegated forecast manager status can access this object.

ForecastingFilter.description: Represents the custom filter for including or excluding data from opportunity forecasts.
ForecastingFilter.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only standard users with the View All Forecasts permission OR Allow Forecasting permission OR delegated forecast manager status can access this object.

ForecastingFilterCondition.description: Represents the custom filter condition logic for including or excluding data from opportunity forecasts.
ForecastingFilterCondition.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only standard users with the View All Forecasts permission OR Allow Forecasting permission OR delegated forecast manager status can access this object.

ForecastingGroup.description: Represents groups used to roll up forecast totals on the forecasts page.
ForecastingGroup.accessRules: Available for forecast types created in Spring ‘24 or later and that are based on the Opportunity and Opportunity Product objects.

ForecastingGroupItem.description: Represents the value within the picklist that is specified as the forecasting group for a forecast type. For example, if you have a forecasting group that identifies the industry an opportunity is part of, this object represents the value in the the industry picklist that’s chosen to be part of the group.

ForecastingItem.description: This object is read-only used for individual forecast amounts. Users see amounts based on their perspectives and forecast roles.
ForecastingItem.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only standard users with the View All Forecasts or Allow Forecasting permission or delegated forecast manager status can access this object.

ForecastingOwnerAdjustment.description: This object represents an individual forecast user’s adjustment of their own forecast, including territory forecasts they own, via a ForecastingItem.
ForecastingOwnerAdjustment.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only standard users with the View All Forecasts or Allow Forecasting permission or delegated forecast manager status can access this object.

ForecastingQuota.description: This object represents an individual user’s or territory’s quota for a specified time period.
ForecastingQuota.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only standard users with the View All Forecasts or Allow Forecasting permission or delegated forecast manager status can access this object.

ForecastingShare.description: Represents forecasts shared between a forecast manager and a user.
ForecastingShare.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only standard users with the View All Forecasts or Allow Forecasting permission or delegated forecast manager status can access this object.

ForecastingSourceDefinition.description: Represents the object, measure, date type, and hierarchy that a forecast uses to project sales.

ForecastingSrcRecJudgment.description: Represents forecast managers’ judgment of whether they consider an opportunity-related deal to be certain to close.

ForecastingSubmission.accessRules: Available for forecast types that aren’t grouped by product family forecast.

ForecastingSubmissionItem.description: Represents the values for each forecast category in a submitted forecast.

ForecastingType.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only standard users with the View All Forecasts or Allow Forecasting permission or delegated forecast manager status can access this object.

ForecastingTypeSource.description: Represents the mapping of a forecasting source definition to a forecast type.

ForecastingTypeToCategory.description: Forecasting Type To Category Mappings - ForecastingTypeToCategory
ForecastingTypeToCategory.label: Forecasting Type To Category Mapping

ForecastingUserPreference.description: Represents the forecasting selections that a user has made, such as display options, date range, forecasting type, and currency.
ForecastingUserPreference.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only standard users with the View All Forecasts or Allow Forecasting permission or delegated forecast manager status can access this object.

FormulaFunction.description: Represents a function used when building a formula, including examples and uses.
FormulaFunction.accessRules: In API version 45.0 and later, only users with the ViewSetup and Configuration permission can access FormulaFunction or FormulaFunctionCategory.

FormulaFunctionAllowedType.description: Represents the functions that are supported in the given formula context.
FormulaFunctionAllowedType.accessRules: Only users with the ViewSetup and Configuration permission can access FormulaFunctionAllowedType.

FormulaFunctionCategory.description: Represents the category to which a formula belongs when building a formula.

FrcstCustmCatgRampRateSrc.description: Represents the total contract value used for custom bulk adjustments.

FrcstCustmzAdjustment.description: Represents an individual forecast manager’s adjustment of a subordinate’s consumption forecast.

FrcstCustmzOwnerAdjustment.description: Represents an individual forecast user’s adjustment of their own consumption forecast.

Frequently Occurring Fields.description: In addition to system fields, these fields are found on many objects.

FrgtHaulingEmssnFctr.description: Represents the emissions factors for scope 3 freight hauling.

FrgtHaulingEnrgyUse.description: Represents the energy consumption related to freight hauling.

FuelType.description: Represents information about the additional fuel types defined by a customer.

FuelTypeSustnUom.description: Represents a mapping between the additional fuel types and their corresponding unit of measure values defined by a customer.

FulfillmentAsset.description: Represents an instance of a technical product used to provide a customer asset.

FulfillmentAssetAttribute.description: Represents an attribute of a fulfillment asset.

FulfillmentAssetRelationship.description: Represents a relationship between two fulfillment assets.

FulfillmentAssetStatePeriod.description: Represents the period during which the fulfillment asset configuration is applicable.

FulfillmentFalloutRule.description: Represents the fulfillment fallout handling rule.

FulfillmentLineAttribute.description: Represents an attribute of a fulfillment order line.

FulfillmentLineRel.description: Represents a relationship between two fulfillment order lines.

FulfillmentLineSourceRel.description: Represents the relationship between a fulfillment order line and its decomposition source.

FulfillmentOrder.description: Represents a group of products, fees, and delivery charges on a single order that share the same fulfillment location, delivery method, and recipient. The FulfillmentOrderLineItems belonging to a FulfillmentOrder are associated with OrderItemSummary objects belonging to a single OrderSummary.
FulfillmentOrder.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs.

FulfillmentOrderItemAdjustment.description: Represents a price adjustment on a FulfillmentOrderLineItem. Corresponds to an OrderItemAdjustmentLineSummary associated with the corresponding OrderItemSummary.
FulfillmentOrderItemAdjustment.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs.

FulfillmentOrderItemTax.description: Represents the tax on a FulfillmentOrderLineItem or FulfillmentOrderItemAdjustment. Corresponds to an OrderItemTaxLineItemSummary.
FulfillmentOrderItemTax.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs.

FulfillmentOrderLineItem.description: Represents a product or delivery charge belonging to a FulfillmentOrder. Corresponds to an OrderItemSummary.
FulfillmentOrderLineItem.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs.

FulfillmentPlan.description: Represents a set of steps to be created to fulfill the order.

FulfillmentSourceChangeEvent.description: Notifies updates to the sources orchestrated by Dynamic Revenue Orchestrator like order product or fulfillment order product.
FulfillmentSourceChangeEvent.accessRules: This object is available in orgs with Revenue Management.

FulfillmentStep.description: Represents a task that's required to perform a certain action as part of order fulfillment. This task can be manual or automated.

FulfillmentStepDefinition.description: Represents a definition of a step that must be executed during fulfillment orchestration.

FulfillmentStepDefinitionGroup.description: Represents a set of fulfillment step definitions.

FulfillmentStepDependency.description: Represents a dependency between tasks by defining the order between a task and one that depends on it.

FulfillmentStepDependencyDef.description: Represents a dependency that must be created between two fulfillment step records.

FulfillmentStepJeopardyRule.description: Represents the duration and tolerance for the step in the fulfillment process to allow the overall tracking of rules and risks.

FulfillmentStepSource.description: Represents a link between a fulfillment step and the corresponding order lines.

FulfillmentTaskAssignmentRule.description: Represents a set of actions that assign a task to a user or queue.

FulfillmentWorkspace.description: Represents a visual designer for fulfillment plans that can have multiple step groups and their dependencies.

FulfillmentWorkspaceItem.description: Represents information about the attributes that are used in the definition for a fulfillment step group.

FulfmtAssetStatePeriodAttr.description: Represents the key-value pair of a fulfillment asset attribute applicable during a specific asset state period.

FulfmtRoutgCriteria.description: Stores individual fulfillment criteria with their metadata, actions, and activation status within a fulfillment criteria group version.

FulfmtRoutgCriteriaActnVar.description: Maps variable identifiers used in fulfillment criteria action expressions to entity fields. Stores the binding between symbolic variable names (e.g., $availableCapacity, $location) in action expression and the actual entity and field paths (e.g., Location.availableCapacity) used at runtime.

FulfmtRoutgCriteriaCond.description: Stores atomic conditions that make up fulfillment criteria logic, with globally unique identifiers.

FulfmtRoutgCriteriaGrp.description: Represents a logical grouping of rules for a specific business context, for example, Fulfillment routing and Delivery estimation.

FulfmtRoutgCriteriaGrpVer.description: Manages versioning and lifecycle states for fulfillment criteria groups, providing stable external references while supporting versioning.

FunctionConnection.description: Represents a connection between an org and Salesforce Functions.

FunctionInvocationRequest.description: Represents invocation information for a Salesforce Function.

FunctionReference.description: Represents a deployed Salesforce Function associated with an org.

FundTransferRequest.description: Represents the details of fund transfer request between two financial accounts.

FundingAward.description: Represents an award given to an individual or organization to facilitate a goal related to the funder’s mission. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.
FundingAward.accessRules: This object is available only if the Grantmaking license is enabled, Grantmaking is enabled, and the Manage Funding Awards system permission is assigned to users.

FundingAwardAmendment.description: Represents a modification to the scope or finances of a previously approved award. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.
FundingAwardAmendment.accessRules: This object is available only if the Grantmaking license is enabled, Grantmaking is enabled, and the Manage Funding Awards system permission is assigned to users.

FundingAwardParticipant.description: Represents information about a user or group of participants who have access to a funding award.

FundingAwardRequirement.description: Represents a deliverable or milestone for a funding award or funding disbursement. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.
FundingAwardRequirement.accessRules: This object is available only if the Grantmaking license is enabled, Grantmaking is enabled, and the Manage Funding Awards system permission is assigned to users.

FundingAwardRqmtSection.description: Represents a part of a funding award requirement to be completed or reviewed.

FundingDisbursement.description: Represents a payment that has been made or scheduled to be made to a funding recipient.
FundingDisbursement.accessRules: This object is available only if the Grantmaking license is enabled, Grantmaking is enabled, and the Manage Funding Awards system permission is assigned to users.

FundingOppParticipant.description: Represents information about a user or group of participants who have access to a funding opportunity.

FundingOpportunity.description: The pool of money available for distribution for a specific purpose. This object is available in API version 57.0 and later.
FundingOpportunity.accessRules: This object is available only if the Grantmaking license is enabled, Grantmaking is enabled, and the Manage Funding Awards system permission is assigned to users.

GameDefinition.description: Represents information about a game that's offered as a reward to customers and loyalty program members.

GameParticipant.description: Represents a junction between a game definition and a participant who is either an account, a contact, or a loyalty program member.

GameParticipantReward.description: Represents the reward that’s provided to a participant after they’ve played a game.

GameReward.description: The reward that’s offered to participants of a game.

GenAIConversationSummary.description: Represents a generated summary of a voice or video call.

GenAiConvDefPlanner.description: Generative AI Conversation Definition Planner (Tooling API)
GenAiConvDefPlanner.label: Generative AI Conversation Definition Planner

GenAiPlannerAttrDefinition.description: Generative AI Planner Attribute Definition (Tooling API)
GenAiPlannerAttrDefinition.label: Generative AI Planner Attribute Definition

GenAiPlannerDefinition.description: Represents an agent planner service that uses a large language model (LLM) and a reasoning strategy to decompose a given task into smaller subtasks, identify the most suitable actions for each subtask, and invoke them.

GenAiPlannerFunctionDef.description: Represents a relationship between the agent planner service and agent actions.

GenAiPlannerRuleExpr.description: Generative AI Planner Rule Expression (Tooling API)
GenAiPlannerRuleExpr.label: Generative AI Planner Rule Expression

GenAiPlannerRuleExprObject.description: Generative AI Planner Rule Expression Object (Tooling API)
GenAiPlannerRuleExprObject.label: Generative AI Planner Rule Expression Object

GenAiPluginDefinition.description: Represents an agent topic, which is a category of actions related to a particular job to be done by AI agents.

GenAiPluginFunctionDef.description: Generative AI Plugin Function Definition (Tooling API)
GenAiPluginFunctionDef.label: Generative AI Plugin Function Definition

GenAiPluginInstructionDef.description: Generative AI Plugin Instruction Definition (Tooling API)
GenAiPluginInstructionDef.label: Generative AI Plugin Instruction Definition

GenOpPlanEligibilityConfig.description: Generated Operation Plan Eligibility Configuration (Tooling API)
GenOpPlanEligibilityConfig.label: Generated Operation Plan Eligibility Configuration

GenOpPlanRequest.description: Represents a request to generate a service plan. This object is available in API version 67.0 and later.
GenOpPlanRequest.accessRules: To access this object, you must have the Service Planner Access add-on license.

GeneralLdgrAcctPrdSummary.description: Represents a junction between a general ledger account and a legal entity accounting period. Stores information about the total credit amount, total debit amount, opening balance, and closing balance of a general ledger account for a specific legal entity accounting period.
GeneralLdgrAcctPrdSummary.accessRules: Revenue Cloud Billing license and the Accounts Receivables Admin permission set to access this object

GeneralLedgerAccount.accessRules: Revenue Cloud Billing license and the Accounts Receivables Admin permission set to access this object

GeneralLedgerAcctAsgntRule.accessRules: Revenue Cloud Billing license and the Accounts Receivables Admin permission set to access this object

GeneralLedgerJrnlEntryRule.description: Represents information about the transaction journal entry rule, based on which transaction journals are created for the selected credit and debit general ledger accounts, transaction amount field, and percentage.
GeneralLedgerJrnlEntryRule.accessRules: Revenue Cloud Billing license and the Accounts Receivables Admin permission set to access this object

GeneratedWaste.description: Represents the information on the waste generated in operations, the waste generated while treating end-of-life products that were sold, and so on.

GenericVisitTask.description: Represents information about a task that can be performed during a visit.

GenericVisitTaskContext.description: Represents the context or purpose for a generic visit task.

GeoState.accessRules: The GeoState object is available if B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce is enabled.

GeolocationBasedAction.description: Represents a geolocation-based action, which is an action that’s triggered when a user enters, exits, or is within the area of the associated object.

GiftCommitmentSchedule.description: Represents the schedule for fulfilling the commitment.
GiftCommitmentSchedule.accessRules: This object is available only if the Education Cloud Full Access license or the Fundraising Access license is enabled and the Fundraising User system permission is assigned to users.

GlobalValueSet.description: Represents GlobalValueSet metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

GnrcVstKeyPerformanceInd.description: Represents the key performance indicators that can be recorded while performing a task during a visit. You can compare the expected and actual metric values with the key performance indicator records.

GnrcVstTaskContextRelation.description: Represents common attributes used for a visit task and a visit task context.

Goal.description: The Goal object represents the components of a goal such as its name, description, and status.

GoalAssignment.description: Represents the assignment of a goal.
GoalAssignment.accessRules: the Program and Benefit Management Access permission set or the Program and Benefit Management permission set license

GoalAssignmentDetail.description: Represents additional information associated with a GoalAssignment record.

GoalDefinition.description: The definition of a care plan goal in the reusable PGI library that’s a part of Integrated Care Management. When instantiated, GoalDefinition records create GoalAssignment records that serve as goals in care plans.
GoalDefinition.accessRules: In Integrated Care Management, this object represents the definition of a care plan goal in the reusable PGI library.

GoalLink.description: Represents the relationship between two goals. This is a many-to-many relationship, meaning that each goal can link to many other goals.

GoodsReceivedNote.description: Represents a record created by the buyer to confirm the delivery of goods from a supplier. It is used to verify that the received items match the purchase order. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

GoodsReceivedNoteItem.description: Represents a single line entry on the Goods Received Note (GRN) that details the receiving status of a specific product. It records the total quantity received and indicates how many units were damaged, short-delivered, or received in excess of the purchase order. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

GoogleDoc.description: Represents a link to a Google Document.
GoogleDoc.accessRules: This object is available in All Editions except Database.com for Google Apps Premier Edition accounts. See the Salesforce online help for more information.

GovtFinancialAsstSum.description: Represents information about the financial assistance received from governments.

GroundTravelEmssnFctr.description: Represents the emissions factors for scope 3 ground travel.

GroundTravelEnrgyUse.description: Represents the energy consumption related to ground travel.

Group.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only authenticated internal and external users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

GroupCensus.description: Represents a snapshot of statistics about eligible members (employees or members) of a group (employer or association) and their legal dependents. Use this entity in quoting, rating, and the subsequent enrollment process. Child object of employer or group Account.

GroupCensusMember.description: Represents personal information about a member, for example employee or association member, or their dependents. GroupCensusMember is used to estimate the insurance plan cost for the group. This object is also used in the enrollment process to retrieve the member and dependent details. Child object of GroupCensus.

GroupCensusMemberPlan.description: Represents the association of GroupCensusMember and ContractGroupPlan. Use this entity when census data includes previous member enrollment plan details and new member plan details. You can populate GroupCensusMemberPlan by reading the enrollment census in the enrollment services before creating insurance policies.

GroupClass.description: Represents the classification of group members that receive similar benefits. Example classes include executives, union, and office workers. Child object of employer or group Account.

GroupClassContribution.description: Represents employer or group contributions for GroupClass members and their dependents on a per product category such as medical, dental, or vision. Child object of GroupClass.

GroupMember.description: Represents a User or Group that is a member of a public group.

GroupMembershipEventLog.description: Group Membership events capture details about changes to public group and queue membership, such as when members are added to or removed from the public group or queue.

GtwyProvPaymentMethodType.description: Represents a type that allows integrators and payment providers to choose an active payment to receive an order's payment data rather than allowing the Salesforce Order Management platform to select a default payment method.

GuestBuyerProfile.description: Represents a store's guest buyer profile, which allows unauthenticated buyers to browse the store.

HealthCareDiagnosis.description: Represents information related to industry-standard healthcare diagnosis codes. Before the Spring ’21 release, the Healthcare Procedure and Healthcare Diagnosis objects stored codes specifically related to procedures and diagnoses. These codes were used for prior-authorization requests and approval processes. Since the Spring’21 release, Health Cloud uses the Code Set and Code Set Bundle objects for this purpose instead.

HealthCareProcedure.description: Represents information related to industry-standard healthcare procedure codes. Before the Spring ’21 release, the Healthcare Procedure and Healthcare Diagnosis objects stored codes specifically related to procedures and diagnoses. These codes were used for prior-authorization requests and approval processes. Since the Spring’21 release, Health Cloud uses the Code Set and Code Set Bundle objects for this purpose instead.

HealthScore.description: Represents a subject’s score for a specific score category.

HealthScoreActionLog.description: Represents the log of actions triggered from the Dynamic Actions for Unified Health Scoring component in the Unified Health Scoring feature.

HealthcareFacilityNetwork.description: Represents a junction object identifying the insurance network that a location or business entity is a part of. Network participation records are also stored in this object.

HealthcarePayerNetwork.description: Represents an insurance network group. For example, an insurance company’s exclusive provider organization (EPO) plans.

HealthcarePractitionerFacility.description: Represents the different locations in which a practitioner provides services.

HealthcareProvider.description: Represents business-level details about the healthcare organization or the practitioner.

HealthcareProviderNpi.description: Represents identifiers from the National Provider Identifier that are assigned to every facility and licensed practitioner in the United States. Also includes NPI assigned date, primary mailing address on file, and so on.

HealthcareProviderService.description: Represents a junction object between a HealthcareService and a HealthcareProvider or HealthcareFacility or HealthcarePractitionerFacility.

HealthcareProviderSpecialty.description: Represents specialties for a practitioner or a service provider organization. A provider can have multiple specialties such as anesthesiology and cardiovascular.

HealthcareProviderTaxonomy.description: Represents taxonomy or subspecialty codes for a practitioner or facility. A provider or facility can have multiple taxonomies.
HealthcareProviderTaxonomy.accessRules: the Provider Management Access permission set or the Provider Management permission set license

HealthcareServiceDetail.description: Represents a junction object between a CareService and a CodeSetBundle.

HeapDump.description: A complex type that represents a heap dump in an ApexExecutionOverlayResult object.

HierCondHlthCodeMapping.description: Represents how Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) codes map to condition codes for a specific year.

HierCondHlthRskAdjFctr.description: Stores the risk adjustment factor for patients and members based on the set of Hierarchical Condition Category (HCC) codes that apply to them and the status of their benefits eligibility.

HlthCareProvTreatedCondition.description: Represents a junction object between a healthcare provider, facility, or practitioner and a problem definition that's related to a health condition, such as disease or illness.

Holiday.description: Represents a period during which a service resource is unavailable for appointment scheduling. Recurring holidays are not supported in Automotive Cloud.
Holiday.accessRules: Customer Portal users can’t access this object.

HotelStayEmssnFctr.description: Represents the emissions factors for scope 3 hotel stay.

HotelStayEnrgyUse.description: Represents the energy consumption related to hotel stay.

IPAddressRange.description: Represents a range of IP addresses to include in or exclude from the specified feature.

IconDefinition.description: Represents an icon, such as used for a tab.

Idea.description: Represents an idea on which users are allowed to comment and vote, for example, a suggestion for an enhancement to an existing product or process.

IdeaComment.description: Represents a comment that a user has submitted in response to an idea.

IdeaReputation.description: Represents a collection of statistics and scores derived from a user’s activity within an Ideas zone or internal organization.

IdeaReputationLevel.description: Represents a reputation level within an Ideas zone or internal organization and is used by the system to calculate reputation. You can create up to 25 levels per zone or internal organization.

IdeaTheme.description: Represents an invitation to zone members to submit ideas that are focused on a specific topic.

IdentityDocument.description: Represents information about documents used to identify Agentforce Financial Services clients.

IdentityVerificationProcDef.description: Represents the definition of the identity verification process.

IdentityVerificationProcDtl.description: Used to configure the search function as well as the minimum number of verifiers for the identity verification process.

IdentityVerificationProcFld.description: Used to configure the questions or criteria for verifying the identity of a caller.

IdpEventLog.description: Represents the Identity Provider Event Log. This log records both problems and successes with inbound SAML or OpenID Connect authentication requests from another app provider. It also records outbound SAML responses when Salesforce is acting as an identity provider.

IframeWhiteListUrl.description: Represents a list of trusted external domains that you allow to frame your Embedded Service, Surveys, and Visualforce pages.

Image.description: Represents the details of an image.

ImpactRiskOpportunity.description: Represents an impact, risk, or opportunity that can be evaluated and scored as a part of an organization's double-materiality assessment. Also known as an IRO.

ImpactRiskOpportunityScore.description: Represents the score of an impact, risk, or opportunity for an assessment.

ImpactRiskOpportunityTopic.description: Represents a junction between an impact risk opportunity and a materiality topic.

ImpcRiskOppAssessment.description: Represents an assessment of ESG-related impacts, risks, and opportunities for an organization.

ImpcRiskOppAssessmentTopic.description: Represents a junction between an impact risk opportunity assessment and a materiality topic.

InStoreLocation.description: Create locations within a retail store’s layout such as aisles, shelves, or backrooms.

Incident.description: An Incident is any unplanned business interruption that has wide-sweeping impacts and requires an urgent fix. This object contains the details of the incident, documenting the history of the incident from registration to closure.

IncidentRelatedItem.description: Represents a junction object that relates an Incident to an Asset or Product.

Index.description: Represents Index metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

IndexField.description: Represents IndexField metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

IndexRate.description: Represents a base rate that’s defined by an authority.

IndicatorAssignment.description: Represents the assignment of an indicator definition that's used to measure the performance of an outcome or a related activity.

IndicatorDefinition.description: Represents information about the indicator assignment and the process of measuring and calculating the indicator results.

IndicatorPerformancePeriod.description: Represents information about a specified time period including the frequency at which indicator results should be calculated and the baseline value of the indicator.

IndicatorResult.description: Represents the result of an indicator assignment for the specified time period that can be used to track the performance of the indicator.

Individual.description: Represents a customer’s data privacy and protection preferences. Data privacy records based on the Individual object store your customers’ preferences. Data privacy records are associated with related leads, contacts, person accounts, and users.
Individual.accessRules: This object is available if Data Protection and Privacy is enabled.

IndividualApplication.description: Represents an application form submitted by an individual or organization.

IndividualApplicationItem.description: Captures individual application input data that is used during run-time.

IndividualApplicationTask.description: Represents a task related to an application.
IndividualApplicationTask.accessRules: This object is accessible only when the Grantmaking license is on, Grantmaking is active, Compliant Data Sharing is on, and users have the Managed Funding Awards system permission.

IndividualApplnParticipant.description: Represents information about a user or group of participants who have access to a individual application.

IndividualHistory.description: Represents the history of changes to values in the fields of a data privacy record, based on the Individual object.
IndividualHistory.accessRules: This object is available if Data Protection and Privacy is enabled. The Individual object isn’t available to Customer Community, Partner Community, and Customer Portal users.

IndividualShare.description: Represents a list of access levels to a data privacy record along with an explanation of the access level. For example, if you have access to a record because you own it, the IndividualAccessLevel is All and RowCause is Owner.
IndividualShare.accessRules: This object is available if Data Protection and Privacy is enabled. The Individual object isn’t available to Customer Community, Partner Community, and Customer Portal users.

InflationRate.description: Represents the inflation rates that are used to adjust currency values from one year to another.

InfoAuthRequestForm.description: Tracks the individual Authorization Form Texts that belong to an Authorization Request. For example, consent on GDPR privacy policy document and consent on mortgage loan rate lock fee document.
InfoAuthRequestForm.accessRules: To grant community users access to InfoAuthRequestForm records, from Setup, go to Sharing Settings and set the Info Authorization Request object's default internal and external access to Private.

InfoAuthorizationRequest.description: Tracks a request for authorization on a Data Use Purpose. For example, consent request to share the documents required to open a financial account and share loan rate lock disclosure to the external customer.

InfoLibraryExternalDocument.description: Represents the external document that's used to collaborate on Information Library content.

InformationVerification.description: Represents the details of the information verification initiated for an object.

InsPlcyCoverageSpecConfig.description: Insurance Policy Coverage Specification Configuration (Tooling API)
InsPlcyCoverageSpecConfig.label: Insurance Policy Coverage Specification Configuration

InsPlcyLimit.description: Represents the data that's used as a base to track the insurance policy consumption.

InsPlcyLimitTracking.description: Represents the calculated values based on the consumption of the policy and coverage attributes during claims processing.

InsPlcyLineOfBusConfig.description: Insurance Policy Line Of Business Configuration (Tooling API)
InsPlcyLineOfBusConfig.label: Insurance Policy Line Of Business Configuration

InsPolicyAssetAttribute.description: Represents attributes for insurance policy asset.

InsPolicyAssetRelatedObj.description: Represents the relationship between an Insurance Policy Asset and a related object. The values of the attributes from the related object are referenced by the relevant product attributes on Insurance Policy Asset.

InsPolicyBillingInfo.description: Stores information related to billing and supports billing workflows and integration with downstream financial systems.

InsPolicyCoverageAttribute.description: Represents attributes for insurance policy coverage.

InsPolicyCvrRelatedObj.description: Represents the relationship between an Insurance Policy Coverage and a related object. The values of the attributes from the related object are referenced by the relevant product attributes on Insurance Policy Coverage.

InsPolicyParticipantAttr.description: Represents attributes for insurance policy participant.

InsPolicyPtcpRelatedObj.description: Represents the relationship between an Insurance Policy Participant and a related object. The values of the attributes from the related object are referenced by the relevant product attributes on Insurance Policy Participant.

InsPolicyRelatedObject.description: Represents the relationship between an Insurance Policy and a related object. The values of the attributes from the related object are referenced by the relevant product attributes on Insurance Policy.

InsPolicyTransactionDetail.description: Represents the details of an insurance policy transaction.

InsRatePlanCmsnConfig.description: Insurance Rate Plan Commission Configuration (Tooling API)
InsRatePlanCmsnConfig.label: Insurance Rate Plan Commission Configuration

InsRatePlanTypeConfig.description: Insurance Rate Plan Type Configuration (Tooling API)
InsRatePlanTypeConfig.label: Insurance Rate Plan Type Configuration

Insecure External Assets Event Type.description: Insecure External Assets events contain information about external assets. External assets include images or videos accessed by users over an insecure HTTP protocol. The event lists all your Salesforce pages that contain assets hosted insecurely on third-party sites that users loaded with a Chrome, Firefox, Microsoft Edge, or Safari browser. The INSECURE_URI field contains the URI being used to load the asset insecurely.

InspectionAssessmentInd.description: Represents the assessment indicators recorded during an inspection.

InspectionType.description: Represents the type of inspections related to a permit or license.

Insufficient Access Event Type.description: Insufficient Access events contain details about errors relating to insufficient account, case, contact, and opportunity record access, so that you can troubleshoot and resolve access issues for your users.

InsufficientAccessEventLog.description: Insufficient Access event logs contain details about errors relating to insufficient account, case, contact, and opportunity record access.

InsuranceClaimAsset.description: A junction object that associates the Claim object with the InsurancePolicyAsset object. You see this object only if you have enabled the Use Many-to-Many Relationships org pref.

InsuranceContract.description: Represents insurance-specific contract information. Extension of Contract object, specifically for the insurance industry.

InsurancePolicy.description: Represents the type of insurance policy, such as auto, home, life, or annuity.

InsurancePolicyAsset.description: Represents the customer property insured through the insurance policy.

InsurancePolicyCoverage.description: A junction object that associates the InsurancePolicy object with the ProductCoverage object.

InsurancePolicyMemberAsset.description: A junction object that associates the InsurancePolicyAsset object with the InsurancePolicyParticipant object. You see this object only if you’ve enabled the Use Many-to-Many Relationships org pref.

InsurancePolicyParticipant.description: A junction object that associates the InsurancePolicy object with the Account object. This object represents the participants of an insurance policy. Insurance policy participants include policy owners and beneficiaries.

InsurancePolicySurcharge.description: Represents the charges calculated for an insurance policy and its related assets, coverages, and participants in a region.

InsurancePolicyTransaction.description: Represents a transaction related to a change that affects the premium of an insurance policy, such as an endorsement, renewal, or cancellation.

InsuranceProfile.description: Represents the insurance-related attributes for the insured member.

IntakeFormSection.description: Represents a section of an intake form such as a job application, a complaint, or a referral.

IntakeFormSectionPtcp.description: Represents information about a user or group of participants who have access to an intake form section.

IntegrationProviderAttr.description: Represents information about the attributes that are used in the definition for an integration provider.

IntegrationProviderDcsnRqmt.description: Represents a decision requirement used to create integration provider records.

IntegrationProviderDef.description: Represents the definition that's applicable to an integration provider.

IntegrationProviderExecution.description: Represents the execution instance of an integration provider.

Interaction.description: Represents an interaction (phone call, in-person meeting, or video conference) between two or more people (attendees), typically including at least one representative and one customer or partner.

InteractionAttendee.description: Represents an attendee of an interaction.

InteractionParticipant.description: Represents a user or User Group with whom the interaction is shared.

InteractionRelatedAccount.description: Represents a junction between an interaction and account that's related to that interaction.

InteractionSumDiscussedAccount.description: Represents information about the companies discussed in an interaction.

InteractionSummary.description: Represents the summary of an interaction, including confidentiality information.

InteractionSummaryParticipant.description: Represents a user with whom an interaction summary is shared.

InternalOrganizationUnit.description: Represents an organization that an Employee belongs to.
InternalOrganizationUnit.accessRules: To access this object, you have either a Workplace Command Center permission set license and the Provides access to Workplace Command Center features system permission, or the Employee Management and Employee User add-on licenses. This object is also available with the Referral Marketing license.

InteropTopic.description: Represents the interoperability topic for which notifications are sent to subscribers.

InteropTopicDetail.description: Represents the details of an interoperability topic.

InteropTopicFilter.description: Represents the properties by which an interoperability topic's notification can be filtered.

InteropTopicNtfcnResource.description: Represents the notification resource for an interoperability topic.

InteropTopicSubcrFilter.description: Represents the subscriber's criteria for filtering the interoperability topic subscription event.

InteropTopicSubcrParameter.description: Represents the parameters added to an interoperability topic subscription.

InteropTopicSubscription.description: Represents a subscription to an interoperability topic.

InteropTopicSubscriptionDtl.description: Represents the details of an interoperability topic subscription.

InteropTopicTriggerCriteria.description: Represents the criteria that trigger a notification for an interoperability topic.

InvBatchDraftToPostedRun.description: Represents information about the batch job that posts all invoices with the status as Draft that are generated by the invoice batch run associated with the billing schedule.

InvItemInstanceReservation.description: Represents the inventory reservation for a specific item instance for a given item reservation source.

InventoryBatchItemReservation.description: Represents the inventory reservation for a specific product batch associated with a given item reservation source.

InventoryCntProdtBatchItem.description: Represents the inventory count of a batch of a product at a location.

InventoryCntSerializedProdt.description: Represents a serialized product in an inventory count.

InventoryCountAssessment.description: Represents an inventory count performed at a location.

InventoryCountPlan.description: Represents a plan to count inventory at a location.

InventoryCountPlanItem.description: Represents a product in an inventory plan. Inventory Count Plan Item is the child object of Inventory Count Plan.

InventoryCountProductItem.description: Represents the inventory count of a product at a location. Inventory Count Product Item is a child object of Inventory Count.

InventoryItemReservation.description: Used to store inventory item reservation information for a specific product and location.

InventoryReplenishmentPolicy.description: Represents a policy for replenishing inventory when the inventory quantity reaches a minimum level.

InventoryReservation.description: Stores information about the status of cart inventory reservations in B2B and D2C Commerce.

InvocableActionEventLog.description: Invocable Action events capture the calls to Salesforce Invocable Actions. This is particularly useful to monitor actions invoked during Agentforce flows.

InvocableActionExtTgtAttr.description: Invocable Action Extension Target Attribute (Tooling API)
InvocableActionExtTgtAttr.label: Invocable Action Extension Target Attribute

InvocableActionExtension.description: Represents an extension to an invocable action in Salesforce. This object is available in API version 65.0 and later.

Invoice.description: Represents information about a financial document describing the total amount a buyer must pay for provided products or services.

InvoiceAddressGroup.description: Represents the storage of the buyer's address information.

InvoiceBatchRun.description: Represents a batch processing job in Billing. During an invoice batch run, all billing schedules that meet the specified criteria are processed, resulting in the generation of invoices.
InvoiceBatchRun.accessRules: the Billing Admin permission set to access this object

InvoiceBatchRunCriteria.description: Represents a batch processing job and its required criteria in Billing. During an invoice batch run, all billing schedules that meet the specified criteria are processed, resulting in the generation of invoices.
InvoiceBatchRunCriteria.accessRules: the Billing Admin permission set to access this object

InvoiceBatchRunRecovery.description: Represents information about the recovery procedure of an invoice batch run.
InvoiceBatchRunRecovery.accessRules: the Billing Admin permission set to access this object

InvoiceDocument.description: Represents the PDF document generated for an invoice.
InvoiceDocument.accessRules: Billing Admin permission set or the Billing Operations

InvoiceErrorDetailEvent.description: Represents information about the errors that occurred during the processing of a /commerce/billing/invoices request. This object is included in an InvoiceProcessedEvent platform event message. You can't subscribe to InvoiceProcessedEvent platform event directly.
InvoiceErrorDetailEvent.accessRules: This object is available when Billing is enabled.

InvoiceLine.description: Represents the amount that a buyer must pay for a product, service, or fee. Invoice lines are created based on the amount of an order line.
InvoiceLine.accessRules: the Billing Admin permission set to access this object

InvoiceLineRelationship.description: Represents a relationship between invoice line items to support bundles where one parent invoice line has multiple child invoice lines.
InvoiceLineRelationship.accessRules: the Billing Admin permission set to access this object

InvoiceLineTax.description: Represents tax information of an invoice line of type Tax.
InvoiceLineTax.accessRules: the Tax Admin permission set to access this object

InvoiceProcessedDetailEvent.description: Represents the notification to customers regarding the results of an attempt to create an invoice from billing schedules as part of /commerce/billing/invoices request. The InvoiceProcessedDetailEvent platform event contains the results of an attempt to create an invoice from one or more billing schedules that share a grouping key. Each InvoiceProcessedDetailEventplatform event for an action is grouped within the parent InvoiceProcessedDetailEvent platform event.
InvoiceProcessedDetailEvent.accessRules: This object is available when Billing is enabled.

InvolvementGroup.description: Represents an involvement group in an institution.

InvolvementGroupMember.description: Represents a member in an institution's involvement group.

JobApplnSearchableField.description: Represents searchable data for job applications, enabling criteria-based search and filtering to find applications that match the user-specific criteria.

JobExpenseType.description: Represents a unique expense type associated with a standard job in an organization, which is used to measure the job costs and budget.

JobPosition.description: Represents an instance of employment in a particular position in the organization.

JobPositionPayGrade.description: Represents a junction between a job position and a position pay grade.

JobPositionQualification.description: Represents qualification required for a specific job position. For example, Data Visualization for a Program and Management Analyst position.

JobPostingSearchableField.description: Object used for searching and Filtering published Job Postings.

JobProfile.description: Represents a job profile used for shift scheduling.
JobProfile.accessRules: Field Service or Workforce Engagement must be enabled.

JobProfileQueueGroup.description: JobProfileQueueGroup defines the mapping between Queue and JobProfile and configurations for capacity plans in Workforce Engagement.

JobPstnRecruitmentRqs.description: Represents a junction between a job position and a recruitment requisition.

JournalReason.description: Represents a view that specifies the reason for the action that created a transaction journal.

JournalSubType.description: Represents the subcategory of transaction journal.

KeywordList.description: Represents KeywordList metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

Knowledge Article View Event Type.description: Knowledge Article View events contain user activity with your knowledge base.

KnowledgeArticle.description: Provides read-only access to an article and the ability to delete the primary article.
KnowledgeArticle.accessRules: Knowledge must be enabled in your org. A user must have the View Articles permission enabled. Salesforce Knowledge users, unlike customer and partner users, must also be granted the Knowledge User feature license.

KnowledgeArticleEventLog.description: Knowledge Article View event logs contain user activity with your knowledge base.

KnowledgeArticleFeedback.description: Represents information about feedback from users on Knowledge articles and details about assignment of feedback to the article owner or team to take action.
KnowledgeArticleFeedback.accessRules: Knowledge must be enabled in your org. A user must have the View Articles permission enabled. Salesforce Knowledge users, unlike customer and partner users, must also be granted the Knowledge User feature license. Knowledge Article Feedback Org Preference should also be enabled.

KnowledgeArticleVersion.description: Provides a global view of standard article fields across all types of articles depending on their version.
KnowledgeArticleVersion.accessRules: Knowledge must be enabled in your org. A user must have the View Articles permission enabled. Salesforce Knowledge users, unlike customer and partner users, must also be granted the Knowledge User feature license.

KnowledgeArticleVersionHistory.description: Enables read-only access to the full history of an article.
KnowledgeArticleVersionHistory.accessRules: Knowledge must be enabled in your org. This object respects field, entity, and record-level security. You must have at least “Read” permission on the article type or the field to access its history. For data category security, Salesforce determines access based on the categorization of the online version of an article. If there’s no online version, then security is applied based on the archived version, followed by the security of the draft version.

KnowledgeArticleViewStat.description: Provides certain statistics related to the number of views for the specified article across all article types.
KnowledgeArticleViewStat.accessRules: Knowledge must be enabled in your org. Users must have access to the published and archived versions of an article to retrieve its views. For more information on published and archived article versions, see the PublishStatus field in KnowledgeArticleVersion.

KnowledgeArticleVoteStat.description: Provides the weighted rating for the specified article on a scale of 1 to 5 across all article types.
KnowledgeArticleVoteStat.accessRules: Knowledge must be enabled in your org. Users must have access to the published version of an article to retrieve its votes. For more information on published article version, see the PublishStatus field in KnowledgeArticleVersion

Knowledge__DataCategorySelection.description: Represents a data category that classifies an article
Knowledge__DataCategorySelection.accessRules: Lightning Knowledge must be enabled in your org.

Knowledge__Feed.description: Represents the feed for a knowledge article.
Knowledge__Feed.accessRules: Lightning Knowledge must be enabled in your org.

Knowledge__ka.description: Provides access to the concrete object that represents a Knowledge article, the parent object for article versions.
Knowledge__ka.accessRules: Lightning Knowledge must be enabled in your org. A user must have the View Articles permission enabled. Salesforce Knowledge users, unlike customer and partner users, must also be granted the Knowledge User feature license.

Knowledge__kav.description: Provides access to the concrete object that represents a Knowledge article version.
Knowledge__kav.accessRules: Lightning Knowledge must be enabled in your org. A user must have the View Articles permission enabled. Salesforce Knowledge users, unlike customer and partner users, must also be granted the Knowledge User feature license.

KnowledgeableUser.description: Represents a user identified as knowledgeable about a specific topic, and ranks them relative to other knowledgeable users.

LaborUnion.description: Represents the labor union organization that field technician is associated with. This association decides the wage classification, pay type, overtime code, supplemental compensation and wage calculation rules.

LandingPage.description: Represents an Account Engagement landing page. A landing page is a web page that a visitor reaches after clicking a link or advertisement. Landing pages can be created in Account Engagement and synced to Salesforce or created on the Landing Page object in Account Engagement Lightning App.

LeadCleanInfo.description: Stores the metadata Data.com Clean uses to determine a lead record’s clean status. Helps you automate the cleaning or related processing of lead records.

LeadDailyMetric.description: Represents the daily engagement metrics for a lead.

LeadLineItem.description: Represents items such as vehicles, accessories, and parts that a lead is interested in.

LeadMonthlyMetric.description: Represents the monthly engagement metrics for a lead.

LeadPreferredSeller.description: Represents the relationship between a lead and the dealer account that the lead selects, or the relationship between a lead and the account that provides the lead.

LeadShare.description: Represents a sharing entry on a Lead.
LeadShare.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only users with access to the Lead object can access this object.

LeadStatus.description: Represents the status of a Lead record, such as Open, Qualified, or Converted.

LeadTag.description: Associates a word or short phrase with a Lead.

LearnerPathway.description: Represents the learner's planned path to completion of their enrolled learning programs.

LearnerPathwayItem.description: Represents a requirement with completion details in the Learner Pathway.

LearnerProfile.description: Represents information about a learner's profile.

LearnerProgram.description: Represents details of a Learning Program Plan that's created for a learner.
LearnerProgram.accessRules: These fields are available only if United Kingdom Compliance and Configuration is turned on.

LearnerProgramRequirement.description: Represents details of the requirement that a learner is required to complete in their assigned Learning Program Plan.

LearnerProgramRqmtProgress.description: Represents information about the progress of a requirement that a learner is required to complete as a part of the assigned program plan.

Learning.description: Represents information that defines a training that can be made available as a course, program, or on-site experience, for a contact.

LearningAchievement.description: Represents information about the outcome of a learning activity.

LearningAchievementConfig.description: Represents the mapping details between a Learning Achievement type and a Learning Achievement record type.

LearningContent.description: Represents a Trailhead or enablement site (myTrailhead) module assigned to a user in Workforce Engagement or Learning Paths. This object also represents a Trailhead module or video in an Enablement program exercise.
LearningContent.accessRules: Workforce Engagement license. The user must have at least one Workforce Engagement

LearningCourse.description: Represents information about a course that’s required in a learning framework.
LearningCourse.accessRules: These fields are available only if United Kingdom Compliance and Configuration is turned on.

LearningEquivalency.description: Represents the details of the equivalency between external and internal learnings.

LearningEquivalencyLearning.description: Represents a junction between a learning equivalency and a learning. Use this object to filter learning equivalencies by learning.

LearningEqvAchvMapping.description: Represents the mapping between a learning equivalency, internal achievement group, and external achievement group.

LearningFoundationItem.description: Represents information about the prerequisite, co-requisite, or the recommended learning that’s required for a learning outcome.

LearningItem.description: Represents an item that requires users to take action, including a Learning Paths entry, an Enablement program, or an exercise with linked content in an Enablement program. For Learning Paths, users are assigned a learning item to complete. For Enablement programs and exercises, users are assigned a program or can self-enroll in shared programs.
LearningItem.accessRules: a supported Partner Relationship Management (PRM) add-on license

LearningItemAssignment.description: Represents the assignment of a Learning Paths entry to users or groups or the enrollment of an Enablement program for a specific user.
LearningItemAssignment.accessRules: a supported Partner Relationship Management (PRM) add-on license

LearningItemProgress.description: Represents the progress that a user has made towards completing an assigned learning item, such as a Learning Paths entry or Enablement program.
LearningItemProgress.accessRules: a supported Partner Relationship Management (PRM) add-on license

LearningItemSubmission.description: Represents a link to a resource, such as a video recording, that a user submits as part of a Feedback Request exercise in an Enablement program. For peer and manager feedback, this resource can be a recording of a user’s sales patch. For Einstein Coach feedback, this resource can be a video call, and Einstein generates feedback from the call’s transcription.
LearningItemSubmission.accessRules: A learning item submission record is created when users take an Enablement program that includes a Feedback Request exercise for peer and manager feedback.

LearningItemType.description: Represents a custom exercise type that an Enablement user takes in an Enablement program in the Guidance Center. A custom exercise type also requires a corresponding LearningItem record for the Guidance Center and corresponding EnblProgramTaskDefinition and EnblProgramTaskSubCategory records for when admins create a program in Program Builder.
LearningItemType.accessRules: For Enablement admins to create, update, and delete Enablement programs, the Design and Deliver Enablement Programs permission is required. This permission is enabled by default as part of the Manage Enablement Essentials permission set, which comes with the Enablement add-on license. For users who take Enablement programs, the Take Enablement Programs permission is required. This permission is enabled by default as part of the Use Enablement Programs permission set, which comes with the Enablement add-on license.

LearningOutcomeItem.description: Represents information about the mapping between the learnings and the related outcome.

LearningPathwayTemplate.description: Represents a template that a learner can apply to create a planned learning path.

LearningPathwayTemplateItem.description: Represents a requirement with completion details in the Learning Pathway Template.

LearningPathwayTmplPgmPlan.description: Represents a junction between Learning Program Plan and Learning Pathway Template objects.

LearningPractice.description: Represents a Feedback Request exercise in an Enablement program. Users can submit a sample of their work and request feedback from their peers and managers. Or, users can submit a video call and Einstein Coach generates feedback from the call’s transcription.
LearningPractice.accessRules: For Enablement admins to create, update, and delete Enablement programs, the Design and Deliver Enablement Programs permission is required. This permission is enabled by default as part of the Manage Enablement Essentials permission set, which comes with the Enablement add-on license. For users who take Enablement programs, the Take Enablement Programs permission is required. This permission is enabled by default as part of the Use Enablement Programs permission set, which comes with the Enablement add-on license. To access exercises that use Einstein Coach, the Use Einstein Coach permission is required. This permission is enabled by default as part of the Access Einstein Coach permission set, which comes with the Enablement add-on license.

LearningProgram.description: Represents information about one or more trainings in a program that’s required to obtain a credential.
LearningProgram.accessRules: These fields are available only if United Kingdom Compliance and Configuration is turned on.

LearningProgramPlan.description: Represents details of a plan that’s created to execute a Learning Program.

LearningProgramPlanRqmt.description: Represents information about the requirements of a learning outcome that’s included in the learning program plan.

LearningRule.description: Represents a junction between the Learning and Rule (Expression Set) objects for an extensible rule on a learning.

LegalEntity.description: Represents the way an organization is structured. An organization can be a single legal entity or it can comprise more than one legal entity.
LegalEntity.accessRules: the Accounts Receivables Admin permission set to access this object

LegalEntyAccountingPeriod.description: Represents a junction between a legal entity and an accounting period.
LegalEntyAccountingPeriod.accessRules: the Accounts Receivables Admin permission set to access this object

LicenseDefinitionCustomPermission.description: Represents a licensed custom permission that controls access to a license's features when included in a custom permission set license definition.

LicenseDefinitionCustomPermission (Devel.description: Represents a licensed custom permission that controls access to a license's features when included in a custom permission set license definition.

Lightning Error Event Type.description: Lightning Error events represent errors that occurred during user interactions with Lightning Experience and the Salesforce mobile app.

Lightning Interaction Event Type.description: Lightning Interaction events track user actions in Lightning Experience and the Salesforce mobile app, such as the user clicking, tapping, or scrolling on a page.

Lightning Logger Event Type.description: Lightning Logger events contain information from observed Lightning component logs. This event type is available in the EventLogFile object in API version 58.0 and later.

Lightning Page View Event Type.description: Lightning Page View events represent information about the page on which the event occurred in Lightning Experience and the Salesforce mobile app, such as the page's load time.

Lightning Performance Event Type.description: Lightning Performance events track trends in Lightning Experience and Salesforce mobile app performance.

LightningComponentBundle.description: Represents LightningComponentBundle metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

LightningComponentResource.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.

LightningErrorEventLog.description: Lightning Error events represent errors that occurred during user interactions with Lightning Experience and the Salesforce mobile app.

LightningExitByPageMetrics.description: Represents frequency metrics about the standard pages within which users switched from Lightning Experience to Salesforce Classic.

LightningExperienceTheme.description: Represents information for a theme in Lightning Experience.

LightningLoggerEventLog.description: Lightning Logger Event Log provides information from observed Lightning component logs.
