LightningOnboardingConfig.description: Represents the feedback provided when users switch from Lightning Experience to Salesforce Classic. Admins can customize the question, how frequently the form appears, and where the feedback is stored in Chatter from the Adoption Assistance page in Lightning Experience Setup.

LightningOutApp.description: Represents a Lightning Out 2.0 application. With a Lightning Out 2.0 app, you can embed Lightning web components (LWC) into external applications.

LightningOutAppComponent.description: Lightning Out App Host Page (Tooling API)
LightningOutAppComponent.label: Lightning Out App Host Page

LightningOutAppHost.description: Lightning Out App Host Page (Tooling API)
LightningOutAppHost.label: Lightning Out App Host Page

LightningPageViewEventLog.description: Lightning Page View event logs represent information about the page on which the event occurred in Lightning Experience and the Salesforce mobile app. A Lightning Page View event log tracks the page a user visited, how long the user spent on the page, and the load time for the page.

LightningPrfmEventLog.description: Lightning Performance events track trends in Lightning Experience and Salesforce mobile app performance.

LightningToggleMetrics.description: Represents users who switched from Lightning Experience back to Salesforce Classic.

LightningUsageByAppTypeMetrics.description: Represents number of users on Lightning Experience and Salesforce Mobile.

LightningUsageByBrowserMetrics.description: Represents Lightning Experience usage grouped by user’s browser.

LightningUsageByFlexiPageMetrics.description: Represents custom pages users viewed most frequently in Lightning Experience.

LightningUsageByPageMetrics.description: Represents standard pages users viewed most frequently in Lightning Experience.

LinkedArticle.description: Represents a knowledge article that is attached to a work order, work order line item, or work type.
LinkedArticle.accessRules: the Knowledge article and the parent record linked to it can access this object

LinkedArticleFeed.description: Represents the comment feed on a linked article.
LinkedArticleFeed.accessRules: Knowledge must be enabled in your org.

LinkedArticleHistory.description: Represents the history of changes made to tracked fields on a linked article.
LinkedArticleHistory.accessRules: Knowledge must be enabled in your org.

ListEmail.description: Represents a list email sent from Salesforce, or sent from Account Engagement and synced to Salesforce. When the list email is sent, the recipients are generated by combining recipients in ListEmailIndividualRecipients and ListEmailRecipientSource. Duplicate and other invalid recipients are removed. The result is the recipients sent any given list email. ListEmail has a one-to-many relationship with ListEmailRecipientSource and ListEmailIndividualRecipient.

ListEmailIndividualRecipient.description: For a list email in Salesforce, represents a recipient. Each record represents a link from a list email to exactly one recipient for that list email. Recipients can be contacts, leads, or campaign members. Has a one-to-many relationship with ListEmail.

ListEmailMonthlyMetric.description: Represents the monthly engagement metrics for a single list email.

ListEmailRecipientSource.description: For a list email in Salesforce, represents the dynamically defined sources of recipient email addresses. Each record represents a link to a single list view or campaign that is examined when the list email is sent. Has a one-to-many relationship with ListEmail.

ListEmailSentResult.description: Represents the results of a list email sent from Salesforce, or sent from Account Engagement and synced to Salesforce. It contains transport headers and information specific to the associated send action.

ListView.description: Represents a list view. A list view shows a set of records for an object, based on specific criteria.

ListViewChart.description: Represents a graphical chart that’s displayed on Salesforce for Android, iOS, and mobile web list views. The chart aggregates data that is filtered based on the list view that’s currently displayed.

ListViewChartInstance.description: Retrieves metadata for all standard and custom charts for a given entity in context of a given list view.

LiveAgentSession.description: This object is automatically created for each Chat session and stores information about the session.

LiveAgentSessionHistory.description: This object is automatically created for each Chat session and stores information about changes made to the session.

LiveAgentSessionShare.description: This object is automatically created for each Chat session and stores information about the session.

LiveChatBlockingRule.description: Represents a rule for blocking chat visitors’ IP addresses from starting new chats with agents.
LiveChatBlockingRule.accessRules: To create a new rule, you must be logged in with the “Customize Application” permission or as a system administrator.

LiveChatButton.description: Represents a button that allows visitors to request chats with Chat users.

LiveChatButtonDeployment.description: Associates an automated chat invitation with a specific deployment.

LiveChatButtonSkill.description: Represents all the skills available to a LiveChatButton except the one currently assigned. To retrieve the skill currently assigned, query LiveChatButton.

LiveChatDeployment.description: Represents the general settings for deploying Live Agent on a website.

LiveChatObjectAccessConfig.description: Represents the action you can perform on a specified object by the Chat API.
LiveChatObjectAccessConfig.accessRules: To access this object, enable Chat. To see the list of objects you can find or create in the UI using this API, enable the "Turns on findOrCreate in chat API" permission. You can find this permission in the Chat Settings page of the Setup UI.

LiveChatObjectAccessDefinition.description: Represents the parent record for one or more LiveChatObjectAccessConfig objects.
LiveChatObjectAccessDefinition.accessRules: To access this object, enable Chat. To see the list of objects you can find or create in the UI using this API, enable the "Turns on findOrCreate in chat API" permission. You can find this permission in the Chat Settings page of the Setup UI.

LiveChatSensitiveDataRule.description: Represents a rule for masking or deleting data of a specified pattern. Written as a regular expression (regex).
LiveChatSensitiveDataRule.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.

LiveChatTranscript.description: This object is automatically created for each Live Agent chat session and stores information about the session.

LiveChatTranscriptEvent.description: Captures specific events that occur over the lifetime of a chat.

LiveChatTranscriptShare.description: Represents a sharing entry on a LiveChatTranscript object.

LiveChatTranscriptSkill.description: Represents a join between LiveChatTranscript and Skill.

LiveChatUserConfig.description: Represents a setting that controls the console settings for Chat users.
LiveChatUserConfig.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.

LiveChatUserConfigProfile.description: Represents a join between LiveChatUserConfig and Profile.
LiveChatUserConfigProfile.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.

LiveChatUserConfigUser.description: Represents a join between Live Chat User Config and User.
LiveChatUserConfigUser.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.

LiveChatVisitor.description: Represents a website visitor who has started or tried to start a chat session.

LoanApplicant.description: Represents details of the borrower or co-borrower for the loan application.

LoanApplicantAddress.description: Represents borrower's or co-borrower's current address information.

LoanApplicantAsset.description: Represents a junction between a borrower and a loan application asset.

LoanApplicantDeclaration.description: Represents financial issues like foreclosure, lawsuits, or defaults of the applicant or co-applicant.

LoanApplicantEmployment.description: Represents details about the borrower's or co-borrower's current and past employment.

LoanApplicantIncome.description: Represents details about the borrower and co-borrower current monthly income.

LoanApplicantLiability.description: Represents a junction between a borrower and a loan application liability.

LoanApplicationAsset.description: Represents details about the borrower's and co-borrower's current personal and real property.

LoanApplicationFinancial.description: Represents transaction details for a loan application.

LoanApplicationLiability.description: Represents details about the borrower and co-borrower current liabilities.

LoanApplicationProperty.description: Represents details of the property the loan application finances.

LoanApplicationTitleHolder.description: Represents details of borrowers who are applying to hold title to the property the loan application finances.

LocWaitlistMsgTemplate.description: Represents a junction object connecting LocationWaitlist to MessagingTemplate.

Location.description: Represents details about a facility, building, room, or region.
Location.accessRules: At least one of these features must be enabled:

LocationGroup.description: Represents a group of Omnichannel Inventory locations, providing an aggregate view of inventory availability across those locations. Omnichannel Inventory can create an inventory reservation for an order at the location group level, then assign the reservation to one or more locations in the group as needed.
LocationGroup.accessRules: This object is only available in Omnichannel Inventory orgs.

LocationGroupAssignment.description: Represents the assignment of a location to a location group.
LocationGroupAssignment.accessRules: This object is only available in Omnichannel Inventory orgs.

LocationShippingCarrierMethod.description: The available shipping carrier services associated with a location or location group. Allows the assignment of different shipping methods to a specific location and enables flexibility and customization in the shipping process.
LocationShippingCarrierMethod.accessRules: The LocationShippingCarrierMethod object is available only if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled.

LocationTrustMeasure.description: Represents the COVID safety protocols that your business follows. For example, enforcement of masks, social distancing, cleanliness, and capacity limits.

LocationUse.description: Records the general purpose of the Location.

LocationWaitlist.description: Represents a queue created for a specific location. Multiple queues can be created for a single location. For example, you can have a queue for each sales agent or a standard queue and a queue for vulnerable groups. The specific party of people in a queue is represented by LocationWaitlistedParty.

LocationWaitlistedParty.description: Represents a specific party of people waiting in a queue.

Login As Event Type.description: Login As events contain details about what a Salesforce admin did while logged in as another user.

Login Event Type.description: Login events contain details about your org’s user login history.

LoginAsEventLog.description: LoginAsEventLog contains details about when a user logs in as another user in your org.

LoginEvent.description: The documentation has moved to LoginEvent in the Platform Events Developer Guide.

LoginEventLog.description: Login event logs contain details about your Salesforce org's user login history.

LoginGeo.description: Represents the geographic location of the user’s IP address for a login event. Due to the nature of geolocation technology, the accuracy of geolocation fields (for example, country, city, postal code) may vary.
LoginGeo.accessRules: Only users with Manage Users permissions can access this object.

LoginHistory.description: Represents the login history for all successful and failed login attempts for organizations and enabled portals.
LoginHistory.accessRules: With one exception, only users with Manage Users or Monitor Login History permissions can access this object. The exception is that, in API version 37.0 and later, all users can retrieve their own login history records.

LogoutEventLog.description: Contains details of user sessions ending or being revoked.

LogoutEventStream.description: The documentation has moved to LogoutEventStream in the Platform Events Developer Guide.

LookedUpFromActivity.description: This read-only object is displayed as a related list on an activity record (an event or a task); the list contains records that have custom lookup relationships from the activity to another object. This object is not queryable.

LookupFilter.description: Represents a lookup filter, which restricts the valid values and lookup dialog results for lookup, master-detail, and hierarchical relationship fields.

LoyaltyAggrPointExprLedger.description: Represents information about non-qualifying currency points that expire based on a fixed model tier group.

LoyaltyLedger.description: Records the points that have been credited or debited for a member across the transactions.

LoyaltyLedgerTraceability.description: Represents a tracker for the loyalty ledger. The debit ledger consumes points from the linked credit ledger for a member redemption or an accrual cancellation.

LoyaltyMemberCurrency.description: Represents the information about point balance for a member and a particular currency.

LoyaltyMemberTier.description: Represents information about the current tier of the member across tier groups.

LoyaltyMembershipLifecycle.description: Represents information about a member's lifecycle in the loyalty program.

LoyaltyPartnerProduct.description: Represents products and product categories offered by loyalty partners.

LoyaltyPgmCurrencyExtPrd.description: Represents an additional timeframe beyond the standard expiration date for redeeming or reinstating points. It enables tier-based flexibility, allowing certain members more time to utilize their points before they are forfeited.

LoyaltyPgmCurrencySubtype.description: Represents a subtype of a fixed-model non-qualifying loyalty program currency.
LoyaltyPgmCurrencySubtype.accessRules: This object is available only if the Loyalty Management - Advanced license is enabled in your org.

LoyaltyPgmEngmtAttrProm.description: Represents a junction between Loyalty Program Engagement Attribute and Promotion. Associate an engagement attribute with a promotion if you want to track the engagement attribute during the promotion period.

LoyaltyPgmEngmtAttribute.description: Represents information about an engagement attribute for a loyalty program.

LoyaltyPgmGroupMbrRlnsp.description: Represents a junction between a Corporate or Individual type loyalty program member who is part of a group and the Group type loyalty program member.

LoyaltyPgmMbrAttributeVal.description: Represents information about the value reached by a loyalty program member for an engagement attribute.

LoyaltyPgmMbrLinkedPtnr.description: Represents the association between a loyalty program member and their membership with a partner. It acts as an association that facilitates points accrual and data exchange in a joint loyalty program.

LoyaltyPgmMbrPromEligView.description: Represents a virtual object that provides a consolidated view of the loyalty program member’s eligibility for a promotion and their enrollment status in eligible promotions.

LoyaltyPgmPartnerCurrency.description: Represents a junction between a loyalty program partner and a loyalty program currency.

LoyaltyPgmPartnerPromotion.description: Represents a junction between the Promotion and Loyalty Program Partner objects.

LoyaltyPgmPtnrLdgrSummary.description: Represents the aggregated ledger used by a loyalty program to credit points to or debit points from a prepaid partner's points pack. This ledger can also be used to add or deduct the monetary value of points from the postpaid partner's bill.

LoyaltyPgmPtnrPrepaidPack.description: Represents information about a prepaid set of points purchased by a loyalty program partner.

LoyaltyProgram.description: Represents the loyalty program within an organization. All the information related to members, tiers, tier groups, program currencies, vouchers, benefits, partners, promotions, transactions are associated with the program.

LoyaltyProgramBadge.description: Represents information about the badge that's associated with a loyalty program.

LoyaltyProgramCurrency.description: Represents qualifying and non-qualifying currencies associated with the program. Qualifying currency represents the engagement of a member with the program and it’s associated with a tier group. Non-qualifying currency represent the points that the member earns for redemption.

LoyaltyProgramCurrencyTier.description: Repesents a junction between non-qualifying loyalty program currency and loyalty tier.
LoyaltyProgramCurrencyTier.accessRules: This object is available only if the Loyalty Management - Growth or the Loyalty Management - Advanced license is enabled in your org.

LoyaltyProgramJournalType.description: Represents an activity that resets points validity for currencies with an activity-based expiration model.

LoyaltyProgramMbrPromotion.description: Represents details about the promotions to be applied for a loyalty program member. Tracks the enrollment status, promotion status, and progress for a promotion of a member.

LoyaltyProgramMember.description: Represents information about member who belongs to a loyalty program. The member can be individual or corporate type.

LoyaltyProgramMemberBadge.description: Represents a badge that’s assigned to a loyalty program member.

LoyaltyProgramMemberCase.description: Represents a junction between a loyalty program member and a case.

LoyaltyProgramMemberMerge.description: Represents information about merged loyalty program memberships.

LoyaltyProgramPartner.description: Represents partners that are associated with a given loyalty program. Partners can be an accrual partner, a redemption partner, or both.

LoyaltyProgramPartnerLedger.description: Represents the ledger used by a loyalty program to credit points to or debit points from a prepaid partner's points pack or from a postpaid partner’s point balance. This ledger can also be used to add or deduct the monetary value of points from the partner's postpaid bill.

LoyaltyProgramProcess.description: Represents information about loyalty program processes that determine how transaction journals are processed.

LoyaltyProgramWidget.description: Represents the configuration of a widget that a user can apply to the out-of-the-box widget templates and FlexCards provided by Omnistudio. The configuration helps implement custom UI changes, such as promotion type, promotion tag line, and so on for a user.

LoyaltyTier.description: Represents information about tiers of a loyalty program. A tier group has a set of tiers in a sequential order.

LoyaltyTierBenefit.description: A junction object that associates the loyalty benefits with the loyalty program tiers.

LoyaltyTierGroup.description: Represents information about tier groups of a loyalty program. Tier group categorizes members based on their loyalty points.

LoyaltyTierMshpFeeOption.description: Represents the options by which members can pay for tier or club memberships.

LoyaltyTierPromotion.description: Represents a junction between a member tier and a loyalty promotion.

MLDataDefinition.description: Represents a modeling data definition, which specifies the data used to create a model for a machine learning (ML) application. Examples of such data can include filters, fields to include, and fields to exclude.

MLField.description: Represents a field in a modeling data definition. A modeling data definition specifies the data used to create a model for a machine learning (ML) application.

MLFilter.description: Represents a data filter based on a data comparison in a machine learning (ML) application. For each comparison, there’s a left-hand element, an operator, and a right-hand element.

MLModel.description: Represents an AI model that can be used in Einstein Prediction Builder, Einstein Recommendation Builder, and other Einstein features.

MLModelFactor.description: Represents a field value that has a positive or negative effect on the model’s score.

MLModelFactorComponent.description: Represents information about the related MLModelFactor. For example, this object can represent a field value or a field range such as “Title = CEO” or “Annual Revenue >10000000”.

MLModelMetric.description: Represents a metric or statistic about the related model, such as accuracy, precision, or RSquared. Use a model’s metrics to learn about its performance and to compare it with other models.

MLPredictionDefinition.description: Represents the details about a prediction within a prediction definition used in a machine learning (ML) application.

Macro.description: Represents a macro, which is a set of instructions that tells the system to perform one or more tasks.

MacroInstruction.description: Represents an instruction in a macro. An instruction can specify the object that the macro interacts with, the context or publisher that the macro works within, the operation or action that the macro performs, and the target of the macro’s actions.

MacroUsage.description: Represents macro usage on a record, including which macro was used, who used it, and how they used it.
MacroUsage.accessRules: This object is always read-only. Only users with “Modify All Data” permission can delete MacroUsage records.

MailmergeTemplate.description: Represents a mail merge template (a Microsoft Word document) used for performing mail merges for your organization.
MailmergeTemplate.accessRules: the “Customize Application” permission to modify it

MaintenanceAsset.description: Represents an asset covered by a maintenance plan in field service. Assets can be associated with multiple maintenance plans.

MaintenanceWorkRule.description: Represents the recurrence pattern for a maintenance record.

ManagedCareProgramPrfm.description: Represents the rating and enrollee retention rate according to the plan type of an average medicare advantage plan.

ManagedContent.description: Represents managed content in a Salesforce CMS workspace for use in an Experience Cloud site or a channel. The ManagedContent object represents the complete instance of a managed content record. It provides a consistent identifier for the managed content so that variants of the content item can be created over time.
ManagedContent.accessRules: ManagedContent is available when the Digital Experiences app is enabled.

ManagedContentChannel.description: Represents the details of a CMS channel. CMS channels correspond to managed content publishing endpoints. They deliver published content from your Salesforce CMS workspaces to an audience.
ManagedContentChannel.accessRules: ManagedContentChannel is available when the Digital Experiences app is enabled.

ManagedContentInfo.description: Allows the creation of relationship to Product using ProductMedia.
ManagedContentInfo.accessRules: You must have the B2B Commerce license and a CMS workspace to access a web store.

ManagedContentNodeType.description: Represents ManagedContentNodeType metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

ManagedContentSpace.description: Represents the complete instance of a Salesforce CMS workspace that stores managed content. Users and groups with designated permissions can access and manage the content in a CMS workspace.
ManagedContentSpace.accessRules: ManagedContentSpace is available when the Digital Experiences app is enabled.

ManagedContentType.description: Represents ManagedContentType metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

ManagedContentVariant.description: Represents a variant of a managed content item.
ManagedContentVariant.accessRules: ManagedContentVariant is available when the Digital Experiences app is enabled.

ManagedEventSubscription (Beta).description: Represents a managed event subscription in Pub/Sub API. Use a managed event subscription to track the events that a subscriber client consumed and resume a subscription where it left off.
ManagedEventSubscription (Beta).accessRules: To retrieve or query this object, you must have the View Setup and Configuration permission. To create, update, or delete this object, you must have the Customize Application permission.

ManufacturingProgram.description: Represents information about a manufacturing program. For example, Verican X program for Verican Account to manufacture auto components for their upcoming concept vehicle, staring from 01-Jan-2022 and valid until 01-Dec-2024.

MarketingAppExtAction.description: Represents an Action Type, which is an action that you can add to Engagement Studio programs in Account Engagement and execute in a third-party app.
MarketingAppExtAction.accessRules: MarketingAppExtAction is available to customers with Account Engagement Plus, Advanced, or Premium editions.

MarketingAppExtActivity.description: Represents an Activity Type, which is a prospect activity that occurs in a third-party app and can be used in Account Engagement automations.
MarketingAppExtActivity.accessRules: MarketingAppExtActivity is available to customers with Account Engagement Plus, Advanced, or Premium editions.

MarketingAppExtAssignment.accessRules: MarketingAppExtAssignment is available to customers with Account Engagement Plus, Advanced, or Premium editions.

MarketingAppExtension.description: Represents an integration with a third-party app or service that generates prospect external activity. Available in API version 53.0 and later.
MarketingAppExtension.accessRules: MarketingAppExtension is available to customers with Account Engagement Plus, Advanced, or Premium editions.

MarketingForm.description: Represents an Account Engagement marketing form that has been synched to Salesforce. Use forms on your website and landing pages to collect information about visitors and turn anonymous visitors into identified prospects.

MarketingLink.description: Represents an Account Engagement marketing link record, either a custom redirect or a file, that has been synced to Salesforce.

MatchingRule.description: Setup object specifying a MatchingRule to use with DuplicateJob instances that share a DuplicateJobDefinition. Available in Tooling API version 42.0 and later.
MatchingRule.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

MatchingRuleItem.description: Represents criteria used by a matching rule to identify duplicate records.
MatchingRuleItem.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

MaterialityAssessment.description: Represents information about stakeholder engagement to assess the importance of environmental, social, and governance (ESG) issues for them.

MaterialityMatrixScore.description: Represents the materiality matrix score used to visualize all the data gathered through materiality assessment intake process.

MaterialityStakeholder.description: Represents information about a stakeholder who can be internal or external party having interest in a company. A stakeholder can either affect or be affected by the business.

MaterialityStkhldrCatg.description: Represents a category to organize materiality stakeholders into groups, such as employees, shareholders, suppliers, and customers.

MaterialityTopic.description: Represents a possible topic for materiality assessment.

MaterialityTopicDocClauseSet.description: Represents a reference object with information about the topic and a document clause set.

MaterialityTopicQstn.description: Represents the mapping between the materiality assessment topics and the materiality assessment survey questions.

MaterialityTopicReference.description: Represents a reference object with information about two related topics.

MedReconRecommendation.description: Stores information about a medication recommendation and associates a recommendation to a medication reconciliation.

MedReconStmtRecommendation.description: Associates a medication recommendation to a medication statement and medication reconciliation.

MedTherapyStmtReviewIssue.description: Represents a junction object between the Medication Therapy Statement Review and Clinical Detected Issue objects.

MedicationReconciliation.description: Stores information about a medication reconciliation conducted for a patient

MedicationTherapyReview.description: Stores information about a medication therapy review conducted for a patient.

MedicationTherapyStmtReview.description: Represents a junction object between the Medication Therapy Review and Medication Statement objects.

MeetingPlaybook.description: Represents a meeting playbook created from a meeting playbook definition. Specifies the sequence of stages and drives execution for the meeting.

MeetingPlaybookStage.description: Represents a stage in a meeting playbook, created from a meeting playbook definition stage. Defines the stage position, action, and prompts available at the stage.

MeetingPlaybookStageText.description: Stores AI-generated or user-authored rich text notes for each meeting stage.

MeetingPlbkStageCapability.description: Represents the execution of an action for a meeting playbook stage.

MeetingPlbkStageContentDoc.description: Represents a document attached to a meeting playbook. It stores meeting-specific details, such as applicable stages and an AI-generated summary.

MemberBenefit.description: Represents details about a benefit that’s assigned to a loyalty program member and has a benefit action that’s triggered.

MemberPlan.description: Represents details about the insurance coverage for a member or subscriber.

MemberPlanCarePlan.description: Represents a junction between member plans and care plans. It defines the problems, goals, and interventions in a care plan based on the patient's health plan coverage.

MemberPlanMedicationStmt.description: Represents a junction between member plans and medication statements. It associates the medications that a patient is currently taking or has taken in the past with their health plan coverage.

MentoringProfile.description: Represents information for a participant in a mentoring program.

MerchAccPaymentMethodSet.description: Defines an ordered list of payment methods that are available to a merchant's cudstomer during checkout. You can configure multiple payment method sets, each designated for a specific locale, payment region, or sale channel.

MerchAccPaymentMethodType.description: Refers to a payment method that is in a payment method set, which is defined by the MerchAccPaymentMethodSet object.

MerchantAccount.description: A type of bank account that lets a merchant accept payments from a variety of payment methods, including credit or debit cards, or digital wallets. A Salesforce Payments merchant account is linked to an underlying payment gateway to process payments

MerchantAccountEvent.description: Represents a merchant account platform event. Subscribe to these events so you can listen and respond to them when they’re published. For example, create a Salesforce Flow that is triggered when one of these events is published.

MessagingChannel.description: Represents a communication channel that an end user can use to send a message to an agent. A communication channel can be an SMS number, a Facebook page, or another supported messaging channel.

MessagingChannelSkill.description: Junction object that represents an association between MessagingChannel and Skill.

MessagingChannelUsage.description: Represents the status of an enhanced Messaging channel or of an application in a Unified Messaging channel.

MessagingConfiguration.description: Represents the details for a Messaging configuration.

MessagingDeliveryError.description: Represents a log of triggered outbound failures to verify when a triggered outbound has failed.

MessagingEndUser.description: Represents a single address—such as a phone number or Facebook page—communicating with a single Messaging channel.

MessagingLink.description: Represents the link between a Messaging Channel and where it's shared.

MessagingSession.description: Represents a session on a Messaging channel.

MessagingSessionMetrics.description: Represents a metric gathered about a specific enhanced messaging session, such as average agent response time.
MessagingSessionMetrics.accessRules: Multiple MessagingSessionMetrics records are generated when a session ends in an enhanced Messaging channel or Messaging for In-App and Web channel. These records aren't generated for standard messaging sessions.

MessagingTemplate.description: Represents a Messaging template used to send pre-formatted messages.

Metadata API Operation Event Type.description: Metadata API Operation events contain details of Metadata API retrieval and deployment requests.

MetadataApiOpEventLog.description: MetadataApiOpEventLog stores details of Metadata API retrieval and deployment requests.

MetadataContainer.description: Manages working copies of ApexClassMember, ApexTriggerMember, ApexPageMember, and ApexComponentMember objects, including collections of objects to be deployed together.

MetadataPackage.description: Represents a package that has been developed in the org you’re logged in to. Applies to unlocked, unmanaged, first-generation, and second-generation managed packages.

MetadataPackageVersion.description: Represents a package version (managed or unmanaged) that has been uploaded from the org you’re logged in to.

Metric.description: The Metric object represents the components of a goal metric such as its name, metric type, and current value.

MetricDataLink.description: The link between the metric and the data source, such as a report.

MfgPgmCpntFrcstFactOpptySchd.description: Represents a junction between the forecast and opportunity line item schedule objects, providing details on the relationship between forecast data and corresponding sales order schedules.

MfgProgramCpntFrcstFact.description: Represents information about the generated manufacturing program component forecast records.

MfgProgramForecastFact.description: Represents information about the generated manufacturing program forecast records.

MfgProgramTemplate.description: Represents information about the templates associated with a manufacturing program.

MfgProgramTemplateItem.description: Represents information about the transformation type associated with a manufacturing program template.

MfgProgramVariantFrcstFact.description: Represents information about the generated manufacturing program product variant forecast records.

MilestoneType.description: Represents a milestone (required step in a customer support process).
MilestoneType.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only Salesforce admins, users with access to the Case, Entitlement, or Work Order objects, and users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

MktJourneyDcsnSetup.description: Represents a collection of Marketing Cloud Engagement journeys that you can interact with by using Salesforce Flow in Marketing Cloud.

MlIntentUtteranceSuggestion.description: Represents a customer input, used for training purposes in the feedback loop process of a conversation. Admins can add these inputs to the intent training model.

MobSecurityCertPinConfig.description: Configuration of mobile security certificate pinning on the Salesforce mobile app with Enhanced Mobile Security.
MobSecurityCertPinConfig.accessRules: Enhanced Mobile App Security add-on subscriptions and the Enforce Enhanced Mobile App Security

MobSecurityCertPinEvent.description: The event of mobile security certificate pinning on the Salesforce mobile app with Enhanced Mobile Security.
MobSecurityCertPinEvent.accessRules: Enhanced Mobile App Security add-on subscriptions and the Enforce Enhanced Mobile App Security

MobileDeviceAppRegistration.description: Represents the details provided in a mobile device registration event from an app that uses the Engagement Mobile SDK.

MobileSecurityAssignment.description: Represents the assignment of mobile security policies to a profile. The policies apply to the Salesforce mobile app with Enhanced Mobile App Security enabled.
MobileSecurityAssignment.accessRules: Enhanced Mobile App Security add-on subscriptions and the Enforce Enhanced Mobile App Security

MobileSecurityPolicy.description: Enables mobile security policies on the Salesforce mobile app with Enhanced Mobile Security.
MobileSecurityPolicy.accessRules: Enhanced Mobile App Security add-on subscriptions and the Enforce Enhanced Mobile App Security

MobileSecurityUserMetric.description: Represents the metrics for users who have Enhanced Mobile Security policies enforced.
MobileSecurityUserMetric.accessRules: Enhanced Mobile App Security add-on subscriptions and the Enforce Enhanced Mobile App Security

MobileSettingsAssignment.description: Represents the assignment of a particular field service mobile settings configuration to a user profile.

ModerationRule.description: Represents ModerationRule metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.

MonthlyUsageTrkgDataGap.description: Represents a gap in the tracking of fuel usage data for the month.

MsgChannelLanguageKeyword.description: Represents the consent configuration for a Messaging channel.

MsgChannelUsageExternalOrg.description: Represents the Enterprise ID (EID) and Business Unit (MID) for Marketing Cloud connections in a Unified Messaging channel.

Multiblock Report Event Type.description: Multiblock Report events contain details about Joined Report reports.

MultipartyInfoAuthRequest.description: Tracks a request for multiple parties of authorization on a Data Use Purpose. For example, consent requests to share the required documents to open a joint financial account or share mortgage disclosures to loan applicants (borrower + co-borrower).

MutingPermissionSet.description: Represents a set of disabled permissions and is used in conjunction with PermissionSetGroup.

MyDomainDiscoverableLogin.description: Represents configuration settings when the My Domain login page type is Discovery. Login Discovery provides an identity-first login experience, where the login page contains the identifier field only. Based on the identifier entered, a handler determines how to authenticate the user.

Name.description: Non-queryable object that provides information about foreign key traversals when the foreign key has more than one parent.

Named Credential Event Type.description: The Named Credential event type captures information about Apex callouts that use named credentials as their endpoints. Use this event type to audit the installed managed packages that use named credentials. If you don’t recognize the package namespace in the named credential event log file, then you can investigate whether a security breach has occurred.

NamedCredential.description: Represents a named credential, which specifies the URL of a callout endpoint and its required authentication parameters in one definition.
NamedCredential.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

NamedCredentialEventLog.description: The Named Credential event type captures information about Apex callouts that use named credentials as their endpoints. Use this event type to audit the installed managed packages that use named credentials. If you don’t recognize the package namespace in the named credential event log file, then you can investigate whether a security breach has occurred.

NamespaceRegistry.description: Represents a namespace that you can link to scratch orgs that were created from your org’s Dev Hub. You use the namespace when developing, packaging, and releasing an app. You can’t create this object with the API. Use the Link Namespace action in the Dev Hub graphical interface to insert a NamespaceRegistry record.

NavigationLinkSet.description: Represents the navigation menu in an Experience Cloud site. A navigation menu consists of items that users can click to go to other parts of the site.
NavigationLinkSet.accessRules: Experience Cloud sites created using Experience Builder templates

NavigationMenuItem.description: Represents a single menu item in a NavigationLinkSet. Use this object to create, delete, or update menu items in your Experience Cloud site’s navigation menu.
NavigationMenuItem.accessRules: Experience Cloud sites created using Experience Builder templates

NavigationMenuItemLocalization.description: Represents the translated value of a navigation menu item in an Experience Cloud site.
NavigationMenuItemLocalization.accessRules: Experience Cloud sites created using Experience Builder templates

NegInvcLineProcessedEvent.description: Represents the notification to the customers when a negative invoice line is converted to a credit memo
NegInvcLineProcessedEvent.accessRules: This object is available when Billing is enabled.

Network.description: Represents an Experience Cloud site. Salesforce Experience Cloud lets you create branded spaces for your employees, customers, and partners. You can customize and create experiences, whether they’re communities, sites, or portals, to meet your business needs, then transition seamlessly between them. Experience Cloud sites let you share information, records, and files with coworkers and stakeholders all in one place.
Network.accessRules: This object is available only when your org has digital experiences enabled.

NetworkActivityAudit.description: Represents an audit trail of moderation actions in Experience Cloud sites.
NetworkActivityAudit.accessRules: This object is available only when your org has digital experiences enabled.

NetworkAffinity.description: Represents a junction object that associates a user profile with a Network object, that is, with an Experience Cloud site. Use NetworkAffinity to assign a default Experience Cloud site to a user profile.
NetworkAffinity.accessRules: To work with the NetworkAffinity object, you must have View Setup or Customize Application permission.

NetworkAuthApiSettings.description: Represents the settings that control enablement, access, and security for the Headless Registration Flow, Headless Forgot Password Flow, Headless Passwordless Login Flow, and their associated APIs.

NetworkDataCategory.description: Represents data categories in Lightning Web Runtime (LWR) Experience Cloud Sites.
NetworkDataCategory.accessRules: This object is available only when your org has Digital Experiences and Knowledge or Service Catalog enabled.

NetworkDiscoverableLogin.description: Represents the Login Discoverable page from where customers and partners log in to an Experience Cloud site. Customers and partners are users with an External Identity license or any communities license for Experience Cloud.

NetworkEmailTmplAllowlist.description: Represents an allowlist for the one-time password (OTP) email templates that are sent to end users during the Headless Registration Flow, the Headless Passwordless Login Flow, and the Headless Forgot Password Flow.

NetworkFeedResponseMetric.description: Represents an object that stores the date and time values of question posts. It captures information for question creation, answer creation, and when an answer is marked as best answer
NetworkFeedResponseMetric.accessRules: The NetworkFeedResponseMetric object is available only if both NetworksEnabled and ChatterEnabled org preferences are enabled.

NetworkMember.description: Represents a member of an Experience Cloud site. Members can be either users in your company or external users with portal profiles.
NetworkMember.accessRules: This object is available only when your org has digital experiences enabled.

NetworkMemberGroup.description: Represents a group of members in an Experience Cloud site. Members can be either users in your internal org or external users assigned portal profiles. An administrator adds members to an Experience Cloud site by adding a profile or a permission set, and any user with the profile or permission set becomes a member of the site. This object is available in API version 26.0 and later.
NetworkMemberGroup.accessRules: This object is available only when your org has digital experiences enabled.

NetworkModeration.description: Represents a flag on an item in a community.
NetworkModeration.accessRules: This object is available only when your org has digital experiences enabled.

NetworkPageOverride.description: Represents information about custom pages used to override the default pages in Experience Cloud sites. You can create Experience Builder or Visualforce pages and override the default pages in a site. Using custom pages allows you to create a more personalized experience for your users.

NetworkReferencedObject.description: A junction object that associates the loyalty program with the Experience Cloud site.

NetworkSelfRegistration.description: Represents the account that self-registering Experience Cloud users are associated with by default.

NetworkUserHistoryRecent.description: Represents an Experience Cloud site user’s history of accessed records.
NetworkUserHistoryRecent.accessRules: Only users with the Modify All Data permission can view and delete these data.

Note.description: Represents a note, which is text associated with a custom object or a standard object, such as a Contact, Contract, or Opportunity.

NoteAndAttachment.description: This read-only object contains all notes and attachments associated with an object.

NoteTag.description: Associates a word or short phrase with a Note.

OSAsyncChgCompletedEvent.description: An event that allows the processing of the credit memo, invoices, and other entities after a bulk action has successfully completed. The event provides all of the values that would exist on the synchronous APIs. This object is available in API version 63.0 and later.

OauthCustomScope.description: Represents a permission defining the protected data that a connected app can access from an external entity when Salesforce is the OAuth authorization provider.
OauthCustomScope.accessRules: You must have the “Manage Connected Apps” permission to access this object.

OauthCustomScopeApp.description: Represents the name of the connected app to which the custom scope is assigned.

OauthToken.description: Represents an OAuth access token for connected app authentication. Use this object to create a user interface for token management.
OauthToken.accessRules: Users with the Customize Application permission see all tokens for all users in the org. Otherwise, you see only your own tokens.

OauthTokenExchHandlerApp.description: Represents the enablement settings for a specific Salesforce connected app or external client app that’s enabled for the token exchange handler. A handler can be enabled for multiple apps.

OauthTokenExchangeHandler.description: Represents a token exchange handler. The token exchange handler also consists of an Apex class. During the OAuth 2.0 token exchange flow, the token exchange handler is used to validate tokens from an external identity provider and to map users to Salesforce.

ObjectDataImport.description: Represents the data import status of one or more object records.

ObjectDataImportReference.description: Represents the relationships to the associated reference objects showing the source from which the data is imported.
ObjectDataImportReference.accessRules: ObjectDataImportReference is read only and can only be queried.

ObjectHierarchyRelationship.description: Represents the mapping between an input source object and an output target object. For example, mapping details to transform a sales quote into a sales agreement. This object is available in API version 56.0 and later.

ObjectMetadataTag.description: Represents a meta tag for a store page. Meta tags in HTML documents provide structured data used by search engines for ranking and to show content in search results.
ObjectMetadataTag.accessRules: This object is available only if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled.

ObjectPermissions.description: Represents the enabled object permissions for the parent PermissionSet.
ObjectPermissions.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

ObjectRelatedUrl.description: Represents a URL slug for a Product or Category page on a B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce LWR site, or a custom object, account, or contact page on an enhanced LWR Experience Cloud site.
ObjectRelatedUrl.accessRules: Your org must have B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license enabled for commerce use cases. ObjectRelatedUrl is available for Product2 and ProductCategory records in Commerce, and on custom object, account and contact record pages in enhanced LWR sites.

ObjectTerritory2AssignmentRule.description: Represents a territory assignment rule that’s associated with an object, such as Account. ObjectTerritory2AssignmentRuleItem can be created or deleted if the BooleanFilter field on its corresponding ObjectTerritory2AssignmentRule is null.
ObjectTerritory2AssignmentRule.accessRules: Standard users can access this object. If a territory model is in Active state, any standard user can view that model, including its territories, assignment rules, assigned records, and assigned users. Users cannot view territory models in other states (such as Planning or Archived).

ObjectTerritory2AssignmentRuleItem.description: A single row of selection criteria for an ObjectTerritory2AssignmentRule object. ObjectTerritory2AssignmentRuleItem can only be created or deleted if the BooleanFilter field on its corresponding ObjectTerritory2AssignmentRule object is a null value. Available if Sales Territories has been enabled.
ObjectTerritory2AssignmentRuleItem.accessRules: Standard users can access this object. If a territory model is in Active state, any standard user can view that model, including its territories and assignment rules. For territories in an active model, any standard user can view assigned records and assigned users subject to your Salesforce sharing settings. Users cannot view territory models in other states (such as Planning or Archived).

ObjectTerritory2Association.description: Represents an association (by assignment) between a territory and an object record such as an account or a lead.

ObjectUserTerritory2View.description: Represents a user and object, such as an account or lead, assigned to a territory.
ObjectUserTerritory2View.accessRules: To see this object, enable Sales Territories.

Occupation.description: Represents a group of positions that engage in a specialized line of work and require a connected set of skills, knowledge, or qualifications. For example, the occupation of Registered Nurses in the Healthcare occupation group.

OccupationGroup.description: Represents a group of occupations that involve broadly similar functions, knowledge and skills, or materials and equipment. For example, Architecture and Engineering, Military, and Healthcare.

OcrDocumentScanResult.description: Represents the contents of a document after optical character recognition (OCR) processing.

OmniAssessmentTask.description: Represents the information about an assessment task that is associated with an OmniScript.

OmniExtTrackingDef.description: Represents a connection between an OmniTrackingGroup in OmniAnalytics and a third-party Analytics system such as Google Analytics.
OmniExtTrackingDef.label: Omni External Tracking Definition
OmniExtTrackingDef.accessRules: having an OmniStudio license and enabling OmniAnalytics in Setup

OmniExtTrackingEventDef.description: Represents a format for FlexCard or OmniScript user interaction data that a third-party Analytics system such as Google Analytics can accept.
OmniExtTrackingEventDef.label: Omni External Tracking Event Definition
OmniExtTrackingEventDef.accessRules: having an OmniStudio license and enabling OmniAnalytics in Setup

OmniProcessAsmtQuestionVer.description: Represents a junction between an OmniScript process and an assessment question version.

OmniProcessOmniAsmtTask.description: Represents a junction between an omni process and an omni assessment task.

OmniSupervisorConfig.description: Represents the Omni-Channel supervisor configuration for an assigned group of supervisors.
OmniSupervisorConfig.accessRules: Salesforce admin privileges or the Customize Application permission

OmniSupervisorConfigAction.description: Represents the actions available to the supervisors of a Command Center for Service configuration.
OmniSupervisorConfigAction.accessRules: To access this object, Omni-Channel must be enabled.

OmniSupervisorConfigGroup.description: Represents the group of reps who are visible to the supervisors of a Command Center for Service configuration. The group, if visible, appears in the Agents tab of Command Center for Service.
OmniSupervisorConfigGroup.accessRules: To access this object, Omni-Channel must be enabled.

OmniSupervisorConfigProfile.description: Represents the supervisor profiles to which a Command Center for Service configuration applies. User-level configurations override profile-level configurations.
OmniSupervisorConfigProfile.accessRules: To access this object, Omni-Channel must be enabled.

OmniSupervisorConfigQueue.description: Represents the queues that are visible to the supervisors of a Command Center for Service configuration. The queue, if visible, appears in the Queues Backlog and Assigned Work tabs of Command Center for Service.
OmniSupervisorConfigQueue.accessRules: To access this object, Omni-Channel must be enabled.

OmniSupervisorConfigSkill.description: Represents the skills that are visible to the supervisors of a Command Center for Service configuration. These skills, if visible, appear in the Skills Backlog tab of Command Center for Service.
OmniSupervisorConfigSkill.accessRules: To access this object, Omni-Channel must be enabled.

OmniSupervisorConfigTab.description: Represents the visible tabs specified in a Command Center for Service configuration.
OmniSupervisorConfigTab.accessRules: To access this object, Omni-Channel must be enabled.

OmniSupervisorConfigUser.description: Represents the users to whom a Command Center for Service configuration applies. User-level configurations override profile-level configurations.
OmniSupervisorConfigUser.accessRules: To access this object, Omni-Channel must be enabled.

OmniTrackingComponentDef.description: Represents a FlexCard or OmniScript that is a member of an OmniTrackingGroup, which tracks user interactions in OmniAnalytics.
OmniTrackingComponentDef.label: Omni Tracking Component Definition
OmniTrackingComponentDef.accessRules: having an OmniStudio license and enabling OmniAnalytics in Setup

OmniTrackingGroup.description: Represents a group of FlexCard and OmniScript components that have their user interactions tracked together in OmniAnalytics.
OmniTrackingGroup.label: Omni Tracking Group
OmniTrackingGroup.accessRules: having an OmniStudio license and enabling OmniAnalytics in Setup

One Commerce Usage Event Type.description: One Commerce Usage events capture information about your Commerce instance.

OpenActivity.description: This read-only object is displayed in a related list of open activities—future events and open tasks—related to an object. It includes activities for all contacts related to the object. OpenActivity fields for phone calls are only available if your organization uses Salesforce CRM Call Center.

OperatingHours.description: Represents the hours in which a service territory, service resource, or account is available for work. OperatingHours is used by Field Service, Salesforce Scheduler, Salesforce Meetings, Sales Engagement, and Workforce Engagement.

OperatingHoursHistory.description: Represents the history of changes made to tracked fields on an operating hours record.
OperatingHoursHistory.accessRules: Field Service must be enabled in your organization, and field tracking for operating hours fields must be configured.

OperatingHoursHoliday.description: Represents the day or hours for which a service territory or service resource is unavailable in Field Service, Salesforce Scheduler, Salesforce Meetings, Sales Engagement, or Workforce Engagement.

Operatinghours.description: Standard and custom fields extend the standard Operating hours object in Consumer Goods Cloud to represent the hours in which a service territory, service resource, or account is available for work.

OperationLog.description: Represents long-running or asynchronous operations triggered and tracked through Tooling API.
OperationLog.accessRules: As of the Spring '20 release, to access OperationLog you must have the View Setup user permission.

OppSalesMethodology.description: Represents the sales methodology record attached to an opportunity.
OppSalesMethodology.accessRules: To access this object turn on the userHasSalesMethodologyEnabled, OrgPreferences, SalesMethodologyPref, and PipelineInspectorUser permissions. To create, edit, or delete records, users must own the associated opportunity's parent opportunity.

OppSalesMethodologyItem.description: Represents the scored criteria for an opportunity's associated sales methodology.
OppSalesMethodologyItem.accessRules: To access this object turn on the userHasSalesMethodologyEnabled, OrgPreferences, SalesMethodologyPref, and PipelineInspectorUser permissions. To create, edit, or delete records, users must own the associated opportunity's parent opportunity.

Opportunity.description: Represents an opportunity, which is a sale or pending deal.

OpportunityCompetitor.description: Represents a competitor on an Opportunity.

OpportunityContactRole.description: Represents the role that a Contact plays on an Opportunity.

OpportunityContactRoleSuggestionInsight.description: Represents a suggestion for a new opportunity contact role.
OpportunityContactRoleSuggestionInsight.accessRules: a Sales Cloud Einstein license, edit access on opportunities, and read or edit access on contacts

OpportunityFieldHistory.description: Represents the history of changes to the values in the fields of an opportunity.

OpportunityHistory.description: Represents the stage history of an opportunity.

OpportunityInsight.description: Represents an individual insight (deal prediction, follow-up reminder, or key moment) related to an opportunity record.
OpportunityInsight.accessRules: a Sales Cloud Einstein license and access to the opportunity record

OpportunityLineItem.description: Represents an opportunity line item, which is a member of the list of Product2 products associated with an Opportunity.
OpportunityLineItem.accessRules: The user must have the “Edit” permission on Opportunity records to create or update opportunity line items on an opportunity.

OpportunityLineItemSchedule.description: Represents information about the quantity, revenue distribution, and delivery dates for a particular OpportunityLineItem.

OpportunityLineItemSplit.accessRules: Before creating OpportunityLineItemSplit records, enable Team Selling, set up opportunity splits, and enable product splits on at least one opportunity split type in Setup.

OpportunityParticipant.description: Represents information about a participant in the context of an opportunity record.

OpportunityPartner.description: This object represents a partner relationship between an Account and an Opportunity. An OpportunityPartner record is created automatically when a Partner record is created for a partner relationship between an account and an opportunity.
OpportunityPartner.accessRules: Customer Portal users can't access this object.

OpportunityPreferredSeller.description: Represents the relationship between an opportunity and a dealer account, or the relationship between an opportunity and the account that provided the lead from which the opportunity was created.

OpportunityProductRecipient.description: Represents a site that receives services or utilities related to an opportunity.

OpportunityRelatedDeleteLog.description: Represents an audit log of the deletion of opportunity-related child records, such as opportunity team members, product splits, or opportunity splits.

OpportunityShare.description: Represents a sharing entry on an Opportunity.
OpportunityShare.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only users with access to the Opportunity object can access this object.

OpportunitySplit.description: OpportunitySplit credits one or more opportunity team members with a portion of the opportunity amount.

OpportunitySplitType.description: Represents labels and behavior for each split type

OpportunityStage.description: Represents the stage of an Opportunity in the sales pipeline, such as New Lead, Negotiating, Pending, Closed, and so on.

OpportunityTag.description: Associates a word or short phrase with an Opportunity.

OpportunityTeamMember.description: Represents a User on the opportunity team of an Opportunity.

OpptyLineItemSplitType.description: Represents an opportunity product split type.

OrchestrationPlanCtxMapping.description: Represents an orchestration plan context mapping entry in the org. This entry is used to connect the business data in an object to the orchestration logic within Dynamic Revenue Orchestrator (DRO) by using the orchestration type.

Order.description: Represents an order associated with a contract or an account.

OrderAction.description: Indicates the type of order, such as a new sale or a cancellation.

OrderAdjustmentGroup.description: Group containing a set of adjustments applied to an order.

OrderAdjustmentGroupSummary.description: Represents the current properties and state of a group of related price adjustments. Associated with a set of OrderItemAdjustmentLineSummaries that apply to OrderItemSummaries belonging to one OrderSummary. Corresponds to one or more order adjustment group objects, consisting of an original object and any change objects applicable to it.
OrderAdjustmentGroupSummary.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs or if the B2B Commerce license is enabled.

OrderChangeLog.description: Represents a log record of all change requests made to an order post activation. A log record is always one-to-one to change an order request.

OrderChgReasonCategMap.description: The mapping between an order change reason and a service flow category.

OrderDeliveryGroup.description: A group of order items that share a delivery method and address. The delivery method and address are used during the fulfillment process, such as shipping as a gift, downloading, picking up in store, or shipping to a standard address

OrderDeliveryGroupSummary.description: Represents the current properties and state of a group of OrderItemSummaries, belonging to one OrderSummary, to be fulfilled using the same delivery method and delivered to the same address. A single shipment can include them all, but that isn’t guaranteed. Corresponds to one or more order delivery group objects, consisting of an original object and any change objects applicable to it.
OrderDeliveryGroupSummary.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs or if the B2B Commerce license is enabled.

OrderDeliveryMethod.description: Shows the customizations and options that a buyer selected for their delivery method.

OrderHistory.description: Represents historical information about changes that have been made to the standard fields of the associated order, or to any custom fields with history tracking enabled.

OrderItem.description: Represents an order product that your organization sells.
OrderItem.accessRules: The user must have Edit permission on Order records to create or update order products on an order. The user must have Edit permission on Order records to delete an order product.

OrderItemAdjustmentLineItem.description: An adjustment that has been made to an order item.

OrderItemAdjustmentLineSummary.description: Represents the current properties and state of price adjustments on an OrderItemSummary. Corresponds to one or more order item adjustment line item objects, consisting of an original object and any change objects applicable to it.
OrderItemAdjustmentLineSummary.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs or if the B2B Commerce license is enabled.

OrderItemAttribute.description: Represents a virtual object that stores an attribute specified for an order item.
OrderItemAttribute.accessRules: This object is available in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer Editions of Revenue Cloud.

OrderItemDetail.description: Represents the breakdown details of an order product. Revenue Management generates these records to capture pricing and quantity changes, such as negative quantity reductions, early renewals, derived pricing or repricing during an amendment, and bundle or product attribute reconfigurations.
OrderItemDetail.accessRules: This object is available in Enterprise, Unlimited, and Developer Editions of Revenue Cloud.

OrderItemGroup.description: Stores the group information for line items in an order. It also stores the aggregated line field information (subtotal). It contains a parent-child relationship to order.

OrderItemRateAdjustment.description: Represents the negotiated rate adjustment for an order product.

OrderItemRateCardEntry.description: Represents the catalog and negotiated rates of a usage metric associated with an order item that's used to charge overage consumption.

OrderItemRecipient.description: Represents a site, employee, or other entity for which services are being ordered. This includes essential details such as the recipient's name, contact information, and the specific site or location where the services will be provided.

OrderItemRelationship.description: Describes a relationship between order products.

OrderItemSummary.description: Represents the current properties and state of a product or charge on an OrderSummary. Corresponds to one or more order item objects, consisting of an original object and any change objects applicable to it.
OrderItemSummary.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs or if the B2B Commerce license is enabled.

OrderItemSummaryChange.description: Represents a change to an OrderItemSummary, usually a reduction in quantity due to a cancel or return. Corresponds to a change order item.
OrderItemSummaryChange.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs.

OrderItemTaxLineItem.description: The tax amount that has been applied to an order item.

OrderItemTaxLineItemSummary.description: Represents the current tax on an OrderItemSummary or OrderItemAdjustmentLineSummary. Corresponds to one or more order item tax line items, consisting of an original object and any change objects applicable to it.
OrderItemTaxLineItemSummary.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs or if the B2B Commerce license is enabled.

OrderItemType.description: Shows whether the order product is a product line or charge line.

OrderItemUsageRsrcGrant.description: Represents the negotiated grants for the usage resource that's associated with the usage product added in the order item.

OrderItemUsageRsrcPlcy.description: Represents the policies that are used for the usage resource that's associated with the usage product added in the order item.

OrderPaymentSummary.description: Represents the current properties and state of payments using a single payment method that are applied to one OrderSummary.
OrderPaymentSummary.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs or if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled.

OrderPaymentSummaryReference.description: OrderPaymentSummaryReference is a junction object that allows an order payment summary to be shared with another order summary.
OrderPaymentSummaryReference.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs or if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled.

OrderShare.description: Represents a sharing entry on an Order.

OrderStatus.description: Represents the status of the order entity.

OrderSummary.description: Represents the current properties and state of an order. Corresponds to one or more order objects, consisting of an original object and any change objects applicable to it.
OrderSummary.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs or if the B2B Commerce license is enabled.

OrderSummaryAdditionalInfo.description: Stores information related to OrderSummary including context around the order, such as inventory reservation details, order origination, and other values that Einstein uses to perform order analysis. Only reservation details can be stored in this object.
OrderSummaryAdditionalInfo.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs or if the B2B Commerce license is enabled.

OrderSummaryRelationship.description: Junction object used to track how an original order summary (created before any exchanges have occurred) relates to other order summary objects in a chain of exchange orders.
OrderSummaryRelationship.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs or if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled.

OrderSummaryRoutingSchedule.description: Represents an attempt to route an order summary to one or more inventory locations for fulfillment. You can use it to schedule future attempts and to record completed attempts.
OrderSummaryRoutingSchedule.accessRules: This object is only available in Salesforce Order Management orgs or if the B2B Commerce license is enabled.

OrgDeleteRequest.description: Represents a request to delete a developer edition (DE) org.

OrgDomainLog.description: Represents a Salesforce org’s previous My Domain.

OrgEmailAddressSecurity.description: Defines the assignment of a user profile to an org-wide email address.
OrgEmailAddressSecurity.accessRules: Only authenticated users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

OrgIncidentSummary.description: Represents statistics according to various categories of incidents in an organization, such as non-compliance with laws, corruptions, health and safety, discrimination, marketing and labeling, and customer privacy.

OrgMetric.description: Represents a feature or metric that Salesforce Optimizer evaluates.
OrgMetric.accessRules: Modify All Data and Customize Application

OrgMetricScanResult.description: Represents data or an item associated with a feature’s results in a Salesforce Optimizer evaluation. For example, for the Custom Field Limit feature, an OrgMetricScanResult object represents an object flagged for approaching the custom field limit.
OrgMetricScanResult.accessRules: Modify All Data and Customize Application

OrgMetricScanSummary.description: Represents the results summary for a specific feature in a Salesforce Optimizer evaluation.
OrgMetricScanSummary.accessRules: Modify All Data and Customize Application

OrgPaymentPracSummary.description: Represents the payment practice information to external parties that an organization discloses as part of ESRS G1 - Business conduct.

OrgSnapshot.description: Represents a snapshot of a scratch org. Snapshots capture the state of a scratch org so that you can use it to quickly spin up new scratch orgs using its configuration.

OrgWideEmailAddress.description: Represents an organization-wide email address for user profiles.
OrgWideEmailAddress.accessRules: Only authenticated users with the View Setup and Configuration permission can access this object.

Organization.description: Represents key configuration information for an organization.
Organization.accessRules: Customer Portal users can't access this object.

OtherComponentTask.description: Represents the details of a component task performed in a visit. A component task allows customers to launch components from the task framework.

OtherEmssnFctrSet.description: Represents a collection of emissions and conversion factors for various data types and sources that are neither the electricity grid nor scope 3 data types.

OtherEmssnFctrSetItem.description: Represents the individual entries for emissions and conversion factors for various data types and sources that are neither the electricity grid nor scope 3 data types.

OthrLifecyclEmssnFctrSet.description: Represents a collection of emissions factors used to calculate emissions that occur throughout the fuel lifecycle, from extraction to end-of-life. These fuels are used in stationary and vehicle assets other than electricity.

OthrLifecyclEmssnFctrSetItem.description: Represents the individual emissions factor for a fuel used to calculate emissions that occur throughout its lifecycle, from extraction to end-of-life. This fuel is used in stationary and vehicle assets other than electricity.

OutOfOffice.accessRules: In Lightning Experience, lets users set a message next to their name in Chatter to show when they plan to be out of the office. The message appears in Lightning Experience, Salesforce Classic, and mobile views. Messages expire automatically after their end date. You can control whether out-of-office functionality is available to your users. Set it up in the Out of Office section in Setup | Chatter Settings.

Outcome.description: Represents information about the expected change in participants that is driven by the organization's activity.

OutcomeActivity.description: Represents a junction between Outcome and the object that's related to the activity undertaken by an organization to achieve that outcome.

OvertimeApprover.description: Represents a person who approves overtime hours.

OvertimeType.description: Represents the overtime type code used to categorize overtime labor costs in the Enterprise Resource Planning system.

OwnedContentDocument.description: Represents a file owned by a user.

OwnerChangeOptionInfo.description: Represents default and optional actions that can be performed when a record’s owner is changed.
OwnerChangeOptionInfo.accessRules: OwnerChangeOptionInfo is accessible in Tooling API to user profiles with the View Setup and Configuration permission.

Package Install Event Type.description: Package Install events contain details about package installation in the organization.

PackageInstallEventLog.description: PackageInstallEventLog stores details about package installation in the organization.

PackageLicense.description: Represents a license for an installed managed package.
PackageLicense.accessRules: Customer Portal users can't access this object.

PackagePushError.description: Represents an error encountered during a push request. The number of PackagePushError records created depends on the number of push jobs in the request that result in an error.

PackagePushJob.description: Represents an individual push job for upgrading a package in an org from one version to another version. There can be multiple push jobs created for one push request. For example, if you want to upgrade five orgs as part of one push, you have one PackagePushRequest record and five PackagePushJob records.

PackagePushRequest.description: Represents the push request for upgrading a package in one or many orgs from one version to another version.

PackageSubscriber.description: Represents an installation of a package in an org. This object contains installation information for managed or unlocked packages developed in the org you’re logged in to.

PackageUploadRequest.description: Represents a request to upload a first-generation package version and its components so that subscribers can install it.

PackageVersionInstallRequestError.description: Second Generation Package Version Install Request Error (Tooling API)
PackageVersionInstallRequestError.label: Second Generation Package Version Install Request Error

PardotTenant.description: Represents an Account Engagement business unit.

Participant.description: Represents a participant in a ConversationParticipant. An existing or new Participant is referenced each time a new ConversationParticipant is created.

ParticipantRole.description: Represents details such as the name and associated default access level for a role that a participant can have in the context of a parent record.

Partner.description: Represents a partner relationship between two Account records or between an Opportunity record and an Account record.
Partner.accessRules: Customer Portal users can't access this object.

PartnerFundClaim.description: Represents a claim of funds from the partner marketing budget by a channel partner.

PartnerNetworkConnection.description: Represents a Salesforce to Salesforce connection between Salesforce organizations.
PartnerNetworkConnection.accessRules: As of Winter ’21 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.

PartnerNetworkRecordConnection.description: Represents a record shared between Salesforce organizations using Salesforce to Salesforce.
PartnerNetworkRecordConnection.accessRules: As of Winter ’21 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.

PartnerNetworkSyncLog.description: Represents the Org Sync Log tab in Salesforce, where Salesforce administrators can track the replication of record inserts and updates being performed in Organization Sync. The Connection Detail page for the replication connection also displays the Org Sync Log’s twenty most recent entries, and provides a link to the log.
PartnerNetworkSyncLog.accessRules: Org Sync Log tab can only be added in organizations where Organization Sync has been enabled. To add the tab to the Salesforce user interface, users must also have the “Manage Connections”

PartnerRole.description: Represents a role for an account Partner, such as consultant, supplier, and so on.
PartnerRole.accessRules: Customer Portal users can't access this object.

PartnershipAgreement.description: Represents a formal, renewable agreement that defines and governs an institution’s relationship with an external organization, including the scope, duration, and expected outcomes of corporate, research, and workforce partnerships.
PartnershipAgreement.accessRules: These fields are available only if United Kingdom Compliance and Configuration is turned on.

PartnershipPersonPlacement.description: Represents an individual's verified placement or participation delivered through a Partnership Agreement, linked to a specific program, and partner organization, including on-campus, research, internship, and employment experiences.
PartnershipPersonPlacement.accessRules: These fields are available only if United Kingdom Compliance and Configuration is turned on.

PartyBusinessRegion.description: Represents the trading regions of a party, covering both domestic and international locations, where the business entity is actively involved in trading activities.
