Tax engine providers have a one-to-many relationship with tax engines, where the tax engine record represents a specific configuration of a tax engine that can be assigned to multiple order items.
TaxEngineProvider.accessRules: the Tax Admin permission set to access this object

TaxGeoConfig.description: Represents a tax configuration associated with a GeoCountry.
TaxGeoConfig.accessRules: The TaxGeoConfig object is available if B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce is enabled.

TaxPolicy.description: Represents information about a group of tax treatments, where each treatment represents parameters to determine how a particular product is taxed for a transaction line item. Tax policies are related to products, which pass the policy on to the resulting order items and in turn the billing schedules.
TaxPolicy.accessRules: the Tax Admin permission set to access this object

TaxRate.description: Represents a tax rate for a tax code and country.
TaxRate.accessRules: The TaxRate object is available if B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce is enabled.

TaxTreatment.description: Represents information about tax calculation by external engines. Each product requires a tax policy to determine whether to apply tax. Each tax policy requires at least one tax treatment. The tax treatments determine how taxable products are taxed.
TaxTreatment.accessRules: the Tax Admin permission set to access this object

TaxTreatmentItem.description: Represents tax code information that’s used to calculate tax for a product by a specific tax engine.

Team.description: Represents the team of members associated with an organization.

TeamMember.description: Represents the member associated with a team.

TelemetryActionDefStep.description: Represents a step in the action for a telemetry signal definition.

TelemetryActionDefinition.description: Represents the action taken on a telemetry signal sent from a connected asset or vehicle, such as getting the current status of a vehicle or its component, or sending a request to perform a remote action on the vehicle or its component.

TelemetryActionRelatedProcess.description: Represents the relationship between a telemetry action and a process triggered by the action such as a service catalog item definition or a product.

TelemetryActnDefStepAttr.description: Represents the attributes of a telemetry action definition step.

TelemetryDefinition.description: Represents the definition of the structure of a telemetry signal sent from a connected asset or vehicle.

TelemetryDefinitionVersion.description: Represents a version of the structure of a telemetry signal sent from a connected asset or vehicle.

TenantConsumptionAlert.description: Stores a record each time a utilization signal is reached for your org's consumption-based products. Each record captures the signal type, the resource that triggered it, and the condition that was met.

TenantScrAIPrmptInjection.description: Stores generative AI prompt injection data.
TenantScrAIPrmptInjection.accessRules: This object is available for Security Center subscribers. This object is read-only.

TenantSecret.description: This object stores an encrypted organization-specific key fragment that’s used with the primary secret (KDF seed) to produce org-specific data encryption keys.

TenantSecurityAIGtwyUsage.description: Stores Einstein generative AI gateway usage data.
TenantSecurityAIGtwyUsage.accessRules: This object is available for Security Center subscribers. This object is read-only.

TenantSecurityAlertRuleSelectedTenant.description: Stores information about a Security Center alert rule for tenants.

TenantSecurityApiAnomaly.description: Stores detected anomalies in how users typically make API calls. Fore more information, see Threat Detection. This object is available to Security Center subscribers in API version 53.0 and later.

TenantSecurityCertificate.description: Stores metric details related to public key certificate information. The certificate binds the public key to the identity of an entity.

TenantSecurityConfigAgent.description: Stores metric details related to implemented Agentforce Agents
TenantSecurityConfigAgent.accessRules: This object is available for Security Center subscribers. This object is read-only.

TenantSecurityConnectedApp.accessRules: This object can only be read and queried.

TenantSecurityCustomMetricSetup.description: Represents the configuration for a custom metric within Security Center.

TenantSecurityCustomMetricStat.description: Represents custom metric data within Security Center.

TenantSecurityEncryptedField.description: Represents fields encrypted under your Shield Platform Encryption policy.

TenantSecurityFeature.description: Stores org features across all tenants in Security Center.

TenantSecurityGuestUserAnomaly.description: Represents metric details for guest user anomaly events detected by Threat Detection.

TenantSecurityHealthCheckDetail.description: Stores the details of Health Check scores for a connected tenant. The Health Check detail page in Security Center displays scores and settings for all your tenants in one place. Use this object to get settings and risks per tenant on a selected date.

TenantSecurityHealthCheckTrend.description: Stores the history of Security Health Check scores for a connected tenant within Security Center. Health Check in Security Center displays Health Check scores and the average risk settings for all your tenants in one place. This object belongs to the parent tenant and stores Health Check data pushed from child tenants. This object is available for Security Center subscribers in API version 53.0 and later.

TenantSecurityLicense.description: Stores license usage information within Security Center.
TenantSecurityLicense.accessRules: This object is available only for Security Center subscribers. This object is read-only.

TenantSecurityLogin.description: Stores the login details of a single user to a tenant, grouped by date and type. You can query this object to find out how many times the user logged in to a specific tenant using a specific login type (for example, username/password or SSO). User.description: Standard and custom fields extend the standard User object for use in Consumer Goods Cloud to represent a user in your company.
User.accessRules: To create or update a User record, you must have the Manage Internal Users permission. If the user is a Customer Portal user, you must have the Manage Customer Users permission. If the user is a partner portal user, you must have the Manage External Users permission. But the describeSObjects call always returns createable as true. If digital experiences is enabled, to create or update external users for Customer Portal, partner portal, or Experience Cloud sites, you must also have the Manage External Users permission. Information in hidden fields in a user's profile isn’t searchable by external users (with a portal profile) in an Experience Cloud site. For example, if a user in a site has a hidden email address and an external user searches for it, the user record isn’t returned in the search results. Hidden field values also aren’t returned when external users perform searches on nonhidden fields. So if an external user searches for a user's name (can’t be hidden), any hidden field values associated with the user record such as a hidden email address aren’t returned in the search results. But internal users belonging to the same Experience Cloud site can search for and view hidden field values in search results. When requested by portal users, queries that look up to the User object, such as owner.name or owner.email sometimes don’t return values when the portal user making the request doesn’t have Read access to the User record being queried. The behavior depends on the number of domains associated with the lookup field. If the object can look up to more than one domain, owner.name returns a value, but other detail fields don’t. For example, Case owner can look up to the User or Queue objects. In this case, portal users can see only the value of owner.name. Other User detail fields, such as owner.email or owner.phone don’t return a value. If the object can look up to only a single domain, such as Account owner, then no detail fields return values, including owner.name. To change ownership of a record by updating its OwnerId field, you must have both the Transfer Record permission and Read access to the User record of the new record owner. To view the NumberOfFailedLogins field, you must have the Manage User permission.

VideoCallParticipant.description: Represents a participant in a video call. Participant information can come from the video call provider (for example, Zoom), or Salesforce.

VideoCallRecording.description: Represents a recording from a video call, such as a video recording, a voice recording, or a transcript. Video call recordings aren’t saved in Salesforce.

VideoCallRecordingStructure.description: Represents the structure of a video call recording, having relation to a video call participant, speaking order, start offset, and end offset.
VideoCallRecordingStructure.accessRules: the Conversation Insights for Sales permission set

VideoCallTranscript.description: Represents the complete transcript text and metadata of a recorded video call.

ViolationEnforcementAction.description: Represents the action that a regulatory authority takes to address violations.

ViolationType.description: Represents violations types for licenses and permits.

ViolationTypeAssessmentInd.description: Represents violation types associated with assessment indicator definitions.

ViolationTypeUse.description: Represents a junction between a set of assessment questions and the violation type associated with them.

VirtualVisitConfig.description: Represents the configuration of an external video provider, which relays events from Salesforce to the provider.

Visit.description: Represents information about a visit that a manager schedules for a field rep to perform, usually at distributor, supplier, and partner locations.
Visit.accessRules: In Health Cloud, this object is available in API version 47.0 and later.

VisitedParty.description: Represents the contact person at the account that’s being visited.

VisitedPartyFeed.description: This object represents the posts and feed-tracked changes of the VisitedParty object.

Visitor.description: Represents the sales reps performing visits.
Visitor.accessRules: In Health Cloud, this object is available in API version 49.0 and later.

VisitorFeed.description: This object represents the posts and feed-tracked changes of the Visitor object.

Visualforce Request Event Type.description: Visualforce Request events contain details of Visualforce requests. Requests can originate from the browser (UI).

VisualforceAccessMetrics.description: Represents summary statistics for Visualforce pages.
VisualforceAccessMetrics.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, to access VisualforceAccessMetrics, users must have the Customize Application permission.

VisualforceRequestEventLog.description: Visualforce Request events contain details of Visualforce requests. Requests can originate from the browser (UI).

VoiceCall.description: Represents a call in Salesforce Voice, Sales Dialer, or other supported voice connectors. For Salesforce Voice, this can be a phone or Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) call. This object is available in API version 40.0 and later.
VoiceCall.accessRules: Only users with the Modify All Data permission can delete call records.

VoiceCallInsight.description: Represents the voice call insight data associated with a voice call. Each record represents the call insight of a specific recording or transcript within a call.
VoiceCallInsight.accessRules: the Conversation Insights for Sales permission set

VoiceCallInsightAction.accessRules: the Conversation Insights for Sales permission set

VoiceCallInsightReason.description: Represents the voice call insight reason that contains the insight keyword, insight moments associated with a keyword, and the number of keyword occurrences.
VoiceCallInsightReason.accessRules: the Conversation Insights for Sales permission set

VoiceCallList.description: Represents a prioritized list of numbers to call.
VoiceCallList.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.

VoiceCallListItem.description: Represents a single phone number in a prioritized call list.
VoiceCallListItem.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.

VoiceCallMetrics.description: Represents metrics for a VoiceCall lifecycle event, aggregated daily.

VoiceCallQualityFeedback.description: Represents feedback given by a Sales Dialer user about the quality of a VoiceCall .

VoiceCallRecording.description: Represents a call recording in Salesforce Voice and Sales Dialer.
VoiceCallRecording.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.

VoiceCallRecordingStructure.description: Represents the structure of a voice call recording, which includes voice call participants, speaking order, start offset, and end offset.
VoiceCallRecordingStructure.accessRules: the Conversation Insights for Sales permission set

VoiceCoaching.description: Represents a call that is using call monitoring.
VoiceCoaching.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.

VoiceLocalPresenceNumber.description: Represents a phone number with the same area code as the person who’s being called.
VoiceLocalPresenceNumber.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.

VoiceMailContent.description: Represents a voicemail message left by a caller to the context user.
VoiceMailContent.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.

VoiceMailGreeting.description: Represents a custom greeting message that plays upon reaching a user’s voicemail.
VoiceMailGreeting.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.

VoiceMailGreeting2.description: Represents information about a voicemail message that reps can drop during outbound customer calls, or set to play when they're unable to take calls from customers.

VoiceMailGreeting2Rep.description: Represents information about the voicemail message and its associated service rep.

VoiceMailMessage.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.

VoiceOrgSetting.description: Represents the org's customized voice settings.

VoiceUserLine.description: Represents a user’s forwarding phone number.
VoiceUserLine.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.

VoiceUserPreferences.description: Represents the number the user displays when making outbound calls.
VoiceUserPreferences.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.

VoiceVendorInfo.description: Represents information about the Salesforce Voice or Sales Dialer provider’s vendor.
VoiceVendorInfo.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.

VoiceVendorLine.description: Represents a user’s phone number reserved with the vendor.
VoiceVendorLine.accessRules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.

VoidInvoiceProcessedEvent.description: Represents the notification to the customers after the process started by the /commerce/invoicing/invoices/{invoiceId}/actions/void request is complete. The request attempts to void an invoice by crediting an invoice and changing its status to Voided, which prevents further changes.
VoidInvoiceProcessedEvent.accessRules: This object is available when Billing is enabled.

VolunteerProject.description: Represents information about activities that must be carried out within a certain time frame, at a specified location, by one or more volunteers.

Vote.description: Represents a vote that a user has made on a Knowledge Article, Idea, or Reply.
Vote.accessRules: As of Summer ’20 and later, only authenticated internal and external users can access this object.

Voucher.description: Represents details about a voucher that's issued to a customer or a loyalty program member.

VoucherDefinition.description: Represents details about a voucher definition that’s used to issue vouchers.

Waitlist.description: Represents a queue to which drop in customers who visit the branch without an already scheduled appointment are added.

WaitlistParticipant.description: Represents a customer who is added to a waitlist.

WaitlistServiceResource.description: Represents the relationship between the Waitlist object and the Service Resource object for Salesforce Scheduler.

WaitlistWorkType.description: Represents the relationship between the Waitlist object and the Work Type object for Salesforce Scheduler.

WarrantyTerm.description: Represents warranty terms defining the labor, parts, and expenses covered, along with any exchange options, provided to rectify issues with products.

WarrantyTermCoverage.description: Represents a junction between the warranty term coverage and a product or codeset, such as the repair code or labor code.

WasteFootprint.description: Represents the volume of aggregated waste and carbon emissions from waste generated either as part of operations or during the end- of- life of a product.

WasteFootprintItem.description: Represents the volume by waste type and disposal type of aggregated waste generated either as part of operations or during the end- of- life of a product.

WatchlistedLearner.description: Represents information for a learner that needs to be monitored for support.

Wave Change Event Type.description: Wave Change events represent route or page changes made in the CRM Analytics user interface. A Wave Change event type is captured every time the user opens a new CRM Analytics asset or tab, switches between tabs, or changes dashboard pages. Wave Change events are logged when opening new tabs and switching back to previously opened tabs.

Wave Download Event Type.description: represent downloads made from lens explorations and dashboard widgets in the CRM Analytics user interface. A Wave Download event type is captured when a user downloads images ( .png ), Microsoft® Excel® data ( .xls ), or comma-separated values ( .csv ) files.

Wave Interaction Event Type.description: Wave Interaction events represent route or page changes made in the CRM Analytics user interface. A Wave Interaction event type is captured when a tab is closed. It also collates the interaction statistics over the life of the tab, including total open time, read time, and so on. These statistics are aggregated as you go to other tabs and return, and logged only once when the tab is closed.

Wave Performance Event Type.description: Wave Performance events help you track trends in your Analytics performance.

WaveAutoInstallRequest.description: Provides access to the concrete object that represents a CRM Analytics auto-install request. The auto-install request tracks the progress of CRM Analytics applications created from CRM Analytics templates by the automated process user.
WaveAutoInstallRequest.accessRules: CRM Analytics must be enabled in your org. A user must have the Auto Install permission enabled.

WealthAppConfig.description: Represents configuration information for Agentforce Financial Services functionality.

WebCart.description: Represents an online shopping cart for a store built with B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce, with total amounts for products, shipping and handling, and taxes.
WebCart.accessRules: The WebCart object is available only if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled.

WebCartAdjustmentBasis.description: Coupons that trigger promotions for the cart. When a customer tries to add a coupon to the cart, the store looks for promotions associated with the coupon. If a promotion results in a price adjustment, a WebCartAdjusmentBasis record is created.
WebCartAdjustmentBasis.accessRules: This object is available only if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled.

WebCartAdjustmentGroup.description: Group of price adjustments for a cart.
WebCartAdjustmentGroup.accessRules: The WebCartAdjustmentGroup object is available only if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled.

WebCartHistory.description: WebCartHistory represents the history of changes to the values in the fields of the WebCart object.

WebLink.description: Represents a custom button or link.
WebLink.accessRules: To create a custom link, the client application must be logged in with the “Customize Application” permission. Customer Portal users can’t access this object.

WebLinkLocalization.description: Represents the translated value of the field label for a custom link to a URL or s-control when the Translation Workbench is enabled for your organization.
WebLinkLocalization.accessRules: Your organization must be using Professional, Enterprise, Developer, Unlimited, or Performance Edition and be enabled for the Translation Workbench. To view this object, you must have the “View Setup and Configuration” permission.

WebStore.description: Represents a B2B or D2C store.

WebStoreCatalog.description: Represents the collection of products associated with a store.
WebStoreCatalog.accessRules: You must have the B2B Commerce license and a CMS workspace to access product media.

WebStoreInventorySource.description: Used to configure the inventory source for a webstore.

WebStoreMessageContent.description: Represents the assocation of a managed content message record in CMS to a web store, along with other attributes that specify the application and intent of the message content.

WebStoreNetwork.description: Represents the relationship between a web store and an experience site.

WebStorePricebook.description: Represents a store price book used in Lightning B2B Commerce.
WebStorePricebook.accessRules: This object is available only if the B2B Commerce license is enabled.

WebStoreSearchProdSettings.description: Search settings for a WebStore product search.
WebStoreSearchProdSettings.accessRules: You must have a B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce commerce license to create a web store.

WebStoreShare.description: Represents a sharing entry on a B2B or D2C store.
WebStoreShare.accessRules: Your Salesforce admin can manage this object using standard Salesforce sharing rules and CRUD access for the WebStore.

WebStoreTemplate.description: Represents a configuration for creating commerce stores.
WebStoreTemplate.accessRules: A B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license and access to Commerce objects is required.

WebstoreBuyerGroup.description: Associates a webstore with a buyer group. Supports dynamically changing locales when buyers shop in orgs that are enabled for multiple languages and currencies.

Wishlist.description: Represents a buyer-created list of WishlistItems in a store that’s built with B2B Commerce on Lightning.
Wishlist.accessRules: The Wishlist object is available only if the B2B Commerce license is enabled.

WishlistItem.description: Represents an item on a Wishlist in a store built with B2B Commerce for Lightning.
WishlistItem.accessRules: The WishListItem object is available only if the B2B Commerce for Lightning license is enabled.

WorkAccess.description: Used to grant or restrict user access to give badge definitions. Each badge definition record must have one WorkAccess record.

WorkAccessShare.description: Used to control Givers of WorkBadgeDefinition records.

WorkBadge.description: Represents information about who the badge was given to and which badge was given. A WorkBadge record is created for each recipient of a WorkBadgeDefinition.

WorkBadgeDefinition.description: Represents the attributes of a badge including the badge name, description, and image. Each WorkBadge record must have a lookup to a WorkBadgeDefinition since badge attributes (like badge name) are derived from the WorkBadgeDefinition object.

WorkCapacityAvailability.description: Represents the available work capacity for a specific time and service territory.

WorkCapacityLimit.description: Represents the capacity limit in a specific service territory for a workstream or for the whole service territory in a given period.

WorkCapacityUsage.description: Represents the capacity usage in a specific service territory for a workstream or for the whole service territory in a given period.

WorkCoaching.description: Represents a single coaching relationship between two users. One of the users is defined as the coach and the other is defined as a coachee. WorkCoaching is feed-enabled so there is a private feed available to the coach and coachee.

WorkDemographic.description: Represents the field values used to specify slices in the workload forecasting and capacity planning.

WorkFeedback.description: Represents the answer to a question that a person was asked via a feedback request. Also used to store offered feedback without linking it to a particular question.

WorkFeedbackQuestion.description: Represents a free-form text type or multiple choice question within a set of questions.

WorkFeedbackQuestionSet.description: Represents a set of questions being asked. The question set is used to link all the individual requests where different recipients were asked the same set of questions on the same subject.

WorkFeedbackRequest.description: Represents a single feedback request on a subject or topic (question) to a single recipient in the feedback application. In the case of offered feedback, WorkFeedbackRequest represents feedback that is offered about a subject. In the performance application, WorkFeedbackRequest represents a request for feedback on a set of questions from a question set, on a subject—for the recipient to complete and submit.

WorkGoal.description: Represents the components of a goal, such as its description and associated metrics.

WorkGoalCollaborator.description: Represents collaborators on a WorkGoal object. This doesn’t include WorkGoal followers, which is handled by Chatter Feed Follow functionality.

WorkGoalCollaboratorHistory.description: Represents the history of changes to the values in the fields in a WorkGoalCollaborator object. Access is read-only.

WorkGoalHistory.description: Represents the history of changes to the values in the fields of a WorkGoal. Access is read-only.

WorkGoalLink.description: Represents the relationship between two goals (many to many relationship).

WorkGoalShare.description: Represents a sharing entry on a WorkGoal object.

WorkItem.description: Represents a logical unit of work, such as a user story, task, or bug, used to track the progress of metadata and configuration data changes within a DevOps Center project. A work item moves through multiple development lifecycle stages until all development work is complete and the work item is part of the release pipeline.

WorkItemComponent.description: Represents a metadata component or configuration data record that’s linked to a WorkItemComponentList record in a DevOps Center project. The record includes details such as the change type, metadata member, and change tracking information.

WorkItemEvent.description: Represents real-time notifications for work item status changes in a DevOps Center project.

WorkOrder.description: Represents field service work to be performed for a customer.
WorkOrder.accessRules: Work orders or Field Service must be enabled. The following fields can’t be edited, regardless of your field-level security settings: Discount GrandTotal IsGeneratedFromMaintenancePlan RootWorkOrderId Discount GrandTotal IsGeneratedFromMaintenancePlan RootWorkOrderId

WorkOrderHistory.description: Represents the history of changes made to tracked fields on a work order.
WorkOrderHistory.accessRules: Work orders or Field Service must be enabled in your organization, and field tracking for work order fields must be configured.

WorkOrderLineItem.description: Represents a subtask on a work order in field service.
WorkOrderLineItem.accessRules: Work orders or Field Service must be enabled.

WorkOrderLineItemHistory.description: Represents the history of changes made to tracked fields on a work order line item.
WorkOrderLineItemHistory.accessRules: Work orders or Field Service must be enabled in your organization, and field tracking for work order line item fields must be configured.

WorkOrderLineItemStatus.description: Represents a possible status of a work order line item in field service.

WorkOrderShare.description: Represents a sharing entry on a work order.
WorkOrderShare.accessRules: Work orders or Field Service must be enabled in your organization. External users can’t access this object.

WorkOrderStatus.description: Represents a possible status of a work order in field service.

WorkPerformanceCycle.description: Represents feedback that is gathered to assess the performance of a specific set of employees.

WorkPlan.description: Represents a work plan for a work order or work order line item.

WorkPlanSelectionRule.description: Represents a rule that selects a work plan for a work order or work order line item.

WorkPlanTemplate.description: Represents a template for a work plan.

WorkPlanTemplateEntry.description: Represents an object that associates a work step template with a work plan template.

WorkProcedure.description: Represents information about a procedure or process that's part of a program, such as a care program in Health Cloud or Life Sciences Cloud.
WorkProcedure.accessRules: Available in API version 56.0 and later with Health Cloud.

WorkProcedureStep.description: Represents information about the work type that's a part of a work procedure.
WorkProcedureStep.accessRules: Available in API version 56.0 and later with Health Cloud.

WorkReport.description: Represents the total work performed by a contractor business in a certain period of time for utility customers at one or more locations, providing services for one or more measures.

WorkReportError.description: Represents errors in the Work Report through the Work Report Line Item object.

WorkReportLineItem.description: Represents one measure of work performed by a contractor business for a consumer at a location within a program.

WorkReward.description: Used to store reward codes tied to a Reward Fund. Reward Funds must have at least one WorkReward record.

WorkRewardFund.description: Represents a Reward Fund and describes the Reward Fund attributes.

WorkRewardFundType.description: Represents the type of WorkRewardFund object.

WorkStep.description: Represents a work step in a work plan.

WorkStepStatus.description: Represents a picklist for a status category on a work step.

WorkStepTemplate.description: Represents a template for a work step.

WorkThanks.description: Represents the source and message of a thanks post.

WorkType.description: Represents a type of work to be performed for a dealer location. Work types are templates that associate a work group to a service territory.

WorkTypeAssetType.description: Represents a junction between Work Type and Asset Type. This junction object enables admins to associate a visit type such as PRP Hair Restoration to an asset type such as Room.

WorkTypeCareSpecialty.description: Represents a relationship between a care specialty and a visit type (Work Type).

WorkTypeCodeSetBundle.description: Represents a relationship between visit type (Work Type) and code set bundles that represent the service and appointment details for the visit type.

WorkTypeExtension.description: Represents additional information about a work type.
WorkTypeExtension.accessRules: Available in API version 56.0 and later with Health Cloud.

WorkTypeGroup.description: Represents a grouping of work types used to categorize types of available appointments.

WorkTypeGroupDataTranslation.description: Represents the translated values of the data stored within a WorkTypeGroup record’s fields.
WorkTypeGroupDataTranslation.accessRules: Your organization must be using Enterprise, Performance, Unlimited, or Developer edition. Translation Workbench and data translation must be enabled in your org. To view this object, you must have the “View Setup and Configuration” permission

WorkTypeGroupMember.description: Represents the relationship between a work type and the work type group it belongs to.

WorkTypeGroupRole.description: Represents a grouping of work types by roles, used to categorize types of appointments available in Salesforce Scheduler.

WorkTypeStep.description: Represents each step within a work type.
WorkTypeStep.accessRules: Available in API version 59.0 and later with Health Cloud.

WorkTypeStepLdTimeOvride.description: Represents the lead time that's used to override the default lead time required for the work procedure, work type, or work type step that's performed at a service territory in a country.

WorkTypeSvcTerrSchdPrio.description: Represents the priority of the combination of the service territory, work type, and work procedure while fetching appointment slots.

WorkerCompCoverageClass.description: Represents the compensation coverage class that a worker belongs to.

WorkflowAction.description: Represents WorkflowAction metadata component used in Salesforce deployments and package development.
WorkflowAction.label: Workflow Action

WorkflowAlert.description: Represents a workflow alert. A workflow alert is an email generated by a workflow rule or approval process and sent to designated recipients.

WorkflowOutboundMessage.description: Represents an outbound message. An outbound message sends information to a designated endpoint, like an external service. Outbound messages are configured from Setup. You must configure the external endpoint and create a listener for the messages using the SOAP API.

WorkflowRule.description: Represents a workflow rule that is used to fire off a specific workflow action when the specified criteria is met. Includes access to the associated WorkflowRule object in Salesforce Metadata API.

WorkflowTask.description: Represents a workflow task that is used to fire off a specific workflow action when the specified criteria is met. Includes access to the associated WorkflowRule object in Salesforce Metadata API.

WorkforceCapacity.description: Represents the time series for actual or forecasted workforce allocation.

WorkforceCapacityUnit.description: Represents the number of resources allocated or needed for a specific set of work items at a timestamp within a specific duration.

Workload.description: Represents the time series for work item volume and average handle time from aggregation and forecasting processes.

WorkloadUnit.description: Represents the number of work items and average handle time in a specific time interval.

WstDispoEmssnFctrSet.description: Represents the emissions factors for scope 3 waste handling.

WstDispoEmssnFctrSetItm.description: Represents the individual emissions factors for scope 3 waste handling based on the waste type and disposal type.

XmdDimRecordDisplayLookup.description: Xmd Dimension Record Display Lookups - XmdDimRecordDisplayLookup
XmdDimRecordDisplayLookup.label: Xmd Dimension Record Display Lookup

YearlyUsageTrkgDataGap.description: Represents the percentage of gaps in the fuel usage data in a year.

actionplantemplate.description: Defines a template for different assessment tasks in a visit.

cgc_sync__Sync_API_Log__c.description: Stores performance information that's executed on synchronization endpoints.

cgc_sync__Sync_Client_Registration__c.description: Stores the details of the Consumer Goods Cloud offline mobile app device that a synchronization request to Salesforce is initiated from.

cgc_sync__Sync_History_Detail__c.description: Contains detailed information about all sync history records.

cgc_sync__Sync_History__c.description: Stores information about every sync that's performed on the mobile app along with its status information and associated Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).

cgc_sync__Sync_ID_Mapping__c.description: Contains information about the mappings of the local mobile application IDs to Salesforce IDs.

cgc_sync__Sync_Message__c.description: Represents the messages that are exposed to a mobile app user during the sync process

cgc_sync__Sync_Metadata_Changes__c.description: Stores the timestamps for the changes that are made in the metadata.

cgc_sync__Sync_Mobile_App_Component__c.description: Contains the settings for different customizable UI components in the theme.

cgc_sync__Sync_Mobile_App_Depl_Pkg_As__c.description: Contains information about the recipient of the deployment package.

cgc_sync__Sync_Mobile_App_Depl_Pkg_Inst_.description: Maintains a record of the installed deployment packages, their installation timestamps, and devices on which those packages are deployed.

cgc_sync__Sync_Mobile_App_Depl_Pkg__c.description: Deployment packages that contain application runtime artifacts of the mobile app.

cgc_sync__Sync_Mobile_App_Domain__c.description: Stores information about domains that are available as dropdown boxes in the mobile app.

cgc_sync__Sync_Mobile_App_Installation__.description: Contains information about the user to whom the deployment package is to be distributed.

cgc_sync__Sync_Mobile_App_Log__c.description: Stores the error messages and warnings that occurred in the mobile app. Such error messages and warnings are uploaded every time a user runs the upload to Salesforce action in the mobile app.

cgc_sync__Sync_Mobile_App_Macro__c.description: Contains the color macros that are used for themes.

cgc_sync__Sync_Mobile_App_PL_Config__c.description: Contains the mapping information of picklists for dropdown boxes in the mobile app.

cgc_sync__Sync_Mobile_App_PL_Map_Ext__c.description: Contains the mapping information of picklists and dropdown boxes in the mobile app.

cgc_sync__Sync_Mobile_App_PL_Map__c.description: Contains the mapping information of picklists and dropdown boxes in the mobile application.

cgc_sync__Sync_Mobile_App_PL_Repo__c.description: Represents the repository of dropdown boxes in a mobile app.

cgc_sync__Sync_Mobile_App_Theme__c.description: Represents the themes of a mobile app.

cgc_sync__Sync_Named_Query__c.description: Contains details and SOQL (Salesforce Object Query Language) statements for a named query.

cgc_sync__Sync_Remote_Request__c.description: Stores requests to trigger technical activities on the mobile app. For example, data resupply and clean-up upload queue.

cgcloud__Account_Condition__c.description: Contains the details of the relationship between customer and the customer conditions.

cgcloud__Account_Extension__c.description: This object records account roles and further product-related attributes.

cgcloud__Account_Manager__c.description: This object stores the details of users who manage specific accounts in a particular function (ManagementType).

cgcloud__Account_Org_Unit__c.description: Contains the details of the relationship between customer and the org unit.

cgcloud__Account_Plan_Category__c.description: Categories of the account plan including the manual inputs. Categories can be assigned to an account plan. A category can only be assigned to one account/business year combination.

cgcloud__Account_Plan_User_Filter__c.description: Contains the filter selections of a user for a planning account.

cgcloud__Account_Plan__c.description: Contains the details of the account data for one planning account, one business year and one or multiple categories.

cgcloud__Account_Product_Profile__c.description: This object stores statistical profiles that indicate the distribution of weekly data between a customer and category.

cgcloud__Account_Receivable__c.description: Holds the customer related information regarding invoices to be paid and debit and credit notes.

cgcloud__Account_Relationship__c.description: This object represents the relationship between two customer accounts.

cgcloud__Account_Sales_Data__c.description: Contains the information of the sales of a customer for two consecutive years. Access of the object provided to the System Admin.

cgcloud__Account_Set_Account__c.description: Junction object between Customer and Customer Set.

cgcloud__Account_Set_Manager__c.description: Custom object to store the relation between Customer Set and User.

cgcloud__Account_Set__c.description: Represents the object for the creation of Customer Sets.

cgcloud__Account_Specific_Product_Condit.description: Holds the relation between a customer and the condition template.

cgcloud__Account_Sub_Account__c.description: Defines the account to sub-account relationship.

cgcloud__Account_Task_Template__c.description: Represents the details of the customer task template to be used for customer tasks.

cgcloud__Account_Task__c.description: This object represents the details of the customer task (customer issue).

cgcloud__Account_Template__c.description: Stores the details of the account template object that's to be used for accounts.

cgcloud__Account_Trade_Org_Hierarchy__c.description: This object represents the details of the account hierarchy.

cgcloud__Account_Visit_Setting__c.description: This object stores the settings for the calls of a user based on a customer.

cgcloud__Approval_Code__c.description: Represents the attributes for approval code of users.

cgcloud__Asset_Audit__c.description: Represents the details of an asset survey.

cgcloud__Asset_Template__c.description: An asset is a physical element that has a certain value which a manufacturer can place at a customer's location (retailer, bar, hotel, shop, and so on), and it can be associated to a POS (such as a shelf, cooler, fridge, and more).

cgcloud__Auto_Number_Sequence__c.description: Stores information about the numbered index of the next transaction log record.

cgcloud__BO_API_Entity__c.description: This table stores the entity definitions of Business Object APIs.

cgcloud__BO_API_Output_Entity__c.description: This table stores the output entities of the Business Object API.

cgcloud__BO_API_Step_Input_Structure__c.description: This table stores the input structure configuration that the business object API workflow step expects.

cgcloud__BO_API_Transaction_Log__c.description: This object stores information about Business Object API Transaction Log, which is a collection of one or more promotions that should be created or updated under the same name via the Promotion BO Creation API.

cgcloud__BO_API_Workflow_Entity__c.description: This object stores the entities that Business Object API Workflows use.

cgcloud__BO_API_Workflow_Step__c.description: This table stores the definitions of the workflow step.

cgcloud__BO_API_Workflow_Workflow_Step__.description: This table stores the junction object to identify the workflow steps that apply for each workflow.

cgcloud__BO_API_Workflow__c.description: This table stores the workflows that are defined for the Business Object.

cgcloud__BO_API__c.description: This table stores the header record of Business Object APIs.

cgcloud__Batch_Last_Successful_Run__c.description: Keeps track of the last successful runs.

cgcloud__Batch_Process_Configuration__c.description: Custom setting that captures the configuration of the batch process.

cgcloud__Business_Year__c.description: This object stores the attributes of the Business Year.

cgcloud__CGCPS_Service_Settings__c.description: Use this custom setting to either enable or disable CGCPS service data mocking. With this setting, you can develop non-CGCPS service-enabled orgs.
